Our software supports pathologists in detecting cancer faster and more accurately by applying state-of-the-art deep learning to medical images. Our AI solution is the first to be implemented in clinical histopathology for primary diagnostics in the USA and is used in routine workflows around the world.

We tackle a central challenge in modern healthcare: a growing demand for medical image analysis with a static number of cancer experts. By providing powerful, robust tools for visual diagnosis, we help pathologists focus on what only humans can do best—while our technology takes care of the rest.

 

Position Summary

Role: Fullstack Developer (TypeScript/JavaScript, React, OpenLayers, Python, Django, Postgres)

Focus: Building modern web UIs for AI-assisted pathology workflows, including their backend. Managing and maintaining our huge annotation data platform.

Team: Close collaboration with product design, machine learning teams and annotators.

What you'll work on

  • Build and optimize intuitive user interfaces for visualizing complex medical imaging data and AI-generated results, including millions of cell-level predictions.

  • Turn complex AI outputs into clear, actionable insights for pathologists and other medical experts.

  • Develop tools and lightweight interfaces that simplify data collection, annotation, and review workflows.

  • Design, build, and integrate backend APIs that connect AI models with our applications, ensuring performance, reliability, and scalability.

  • Shape and improve product features through close collaboration with pathologists, product teams, and designers, turning real-world feedback into practical solutions.

Your Responsibilities

  • Ship high-quality features, from prototype to production.

  • Improve performance, accessibility, and reliability of complex visualizations.

  • Own parts of the annotation pipeline UI and help automate repetitive steps.

  • Manage priorities and deadlines in an agile environment.

Your Profile

jobs.title: Product Manager - Accounting (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Mach aus komplexer Buchhaltungssoftware eine, die Menschen ihre Arbeit leichter macht.

Bei Buena kaufen wir Hausverwaltungen und entwickeln die Software, mit der sie täglich arbeiten. Dadurch sind wir direkt an den Menschen, Prozessen und Problemen, für die wir bauen.

Buchhaltung ist ein zentraler Bestandteil dieser Arbeit. Ob Mietausschüttung, Unterkonten oder Jahresabrechnung: Abläufe müssen verständlich, Ergebnisse korrekt und Automatisierungen auch dann zuverlässig sein, wenn etwas vom Standardfall abweicht.

Wir suchen jemanden, der Buchhaltung tief versteht und dieses Wissen in bessere Software übersetzen kann. Gemeinsam mit unseren Nutzern, Engineering und Design findest du heraus, welche Probleme wir lösen müssen, wie eine gute Lösung aussieht und wohin sich unser Accounting-Produkt entwickeln soll.

Was du bei uns machst

  • Probleme wirklich verstehen: Du arbeitest dich in die Buchhaltungsprozesse unserer Hausverwaltungen ein – inklusive Sonderfällen, fachlichen Anforderungen und bestehender Einschränkungen.

  • Die richtigen Verbesserungen identifizieren: Du unterscheidest zwischen fehlenden Funktionen, unklaren Abläufen, technischen Fehlern und Fragen zur Bedienung.

  • Die Produktrichtung gestalten: Du entwickelst eine klare Vorstellung davon, wie Accounting bei Buena funktionieren soll, und priorisierst Verbesserungen nach Nutzen, fachlicher Notwendigkeit und Wirkung.

  • Lösungen konkret machen: Du übersetzt komplexe Anforderungen in verständliche Konzepte, Spezifikationen und Nutzerabläufe, die du mit Engineering und Design weiterentwickelst.

  • Korrektheit sicherstellen: Du prüfst Lösungen, denkst Sonderfälle durch und beurteilst, ob neue Funktionen die zugrunde liegenden Anforderungen erfüllen.

  • Bis zur Nutzung dranbleiben: Du begleitest Verbesserungen bis zur Einführung und überprüfst, ob sie das ursprüngliche Problem im Alltag lösen.

Das kann eine gezielte Verbesserung bei Mietausschüttungen sein – oder die grundlegende Weiterentwicklung unserer Kontenstruktur.

Was du mitbringst

  • Tiefes Buchhaltungsverständnis: Du kannst Abläufe erklären und erkennst, wenn etwas fachlich fehlt oder nicht stimmt. Erfahrung in der Immobilien- oder WEG-Buchhaltung ist besonders wertvoll.

  • Produktdenken: Du hinterfragst bestehende Arbeitsweisen, unterscheidest echte Anforderungen von Gewohnheiten und entwickelst Ideen für bessere Abläufe.

  • Analytische Stärke: Du zerlegst komplexe Probleme, vergleichst Lösungswege und erkennst, welcher nächste Schritt den größten Nutzen bringt.

  • Technische Neugier: Du möchtest verstehen, wie unsere Software funktioniert, und kannst Anforderungen und Abwägungen mit Engineers diskutieren.

  • Klare Kommunikation und Eigenverantwortung: Du bringst Fachlichkeit, Nutzerperspektive und Produktentwicklung zusammen und bleibst an einer Lösung, bis sie praktisch funktioniert.

Besonders relevant ist Erfahrung mit der Entwicklung oder Verbesserung von Buchhaltungssoftware. Dein bisheriger Jobtitel ist dabei zweitrangig: Entscheidend ist, dass du Buchhaltung verstehst und daraus sinnvolle Softwarelösungen ableiten kannst. Praktische Erfahrung mit KI-Tools für Recherche, Prototypen oder Tests ist ein Plus.

Warum du bei Buena einsteigen solltest

  • Dein Fachwissen verändert das Produkt: Du arbeitest direkt mit den Menschen, die unsere Software nutzen, und siehst, was deine Entscheidungen im Alltag bewirken.

  • Du ergänzt ein starkes Team: Engineering und Design bringen ihre Expertise ein. Gemeinsam könnt ihr Probleme von der fachlichen Ursache bis zur fertigen Lösung bearbeiten.

  • Deine Ergebnisse schaffen Möglichkeiten: Wir wachsen schnell und geben Menschen Verantwortung, die etwas bewegen.

  • Du baust langfristig mit: Unsere Mission ist, Wohneigentum zugänglicher zu machen. Gute Software und funktionierende Hausverwaltungen bilden dafür die Grundlage.

Deine Benefits

  • Büronähe wird belohnt: Bis zu 500 € Close-to-Office-Bonus bei einem Wohnort mit 10–20 Minuten Fußweg zum Büro.

  • Verpflegung: 110 € monatliches Lunch-Budget.

  • Weiterentwicklung: 1.200 € Bildungsbudget pro Jahr.

  • Lesestoff: Bücher, die du lesen möchtest, übernehmen wir.

  • Von der Idee bis zur Nutzung begleiten: Du lieferst die passende Detailtiefe für ein Projekt, klärst offene Fragen während der Entwicklung und überprüfst nach dem Release, ob die Verbesserung ankommt.

  • KI praktisch einsetzen: Du nutzt Tools, um Produktverhalten zu untersuchen, Ideen auszuprobieren, Prototypen zu bauen und Tests zu unterstützen.

Type: Full-time

What about us?

Launched in 2023, INFINIT is a fast-growing fintech scale-up operating in multiple countries across Europe and Americas.

At INFINIT we are on a mission to reshape the future of SMEs with AI at the forefront. Our all-in-one operating system has banking at its core, and empowers small business owners and their teams to seamlessly manage and optimize every aspect of their business with AI agents.

By focussing on specific industries, INFINIT delivers tailored, high-value solutions, while building innovative AI products to further unlock significant growth opportunities for our customers. INFINIT operates globally, with ambitions to further expand its footprint to redefine the fintech landscape for SMEs worldwide.

Join us on the INFINIT journey as we revolutionise the SME economy and drive meaningful impact through innovation 🚀 

The Role

We are hiring a Software Engineer (B2B Lending & Payments) to take ownership of the financial infrastructure that powers how our clients finance their assets through INFINIT.

We believe the most resilient lending and payment systems are built by engineers who operate at the intersection of deep technical mastery, genuine product judgment, and direct proximity to the client’s financing workflow. This is not a ticket-execution role. You will work with business stakeholders and clients to understand why a problem matters before deciding what to build then use agentic coding to ship the how fast and well.

Partnering with other engineers owning this domain, you will own two deeply connected responsibilities. First, crafting the best possible experience for a client going through a loan application, from the moment they submit a request to the moment financing is confirmed, every step should feel clear, fast, and trustworthy. Second, ensuring that every payment executed throughout the loan lifecycle (interest accruals, supplier disbursements, reimbursement) is processed correctly, securely, and without exception. Third, supporting the physical audit and due diligence workflows that allow us to maintain control over the collateral throughout the life of the loan.

You will be the person the rest of the team pings when something in this domain breaks.


What do you need to be successful in this role?

  • Expert C# & .NET Engineering, mastery of the .NET ecosystem with a focus on building high-performance, distributed backend systems. You have a proven track record of shipping scalable, production-grade architectures where technical clarity and long-term maintainability are the default.

  • Core banking & ledger logic, a strong professional background in regulated financial environments. You understand the mechanics of ledgers, loan origination, and payment execution and the cost of getting any of it wrong.

  • Mission-critical ownership: Demonstrated ability to own features end-to-end. You don't just "write code"; you analyze customer financing workflows, define rigorous technical requirements, and take full accountability for the reliability of every transaction you process.

  • Highly effective stakeholder communication, capable of seamlessly translating deep technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders (customers, product managers) and clearly translating business objectives into prioritized engineering tasks.

  • Practical experience leveraging modern developer tools (such as agentic coding or advanced automation techniques) to achieve significantly accelerated development velocity while rigorously upholding code quality standards.

jobs.description:
About Agicap

Créée à Lyon en 2016 par trois entrepreneurs français, Agicap est l'une des scale-ups avec la plus forte croissance d’Europe, avec plus de 8 000 clients, 600 employés et une croissance rapide du chiffre d'affaires (multiplié par 7 entre 2021 et 2024). Agicap fait partie du French Tech 120, qui récompense les startups les plus prometteuses de France.

Agicap permet aux directions financières des entreprises de taille intermédiaire de gérer et de prévoir efficacement leur trésorerie, de payer leurs fournisseurs et de se faire payer. En combinant un système de gestion de trésorerie avec des solutions de gestion des comptes fournisseurs et des comptes clients sur une seule plateforme, Agicap ambitionne de devenir la nouvelle référence en matière de gestion de trésorerie pour les entreprises de taille intermédiaire.

Nous avons levé 145 millions d’euros depuis notre création, auprès de fonds de capital-risque prestigieux tels qu’AVP, Greenoaks, Partech et BlackFin, avec un dernier tour en novembre 2024.

Ces ressources supplémentaires alimentent encore davantage notre innovation produit, nous permettant de croître significativement et d’accélérer notre expansion internationale à travers le monde.

Nous sommes convaincus que notre succès réside dans nos équipes passionnées et dévouées, engagées à bâtir une entreprise où chacun peut évoluer et construire sa carrière. Nous sommes constamment à la recherche de nouveaux talents, visant l’excellence et prêts à rejoindre notre aventure ambitieuse !

Home page
Customer Stories
Our Values

Tu veux travailler sur une Data Platform qui irrigue toute une scale-up fintech — du Marketing au Produit, en passant par la Finance, le Customer Success et les sales — et qui est aujourd'hui au cœur de notre transition AI-first ? Tu as le recul pour maintenir des systèmes en prod ET l'énergie pour aller construire la couche sémantique qui va connecter nos données à l'IA ?

Chez Agicap, la Data Platform répond aux besoins analytics (reporting, IA) et de synchronisation de données au service de toute l'entreprise. Elle s'appuie sur Google Cloud Platform (notamment BigQuery et Composer), Airbyte, dbt et Looker pour maintenir et diffuser des données à jour, consolidées et fiables.
🔥 Le chantier qui change tout : l'ouverture de l'accès à la donnée d'entreprise par l'IA via notre serveur MCP Analytics. On a déjà posé les premières briques avec les Explores Looker gouvernés par les DA — la suite logique, c'est l'extension à BigQuery couplée à une couche sémantique. Et c'est là que tu entres en jeu.


👥L'équipe que tu rejoins

Tu intègres une équipe de 3 Data Engineers qui collabore au quotidien avec 4 Data Analysts et Pauline (Head of Data). Tu seras en lien direct avec Kévin (Team Lead Data Engineering) et Pauline au quotidien. L'équipe Data est rattachée au département Revenue & Operations.

L'équipe en 3 mots : soudée, pragmatique, exigeante techniquement. On porte beaucoup de sujets stratégiques en parallèle — c'est pour ça qu'on cherche un·e senior qui pourra prendre vite ses marques et apporter du poids sur les décisions d'architecture.


💪 Tes missions

Tu alternes entre run exigeant et chantiers structurants :

  • Maintenir et fiabiliser la plateforme : Composer (Airflow), Airbyte self-hosted sur GKE, BigQuery, dbt, Terraform. Une part de ton temps va au run (gestion des incidents, support DA), réparti au sein de l'équipe DE. Tu conçois et enrichis tests, monitoring et alerting — technique et fonctionnel.
  • Industrialiser l'ingestion de données : collecter les sources via Airbyte (API ou CDC selon les cas), gérer l'évolution des schémas et les tables externes BigQuery.
  • Alimenter les outils métier : reverse-ETL et synchronisations entre outils (HubSpot, Gainsight, Intercom…) ou vers notre base temps réel PostgreSQL via notre architecture streaming (webhooks → Pub/Sub → Cloud Run).
  • Étendre la couche d'accès IA : prolonger le MCP Analytics vers BigQuery, construire la couche sémantique qui conditionne la qualité des réponses de l'IA. La qualité de la modélisation fait la qualité des réponses.
  • Maîtriser coûts et sécurité : réservations de slots BigQuery en autoscaling, routage dynamique du build dbt, revue FinOps mensuelle, least privilege, gestion des données personnelles et sensibles, sécurisation des accès data par l'IA.

👀 Comment on travaille
  • Daily DE + weekly Data pour partager les avancées et débloquer vite.
  • Décisions d'architecture co-construites et documentées, code review systématique, amélioration continue.
  • Full remote pour les DE — l'équipe est distribuée, on sait travailler ensemble à distance.
  • Une semaine par trimestre à Lyon avec toute l'équipe Data pour les sujets de fond et les moments humains.
  • L'IA est un outil de travail quotidien : Claude Code, consignes par repo, marketplace interne de skills. La relecture humaine reste obligatoire — on utilise l'IA avec exigence.
  • Contribution open source : on publie des connecteurs Airbyte.

    • ⭐ Notre stack
    • GCP : BigQuery, GCS, Pub/Sub, Cloud Run, Cloud SQL, Composer, GKE, Looker
    • Ingestion : Airbyte self-hosted (CDC PostgreSQL et SQL Server), GCS Avro → tables externes BigQuery
    • Transformation & qualité : dbt, Elementary
    • IaC & CI/CD : Terraform, Cloud Build, GitHub Actions
    • Langages : Python, SQL, Docker
    • IA : Claude Code (skills et plugins internes), serveur MCP interne

    🎯 Le profil qu'on cherche

    Indispensable

    • 5 ans d'expérience minimum en Data Engineering sur un Cloud Provider majeur, avec la responsabilité de maintenir des systèmes en production.
    • SQL confirmé + modèles dbt complexes (matérialisation incrémentale, snapshots, macros) que tu sais debugger (doublons, données tardives, suppressions, changement de schéma) et optimiser (durée, coût).
    • Expérience solide en ingestion et orchestration de pipelines : debugging, dérive de schéma, reprise, backfill, analyse d'impacts.
    • Python de qualité, testé et maîtrisé — maintenabilité et fiabilité au cœur de ta pratique.
    • Infrastructure as Code et CI/CD au quotidien.
    • Tu travailles avec un Coding Agent et tu sais prendre du recul pour vérifier ce qu'il produit.
    • Tu es force de proposition, rigoureux·se, humble, et tu aimes transmettre : partager tes découvertes, expliquer tes choix aux équipes techniques comme métier, faire progresser tes collègues.
    • Tu es à l'aise en équipe partiellement full-remote.
    • Anglais B2 minimum.

      • Un gros plus

      • Expérience sur une couche sémantique (dbt Semantic Layer / MetricFlow, LookML), sur le Knowledge Catalog GCP (ex-Dataplex) ou équivalent, ou plus largement sur la gouvernance de données : cataloging, lineage, classification, policy tags, ownership.
      • Traitements en architecture événementielle et leurs spécificités (Pub/Sub, Cloud Run, scaling, rejets, retries).

        • Un plus

        • Expérience GCP : BigQuery et son modèle de compute via réservations de slots, Composer, Cloud Run, GKE / Helm.
        • Tu as construit des tools pour agents IA (serveur MCP, skills).
        • Intégrations dans des outils métier (HubSpot, Gainsight, Intercom).
        • Pipelines data en Change Data Capture.
        • Contribution à l'écosystème Airbyte.

    🎁 Ce qu'on offre
    • Un rôle au cœur d'une AI-first scale-up fintech FT120, €145M levés, 8 000+ clients, 6 pays.

jobs.title: Senior Sourcing Specialist
jobs.description:
Join the Wingtra team and become part of this venture-backed robotics scaleup with a global and international team of 125+ dedicated Wingtranauts who want to see their actions have a positive and lasting impact on the world. Founded more than 8 years ago at ETH Zurich, Europe’s leading robotics university, our goal is to build the best aerial robots to digitize the world at the push of a button and set the basis for faster and better decisions. Wingtra provides efficient and reliable data solutions to a variety of industries ranging from mining, construction and agriculture to humanitarian organizations, environmentalists and wildlife monitoring groups.

We are reaching for the stars and together we might just get there. Open communication, asking hard questions and valuing diverse viewpoints are but a few things that will help us achieve our goals. Above all we will never stop learning and striving to help each other reach our maximum potential.

Responsibilities
  • Plan your sourcing. You take the bill of materials and build a sourcing plan for each commodity. You weigh criticality, lead time and single or dual source options.
  • Find the right suppliers. You run market scans, requests for information and requests for quote. Then you shortlist the suppliers worth a closer look.
  • Judge capability together. You work with R&D, Production, Finance and Compliance to build one clear view of what each supplier can do.
  • Negotiate the deal. You agree pricing, volume tiers, tooling and payment terms. You also set up the NDAs, supply agreements and long-term agreements that back them.
  • Set suppliers up properly. You onboard new suppliers and keep vendor data, price breaks and lead times current in our ERP system.
  • Lead supplier qualification. You coordinate our tiered qualification process, including quality agreements and first-article inspections.
  • Audit on site and remotely. You check suppliers for quality management, traceability and compliance. You also screen them against trade compliance requirements.
  • Keep builds moving. You place and expedite orders for prototype, validation, pilot and pre-series builds. You track supplier performance on delivery, price and quality.
  • Bring costs down. You work with suppliers on cost reduction, using should-cost and landed-cost models.
  • Grow our supplier base. You qualify suppliers for additional production sites and regions, reusing existing qualification records.
  • Make it repeatable. You document sourcing processes, templates and playbooks, so the purchasing team can take over mature suppliers.

    • Requirements
  • You have 6+ years in sourcing, purchasing or new product introduction for hardware products, across a variety of product types, complexities and technologies.
  • You can read technical drawings and specifications, and you work closely with engineers.
  • You’re willing to travel regularly, including international trips of several days.
  • You’ve audited suppliers hands-on or worked within a quality management system such as ISO 9001.
  • You have working knowledge of trade compliance rules.
  • You’ve used an ERP system for purchasing and vendor data.
  • You have a qualification in engineering, supply chain, business or a related field.
  • You communicate excellently in English and build good working relationships with colleagues and suppliers.

    • Plus
  • Experience in aerospace, drones or other safety-critical products
  • Experience sourcing custom electromechanical parts such as plastic parts, motors, batteries and avionics
  • Experience qualifying suppliers for production in more than one region
  • Experience with supplier scorecards and performance reporting

jobs.title: Senior Technical Accountant
jobs.description:
Our Story
 
Hello there. We’re Zopa.
 
We started our journey back in 2005, building the first ever peer-to-peer lending company. Fast forward to 2020 and we launched Zopa Bank. A bank that listens to what our customers don’t like about finance and does the opposite. We’re redefining what it feels like to work in finance. Our vision for a new era of banking puts people front and centre — we’ve built a business that empowers everyone to aim high, every day, to move finance forward. Find out more about our fantastic offerings at Zopa.com! 
 
We’re incredibly proud of our achievements and none of it would be possible without the amazing team here. It’s not just industry awards we’re winning, we’ve also been named in the top three UK’s Most Loved Workplaces. 
 
If you embrace unconventional challenges, are unafraid to think differently and are driven to make an outsized impact, you’ll thrive here at Zopa, so join us, and make it count. Want to see us in action? Follow us on Instagram @zopalife

We are looking for a Senior Technical Accountant to join our growing Finance function, reporting to the Head of Technical Accounting. You’ll provide technical accounting support for ongoing business activities, new products and other initiatives, and play a key part in the Technical Accounting team’s work, from accounting policy assessments to horizon scanning, audit engagement and the annual report. Strong stakeholder management is key to this role. 

The demands on the Finance team are high as Zopa grows at pace, so you’ll need to build effective and influential relationships within Finance and the wider business. Our team are self-starting problem solvers who are agile and thrive on bringing past experiences and networks to a diverse range of challenges. You’ll be part of an impressive Zopa team, who are super collaborative and happy to roll their sleeves up and get involved in whatever needs doing to achieve their goals. 


A day in the life

  • Carry out technical accounting assessments for new transactions, products, significant contracts and other business initiatives, and draft clear accounting papers and memos. 

  • Play a key part in the Technical Accounting team’s ownership of the annual report and accounts, drafting parts of the report and coordinating other sections written by teams across Finance and the wider business, and helping to bring them together into the final report. 

  • Manage stakeholders effectively and work well with other Zopa teams, including Product, Legal, Treasury and Risk, building strong, influential relationships and giving clear, practical technical accounting advice. 

  • Support the development, implementation and upkeep of accounting policies and the accounting manual and give practical guidance on how policies should be applied across the business. 

  • Help put new accounting treatments into practice: make sure finance systems and processes are set up to support new activities, embed them into business-as-usual (BAU) processes and hand them over to the BAU teams. 

  • Support the technical accounting for balance sheet activity, including SPPI testing and hedge accounting assessments and documentation under IAS 39 and IFRS 9. 

  • Support the timely and accurate delivery of month-end reporting where needed. 

  • Work directly with the external auditors on accounting policy and technical accounting matters, answering queries and providing evidence and papers. 

  • Carry out horizon scanning of new and proposed legislation, regulation and accounting standards that affect financial and corporate reporting, prepare impact assessments, and highlight high-impact or high-risk changes. 

  • Help shape and deliver our work to automate the production of the annual report, an area where this role will be fundamental. 

  • Look for ways to use AI and automation to improve technical accounting, policy and reporting processes, and put them into practice. 

  • Keep up to date with developments in financial and corporate reporting. 


About you:

  • Qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA or equivalent) with relevant post-qualification experience. 

  • Experience of working in the financial services sector (ideally banking or consumer finance), or trained at a top six accountancy firm with financial services experience in a technical accounting role. 

  • Solid working knowledge of IFRS and how it applies to financial services products and transactions. 

  • Clear written communication, with experience of drafting technical accounting papers or memos and explaining complex accounting to non-accountants. 

  • A questioning mindset, and the ability to drive change to systems and processes to improve efficiency. 

  • A team player and problem solver. You’ll show great initiative to listen, analyse, research, investigate and provide solutions to problems relating to financial accounting and reporting. 

  • Comfortable managing several pieces of work at once in a fast-moving environment, and building trusted relationships with stakeholders at all levels.

jobs.title: Senior iOS Developer (Remote)
jobs.description:
About Finom
 
Finom is a European tech startup headquartered in Amsterdam, and we’re on a journey towards revolutionizing the financial landscape for entrepreneurs worldwide. Our mission is to develop an all-in-one financial B2B solution that integrates banking functions, accounting, financial management, and invoicing into a seamless, mobile-first platform.
 
We recently closed a €115 million Series C equity round (around $133 million), bringing our total funding to approximately $346 million. This significant investment follows a $105 million growth funding round from General Catalyst, a long-term backer since 2021 known for supporting companies like Airbnb, HubSpot, KAYAK, and Stripe.
 
Finom's platform goes beyond traditional banking, offering invoicing and a growing suite of features, including AI-enabled accounting, aiming to simplify financial management for entrepreneurs. We're actively expanding our reach across key EU markets like Germany, France, the Netherlands, Italy, and Spain.
 
At Finom, we’re not just redefining the entrepreneurial experience — we’re empowering our employees to make a real difference. Your work matters, and your impact extends far beyond product metrics. We nurture innovation and an inspiring work environment where bold ideas thrive, prioritizing thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and our business as a whole.
 
Maintaining our start-up spirit, we prioritize thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and, of course, our business.

The Role

For hundreds of thousands of European entrepreneurs, our iOS app is Finom. It's how they check their cash flow over morning coffee, approve a payment between client meetings, and freeze a card the moment something looks off. We're mobile-first by conviction, not convenience — the app isn't a companion to the "real" product; it is the product. And as an AI-native platform, the features you build increasingly carry intelligence inside them: AI-powered accounting, smart categorization, and agentic workflows that quietly save business owners hours every week. When you ship something great, someone somewhere feels it the same day.

That's why we're not looking for someone to implement tickets. We're looking for a Senior Mobile (iOS) Engineer who thinks like a product builder — someone who cares deeply about the "why" behind what they're building, challenges assumptions when needed, and proactively spots opportunities to create better outcomes.

You'll be embedded in a cross-functional domain team — Backend, Mobile, ML/AI, QA, Design, and Product — that owns a shared product area end-to-end. No handoff culture, no "not my layer": everyone in the team is solving the same customer problem, and you'll shape solutions from the first product conversation to the moment the feature is live in users' hands. Fewer silos means more flow — and real, end-to-end ownership.

How We Build

Agentic development is table stakes at Finom — for every craft, mobile included. Our engineers work with Claude Code and similar harnesses daily, and we've made it a first-class part of how the company operates, not an individual productivity hack. We follow a shared SDLC approach built around Spec-Driven Development (SDD): features start as clear, reviewable specs that both humans and AI agents execute against, powered by a shared AI development toolbelt and a growing library of skills, rules, and context maintained across guilds. You won't be figuring out AI-assisted development alone — you'll join an engineering organization that has already invested in the infrastructure, standards, and shared practices, and you'll be expected to use them, improve them, and raise the bar for others.


What You'll Do

What You'll Do

  • Design and build new features for our iOS application, used daily by business owners across Europe: multi-account cash flow management, banking transactions and payments, physical and virtual card issuance and control, and AI-powered accounting automation.

  • Own outcomes, not just code. You'll follow your features into analytics, jump into customer issues without being prompted, and care about whether what you shipped actually moved the needle.

  • Build polished, responsive UIs with UIKit and SwiftUI — in a financial app, trust is built (or lost) in the details.

  • Drive technical decisions within your domain, discuss trade-offs openly with product managers, and explain constraints clearly to non-technical stakeholders.

  • Raise the bar on engineering quality — automated testing, thorough code reviews, and mobile security best practices are non-negotiable in a regulated fintech.

  • Mentor the engineers around you and contribute to CI/CD pipelines, tooling, and mobile best practices across the team.

    •  


Who You Are

Who You Are

You're pragmatic, learn quickly, and have a proven track record of shipping products that matter. Above all, you're curious — about the product, the users, the business, and how your technical decisions impact all three.

Curiosity. You want to understand the "why" behind every feature. You ask what problem it solves, question whether there's a simpler path, and explore how your decisions ripple into product, users, and revenue.

Business acumen. You connect your work to company objectives. You understand the "so what" behind every decision, and you'd rather ship the feature that moves the right metric than the one that's merely interesting to build.

Communication. You communicate clearly and concisely in English across technical and non-technical audiences — from fellow engineers to PMs to business stakeholders — and you genuinely enjoy the dynamics of a cross-functional team.

T-shapedness. Your iOS craft runs deep, but your curiosity runs wide. You'll peek at the backend contracts, ask questions about the ML models, and dive into analytics to understand how your features perform.

Ownership. You take responsibility not just for your code, but for the outcomes. You move without being prompted — whether that's improving team processes, jumping on a production issue, or mentoring a colleague.

Your Experience Includes

  • 5+ years of commercial iOS development with strong knowledge of Swift.

  • Deep understanding of OOP, SOLID principles, and design patterns.

  • Practical experience with the VIPER architectural pattern and the Coordinator navigation pattern — and the judgment to know when a simpler approach serves the product better.

  • Excellent knowledge of UIKit and experience (or a strong desire to grow) with SwiftUI.

  • Experience with layout development in code, particularly using SnapKit or similar tools.

  • Ability to write unit and UI tests.

  • Confidence with Git / GitLab, including setting up and maintaining GitLab CI/CD.

  • Hands-on experience with agentic development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or similar) as part of your daily workflow — writing prompts, configuring rules and skills, and critically evaluating AI-generated output with tests, linters, and review. This is table stakes for all engineering crafts at Finom, mobile included.

  • A builder's mentality: you care deeply about shipping great products, not just writing great code.


Nice to Have

Nice to Have

  • Background in fintech or financial products — you understand the stakes of working in a regulated environment.

  • Solid grasp of mobile security best practices (especially critical in our domain).

  • Experience profiling and optimizing UI performance — reducing rendering bottlenecks and hitting smooth 60/120fps on iOS.

  • Hands-on work with performance tooling: Instruments, XCTest, or similar.

  • Published apps on the App Store you're proud of.

  • An active GitHub profile with code you're happy to share.

  • Deeper agentic engineering experience beyond daily tool use — setting up agent environments and harnesses, authoring reusable skills and behavioral rules, or contributing to a team's shared AI development practices.

  • Understanding of model capabilities and limitations — knowing which model fits which task and how to manage the context window effectively.

  • Awareness of AI security risks — prompt injection, data leakage, and safe handling of untrusted inputs in agentic workflows.

Recruitment Flow
  • Recruiter Interview
  • First Technical Interview
  • Coding / AI assisted coding interview
  • Mobile System Design Interview
  • Team Fit Interview (peer interview)
  • Offer

What You Will Get In Return
 
Make a genuine impact on the product
 
Join our upward trajectory, and grow with us. We provide the resources and opportunities for continuous personal and professional development, empowering you to make a genuine impact on our evolving product.
 
Work in the EU
 
Embark on this exciting journey with us and enjoy the flexibility of traveling and working remotely or in a hybrid model across Europe.
 
Become a stock options holder
 
Unlock your inner entrepreneur and align your aspirations with ours through our Stock Options Program. This exciting opportunity is available to every team member, from junior team members to our founders.
 
Receive unwavering support and care
 
Finom stands by you at every step, embodying our commitment to your well-being and success reflected in our modern, friendly, and eco-conscious corporate culture. We offer constant support and care to ensure your Finom experience is successful and fulfilling.
 
Work & Swim program
 
Immerse yourself in our exclusive Work & Swim Program. Spend one month in a comfortable corporate apartment in enchanting Cyprus. It's the ideal opportunity to strike the perfect work-life balance while enjoying breathtaking Mediterranean views.
 
Equal Opportunity Statement 
 
At Finom, we're an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We embrace diversity and invite applications from all walks of life. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability status, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

jobs.title: Front & Service Manager – Live Lofoten Hotel, Stamsund
jobs.description:
Front & Service Manager – Live Lofoten

Stamsund, Lofoten, Norway

Do you enjoy creating great guest experiences – and turning local relationships into new business?

Live Lofoten AS is looking for an outgoing, structured and commercially minded Front & Service Manager to join our team in Stamsund.

Hva vi ser etter Who Are You?

We are looking for someone who genuinely enjoys working with people.

You are positive, approachable and professional, and you understand how excellent service can create both loyal guests and new business.

You are comfortable taking initiative and contacting potential customers rather than simply waiting for enquiries to arrive.

We believe you have:

  • Experience from hospitality, tourism, sales, customer service or similar

  • A strong service mindset

  • An interest in sales and business development

  • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills

  • A structured and independent working style

  • The ability to manage several tasks and priorities simultaneously

  • Good digital skills and the ability to learn booking and hotel systems

  • Good Norwegian and English communication skills, both written and spoken

  • Knowledge of Lofoten and the regional business market is an advantage

Previous hotel experience is valuable, but your personality, commercial mindset and ability to create relationships are equally important.

Arbeidsoppgaver The Role

As Front & Service Manager, you will have an important role in the daily operation of Live Lofoten and will be one of the key contact points for our guests and customers.

You will work closely with the Operational Manager and the rest of the hotel team to ensure excellent communication between bookings, reception, restaurant, housekeeping and activities.

An important part of the position will also be to actively develop sales towards the Norwegian market, particularly in Lofoten and Northern Norway.

The role combines operations and sales -- you should be equally comfortable welcoming guests at the Front Office as you are contacting a local company about their next meeting, dinner, event or overnight stay.

Key Responsibilities

  • Daily Front Office operations and guest service

  • Handling enquiries, reservations, check-in and check-out

  • Follow-up of individual guests, groups and corporate customers

  • Ensure professional guest communication before, during and after their stay

  • Coordinate bookings and guest information with F&B, Housekeeping and other departments

  • Maintain a high standard of service throughout the guest journey

  • Handle guest feedback and contribute to continuous service improvement

  • Actively sell hotel accommodation, restaurant services, meetings, events and experiences

  • Develop business from the Norwegian local and regional market

  • Build and maintain relationships with local companies, organisations and partners

  • Follow up existing customers and identify new business opportunities

  • Participate in local sales activities, customer visits and networking

  • Develop offers and packages for companies, meetings, celebrations and local events

  • Follow up enquiries and convert them into confirmed business

  • Support group bookings and event planning

  • Contribute to increased activity and revenue during periods with lower occupancy

  • Ensure good internal communication and information flow

  • Work closely with the Operational Manager on sales priorities and operational planning

Local Sales -- A Key Part of the Position

One of your most important responsibilities will be to strengthen Live Lofoten's presence in the Norwegian market, with particular focus on Lofoten and the surrounding region.

We want more local and regional customers to see Live Lofoten as a natural choice for:

Meetings -- Conferences -- Company Gatherings -- Accommodation -- Group Dinners -- Christmas Parties -- Celebrations -- Events -- Activities and Experiences

You will actively build relationships with businesses and organisations and help create attractive products and packages based on what the market needs.

This is therefore not only a Front Office position. Sales and relationship building are an important part of the role.

Vi tilbyr What We Offer

At Live Lofoten, you will become part of a hospitality business with ambitions to grow both locally and internationally.

We offer:

  • A varied position combining Front Office, service and sales

  • The opportunity to influence how we develop the Norwegian market

  • Responsibility and freedom to develop new customer relationships

  • Close cooperation with hotel management and operational departments

  • A workplace where ideas and initiative can quickly become new products and business

  • Competitive terms based on qualifications and experience

  • The opportunity to live and work in beautiful Lofoten

Become Part of Live Lofoten

We are looking for someone who sees opportunities and enjoys making things happen.

Someone who can welcome a guest in the morning, coordinate an upcoming group during the day and meet a potential corporate customer in the afternoon.

If you enjoy the combination of people, hospitality, sales and creating new business, we would like to hear from you.

Join Live Lofoten and help us create great experiences -- for both our guests and our local community.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Live Lofoten is located in the heart of Lofoten and offers accommodation, restaurant services, and activities. Our main focus is on groups, tour operators, conferences, and private events, where we aim to provide high-quality food and memorable experiences for our guests.

Ready for Lofoten?

We are looking for someone who wants more than another management position.

We want a leader who is motivated by building a strong team, creating great guest experiences and developing a profitable hospitality business.

If that sounds like you, we would be very interested in hearing from you.

Join Live Lofoten and help us shape the next chapter of our hotel in Stamsund.

jobs.description:
Description de tâches:


Job Title:  Manager for our Accounting & Reporting Advisory department

Company:  Deloitte Audit
Job Function:  Audit & Assurance
Level of Experience:  Experienced
Contract Type:  Open-term

Job Description:


Your future team:

The Accounting & Reporting Advisory (ARA) group is a dedicated team of IFRS, US GAAP and LUX GAAP experts that seek to use accounting standards constructively and positively to help clients on complex accounting matters – be it providing expert input and challenge to transactions or providing the assurance that their IFRS, Lux GAAP or US GAAP reporting will stand up to scrutiny.
ARA is a client-facing group that is accustomed to being the expert in the room. ARA is also in charge of dealing with accounting consultations received from the engagement teams of Deloitte. The ARA team members are experts in accounting standards and their practical application to address the challenges faced by clients in different industries.


Your contribution to our success:

The role requires both strong technical and business development capabilities. As a Manager in ARA, you will take ownership of complex client engagements and play a key role in developing the team:

Lead and manage advisory engagements - covering new standards implementation, conversion from one GAAP to another, structured transactions, accounting policy reviews and financial statement reviews - from scoping and planning through delivery and quality review, including presentation of findings and recommendations to senior client management.
Drive the development of the practice by acting as a dynamic “motor” within the team: proactively shaping our service offering, contributing to the growth of the ARA brand and supporting the implementation of our strategic initiatives.
Contribute to business development by building and maintaining client relationships, identifying follow-on opportunities within existing engagements, preparing proposals and contributing to eminence-building initiatives such as internal guidance, technical notes, training sessions and client presentations.
Manage, coach and develop team members, providing on-the-job training, constructive feedback and helping to build a strong technical and client-facing skillset across the team.
Act as the subject matter contact for audit teams and clients on complex accounting transactions, consolidation challenges and financial reporting matters.
Review and challenge technical analysis prepared by senior and junior staff, ensuring robust conclusions and high-quality deliverables under IFRS, Lux GAAP and US GAAP.
Deliver seamless, joined-up expert input alongside other Deloitte teams (e.g. tax, consulting) and proactively identify opportunities for cross-service offerings.


Your skills:

6+ years' experience with IFRS and/or Lux GAAP and/or US GAAP in professional services or corporate accounting policy, ideally in the financial or commercial sector; exposure to consolidated financial statements and complex group structures is a plus.  
Proven ability to lead and review complex IFRS/US GAAP (and preferably Lux GAAP) accounting matters, including drafting and assessing technical memorandums and client deliverables.  
Track record in managing projects and teams: planning engagements, monitoring budgets and timelines, coordinating multidisciplinary teams, and ensuring high-quality client service.  
Strong business acumen and advisory skills, connecting accounting implications to commercial and strategic considerations and identifying value-creation opportunities.  
Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, able to explain complex technical issues to diverse stakeholders and build trusted relationships.  
Chartered Accountant qualification (IRE, DEC, IRE Belge, ACCA, US CPA or equivalent) and commitment to ongoing professional development.  
Fluency in English; French, German or Luxembourgish are an asset.  
Solid understanding of financial or commercial industries and related regulation, plus strong skills in Microsoft Office, analytics tools, and effective use of AI to improve efficiency and deliverable quality.


Interested? Please submit your resume in English.

Risk Officer - UCITS (m/f)

Fundsight is looking for a Risk Officer to join its UCITS Risk Management team.
In this role, you will be responsible for managing the risk management framework for a portfolio of UCITS clients.

Your role

• Assist the UCITS Risk Management team with the implementation and ongoing enhancement of the risk management framework.
• Prepare periodic risk reports on a daily, weekly and monthly basis.
• Perform risk assessments for existing and new UCITS, determine their risk profiles and monitor applicable risk limits, including market risk (commitment and VaR), credit risk, liquidity risk, counterparty risk and operational risk indicators (including TER, PTR and NAV errors).
• Contribute to the integration and monitoring of sustainability risks, including ESG, SFDR and EU Taxonomy considerations, within the risk management process.
• Support the Head of Risk Management on a range of risk management matters.
• Review the existing risk management framework against regulatory and internal requirements, in close cooperation with other departments.
• Monitor UCITS liquidity and analyse the results of liquidity stress tests.
• Provide regular updates to the Head of Risk Management and the relevant governing bodies.

Your skills and experience

• Master's degree in economics, finance, mathematics or a related field.
• At least 2 years of previous experience in risk management, control and/or audit functions.
• Good knowledge and understanding of the Luxembourg investment fund industry and the UCITS regulatory framework.
• Ability to work independently, take initiative and manage priorities effectively.
• Fluency in English; proficiency in French or Italian would be an asset.

Who we are

FundSight is an independent third-party Management Company (ManCo) based in Luxembourg, regulated by the CSSF and holding a dual AIFM and UCITS license as well as a MiFID authorization. Its business has been licensed since 1971 and was carved out and wholly acquired (100%) by BlackFin in 2025; FundSight has since been an independent company, with no operational or capital ties to Lemanik. It has a center of excellence in Porto, a branch in Paris, and representative offices in Hong Kong and Tokyo. The Group is also established in New York and Atlanta. FundSight today supports more than 120 institutional clients and manages more than €40 billion in assets under management. For more information: www.fundsight.com.

How to apply

If you are interested in this opportunity and would like to develop your career in a young, dynamic and international environment, please submit your cover letter and detailed CV in English.
All applications will be treated in the strictest confidence.

Before the employment agreement is signed, a copy of an official criminal record certificate (Bulletin No. 3), issued within the previous two months, must be provided for review.

jobs.description:
a.s.b.l. est une association luxembourgeoise forte de ses 38 ans d'engagement dans le secteur social luxembourgeois. Vous aimez relever des défis, résoudre des problématiques complexes et mettre votre expertise au service de résultats concrets ?Nous vous proposons de prendre la responsabilité d'un périmètre Administration du Personnel & Paie stratégique, opérationnel et en pleine évolution, au sein d'une organisation de plus de 750 collaborateurs. Vos responsabilités :Rattaché(e) à la Direction, vous pilotez l'ensemble des activités d'administration du personnel et de paie, de l'entrée à la sortie des collaborateurs, en garantissant la fiabilité, la conformité et l'efficacité des processus.Véritable référent(e) technique et opérationnel(le), vous conjuguez expertise métier, management et capacité d'intervention sur les dossiers complexes ou sensibles.Vous accompagnez votre équipe, conseillez les responsables et contribuez activement à la sécurisation et à l'évolution des pratiques RH.

Vos missions :

1. Superviser l'administration du personnel

• Superviser les contrats, avenants, visites médicales, affiliations/désaffiliations et la tenue des dossiers collaborateurs ;
• Garantir le suivi des absences, congés, incapacités de travail et autres événements administratifs ;

• Prendre en charge ou accompagner l'équipe dans les dossiers administratifs complexes nécessitant une expertise approfondie.

• Superviser le processus de paie, garantir son exactitude et le respect des échéances ;
• Contrôler les éléments fixes et variables : temps de travail, absences, primes, indemnités, avantages, heures supplémentaires, entrées/sorties, etc. ;

• Sécuriser les pratiques et alerter la direction en cas de risque ou de non-conformité.

• Développer l'autonomie, l'expertise et la polyvalence de l'équipe, tout en favorisant le partage des connaissances ;
• Assurer un rôle de référent technique et apporter un soutien dans la gestion des situations complexes ;

• Rigueur, capacité d'analyse, organisation et respect des échéances ;

Nous vous offrons

C'est d'abord offrir une qualité de service irréprochable à nos clients. Sales Lentz est une entreprise familiale, fondée en 1948, qui ne cesse de grandir et d'innover. Notre objectif se résume en quelques mots: simplifier la mobilité pour tous.

jobs.employer: Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology - LIST E.P.
jobs.description:
Description:

RESEARCH ENGINEER IN ATMOSPHERIC PRESSURE PLASMA DEPOSITION OF FUNCTIONAL COATINGS

Fixed term contract | Belval | 24 Months

Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us
The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a leading Research and Technology Organisation (RTO) that drives innovation for the economy and society in Luxembourg and beyond. With cutting-edge expertise in Natural, Built, Industrial environments, Space, AI, Security and defence technologies. LIST bridges scientific excellence and applied research to design solutions that address real-world challenges and create positive impact.
Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/

How will you contribute?

• Within European collaborative research and innovation projects, the Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is seeking a Research Engineer in Atmospheric-Pressure Plasma Deposition of Functional Coatings. Working with universities, research institutes, and industrial partners across Europe, you will help develop high-performance, multifunctional materials and surfaces for applications ranging from fluid-dynamic surfaces to textile finishing. Your mission and contributions are:
• To conduct applied research work on atmospheric pressure plasma deposition of functional materials.
• To optimise atmospheric-pressure plasma deposition processes for functional coatings (e.g. barrier, hydrophobic, antimicrobial, or protective layers) on textured, porous, or flexible substrates.
• To scale up and transfer processes from laboratory to pilot level, including continuous (e.g. roll-to-roll) configurations, in close collaboration with industrial partners.
• To characterize the deposited materials using various surface analytical techniques, together with functional performance testing adapted to project requirements.
• To contribute to the preparation of scientific reports, publications, and presentations.

Is Your profile described below? Are you our future colleague? Apply now!

Education

A PhD (or equivalent experience) in materials science, plasma science, chemistry, or on textile science and technology, with a strong focus on finishing/functionalization.

Experience and skills

• 3 to 5 years of proven experience in an international R&D environment (public or private sector).
• Demonstrated experience in atmospheric-pressure plasma deposition (e.g. DBD, plasma jets, plasma-enhanced CVD, plasma polymerisation, aerosol-assisted plasma deposition), including reactor setup, pilot or semi-pilot operation, and process implementation for functional thin films and coatings.
• Ability to evaluate and optimise key process parameters, including power and frequency, gas composition and flow, precursor delivery (vapour or aerosol), electrode gap, and substrate temperature and speed.
• Proven autonomy in surface characterization techniques, such as SEM, AFM, XPS, FTIR, ellipsometry, contact angle measurements, and functional performance testing.
• Strong awareness of laboratory and process safety, including high-voltage and RF equipment, handling reactive precursors, and management of by-products.
• You are committed to a strong data security and confidentiality, with experience in handling sensitive information according to consortium agreements.
• You have ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced international consortium environment.

Language skills

• Fluency in English, both oral and written.
• Other relevant languages are an asset.

Your LIST benefits

• An organization with a passion for impact and strong RDI partnerships in Luxembourg and Europe that works on responsible and independent research projects
• Sustainable by design, empowering our belief that we play an essential role in paving the way to a green society
• Innovative infrastructures and exceptional labs occupying more than 5,000 square metres, including innovations in all that we do
• An environment encouraging curiosity, innovation and entrepreneurship in all areas
• Personalized learning programme to foster our staff's soft and technical skills
• Multicultural and international work environment with more than 60 nationalities represented in our workforce
• Diverse and inclusive work environment empowering our people to fulfil their personal and professional ambitions
• Gender-friendly environment with multiple actions to attract, develop and retain women in science
• 32 days' paid annual leave, 11 public holidays, 13-month salary, statutory health insurance
• Flexible working hours, home working policy (not remote) and access to Digital lunch vouchers

Apply online

Your application must include:

•          A motivation letter oriented towards the position and detailing your experience
•          A scientific CV with contact details
•          List of publications (and patents, if applicable)
•          Contact details of 2 references

Please apply ONLINE formally through the HR system. Applications by email will not be considered.

Application procedure and conditions
In accordance with Article L 252-1 of the Luxembourg Labour Code and the requirements of European Defence Agency funding, this position is open exclusively to nationals of the European Union Member States. While we maintain a commitment to equal opportunities and non-discrimination, this restriction applies due to the defence and strategic nature of this EDA-funded research initiative.

We kindly request applicants to provide their nationality for statistical purposes only, as part of our commitment to promoting diversity and ensuring equal opportunities in our workforce. This information will be kept confidential and will not be used for any discriminatory purposes.
LIST is dedicated to maintaining an inclusive work environment and is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to attracting, hiring, and retaining a diverse workforce. All applicants will be considered for employment without discrimination based on national origin (knowing the EDA constraints), race, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, religion, age, or disability.
Applications will be continuously reviewed until the position is filled. An assessment committee will thoroughly evaluate applications, adhering to guidelines designed to ensure equal opportunities. The primary criteria for selection will be the alignment of the applicant's existing skills and expertise with the requirements mentioned above.

As part of our recruitment process, the selected candidate might be subject to a background check in accordance with applicable laws and institutional policies. Further checks and restrictions might apply to candidates in compliance with export controls requirements
For the purposes of the position and in accordance with applicable legislation, the successful candidate may be requested to provide a recent criminal record certificate.

This position offers a gross monthly salary between €6094 and €6678, paid over 13 months (€79.222–€86.814 annually) based on full time employment. The final salary offer within this range will be determined based on the candidate's overall profile, qualifications and professional experience.
For part time employment, the salary is adjusted pro rata.

BIL is a leading player in Luxembourg's financial market. Founded in 1856 as the country's first bank, BIL has contributed significantly to the development of Luxembourg's social and economic landscape. Today, BIL operates across digital banking, wealth management and corporate finance, supporting individuals, entrepreneurs, businesses, and both private and institutional investors. Headquartered in Luxembourg, BIL employs more than 1,800 people and maintains a presence in key financial centers including Luxembourg, Switzerland, France and China. As a major player in Luxembourg's finance industry and as a signatory of the UN Principles of Responsible Banking, BIL is committed to handing over a responsible and sustainable bank to future generations.

In its capacity as Depositary bank for Alternative Investment Funds (AIFs), Banque Internationale à Luxembourg SA (BIL) provides investor protection, through overseeing the general administration of the funds, the safekeeping of the fund's assets, the ownership verification and record keeping of other assets as well as the monitoring of the cash flows. Your role is to ensure that all depositary duties and obligations are performed in accordance with the applicable regulation.

Your next challenge:

• As part of the AIF Depositary team you will be responsible for safekeeping and verifying the ownership of the AIFs assets, monitor cash flow activities and perform oversight controls.
• You will need to ensure that the procedures and controls comply with the applicable laws and keep up to date with legislation, professional standards and regulatory changes.
• You will perform due diligences on fund service providers and be involved in on-site inspections.
• Attending periodic client service meetings will also be part of your activities.
• You will maintain and enhance depositary procedures, review programs and checklists.

Your Profile:

• Minimum 7 years of experience within the banking and financial services industry, including significant exposure to the Luxembourg fund industry.
• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Business Administration, Audit, Law, or a related field.
• Fluent in English, both written and spoken. French and/or German would be considered a strong asset. Any additional language will be viewed favourably.

You possess excellent knowledge of:

• AIFMD and the Luxembourg regulatory framework applicable to investment funds.
• The role and responsibilities of a Depositary Bank.
• Alternative asset classes, including Private Equity, Private Debt, Real Estate and Infrastructure.
• Operational risk assessment, monitoring and process enhancement.
• The key drivers, developments and trends shaping the European fund industry.

You have a strong understanding of:

• Banking organisations, operational workflows and risk management frameworks.
• Financial products and services, including cash and treasury management, securities services, financing and capital markets solutions.
• Microsoft Office applications.

The following would be considered a strong asset:

• Experience within an AIF Depositary function, particularly in investment restriction controls.
• Professional certifications in audit, internal control and/or risk management.

Personal competencies:

• Strong team player with an entrepreneurial mindset and a collaborative, supportive attitude.
• Excellent presentation, interpersonal and communication skills, both written and verbal.
• Strong analytical capabilities combined with conceptual and strategic thinking.
• Well-organised and results-driven, with the ability to deliver high-quality work within deadlines and effectively manage priorities.
• Accurate, flexible and hands-on, with the ability to perform effectively in a fast-paced environment and under tight deadlines.

BIL offers a broad range of challenging projects and a huge choice of career paths .We will assist you in finding the one that best meets your skills and expectations. Your personal development is our priority and we greatly encourage you to dive into different business areas for the broadest possible experience.
BIL is firmly of the opinion that diversity & inclusion contribute towards increasing the collective performance of the Bank. We are committed to creating a culture of inclusion that encourages individual development with equal opportunities for all.

jobs.title: PHD POSITION IN ADVANCED CORRELATIVE MICROSCOPY (m/f)
jobs.employer: Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology - LIST
jobs.description:
Description de tâches:


SD-25168 - PHD POSITION IN ADVANCED CORRELATIVE MICROSCOPY AND ISOTOPIC IMAGING FOR NEXT-GENERATION LI-ION BATTERIES

Fixed term contract | Belvaux | up to 48 months (14 months initial contract)

Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us.

The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a leading Research and Technology Organisation (RTO) that drives innovation for the economy and society in Luxembourg and beyond. With cutting-edge expertise in Natural, Built, Industrial environments, Space, AI, Security and defence technologies, LIST bridges scientific excellence and applied research to design solutions that address real-world challenges and create positive impact.


How will you contribute?

The PhD project will focus on the development of advanced correlative microscopy and isotopic imaging methodologies to investigate lithium transport and interfacial processes in next-generation silicon-based Li-ion battery electrodes.
The candidate will contribute to the development of high-throughput FIB-SIMS workflows, building on methodologies previously developed at LIST, and will adapt innovative sample preparation strategies to preserve the complex porous structure and fragile Solid Electrolyte Interphase (SEI).
A major objective of the PhD will be to develop and optimize advanced characterization approaches, including cryogenic sample preparation and analysis, protective capping and lift-out strategies, and automated high-resolution isotopic mapping.
The candidate will also contribute to the development of automated acquisition and data-processing workflows, enabling large-area, statistically representative 2D and 3D maps of lithium isotopes and SEI-related species.
These datasets will provide quantitative information on lithium distribution and transport at the nanoscale and serve as inputs for predictive modelling of battery behaviour.
The doctoral researcher will work closely with experienced scientists, engineers and international project partners in a highly interdisciplinary environment combining battery science, nano-analytics, instrumentation, software development and data science.
The position offers the opportunity to gain expertise in cutting-edge FIB-SIMS and correlative microscopy, electrochemical materials characterization, isotopic tracing, automated data analysis and scientific communication.
The candidate will take an active role in designing and performing experiments, developing analytical methodologies, interpreting results, publishing scientific findings and presenting the work at international conferences.

jobs.title: Higher Education & Careers Counsellor full-time (m/f)
jobs.description:
Description de tâches:


Want to help students shape what comes next?

At XXXX, we want every student to leave us with the self-knowledge, skills and confidence to make thoughtful choices about their future.

We are looking for an experienced Higher Education & Careers Counsellor to guide students in Grades 9–12 as they explore universities, careers and other post-secondary pathways around the world. You will help students connect their interests, strengths, values and learning experiences with future possibilities—developing the agency to make choices that are meaningful to them.
Working within our international and IB learning environment, you will help students connect the IB Learner Profile, Approaches to Learning (ATL) skills and their academic and wider experiences with life beyond XXXX. You will also guide students and families in understanding our three pathways: the full IB Diploma Programme, IB Courses and Global Impact Diploma (GID).


What will you do?

You will build trusting relationships with students and families and provide personalised, internationally minded guidance throughout the future-planning process.

• Coach students to reflect on their strengths, interests and aspirations and take ownership of their future choices.
• Deliver a coherent Higher Education & Careers programme across Grades 9–12, including individual and small-group guidance.
• Help students research and evaluate universities and other post-secondary opportunities around the world, alongside vocational education, gap experiences, entrepreneurship and employment.
• Guide students and families through international university admissions, with particular expertise in the US college and university application process.
• Support applications, including essays and personal statements, CVs/résumés, portfolios, interviews, recommendations and deadlines.
• Help students articulate who they are as learners and contributors by connecting their academic learning, IB Learner Profile attributes, ATL skills, CAS and community engagement with their future aspirations.
• Build relationships with universities, admissions professionals, alumni, employers and other partners internationally, and coordinate university fairs, visits and information events.
• Collaborate across the Upper School, including with the IB Diploma Programme and Global Impact Diploma teams, to connect academic choices, experiential learning, wellbeing and future pathways.
• Support relevant university admissions testing and maintain accurate, confidential student records.


What will you bring to XXXX?

Essential

• A Master's degree or equivalent in counselling, education, careers guidance or a relevant field.
• 5–8 years of successful experience in higher education/university counselling.
• Strong knowledge of international higher education and admissions systems and the ability to advise students about universities around the world.
• Experience with the IB Diploma Programme and knowledge of the US college and university application process.
• Strong counselling and coaching skills, with the ability to build trusting relationships with adolescents and families.
• Excellent communication, collaboration, organisation and attention to detail.
• The ability to work effectively within a culturally and linguistically diverse international community.
• Strong digital competence and confidence using higher education and careers platforms.
• Excellent written and spoken English.
• Professional discretion, sound ethical judgement and a strong commitment to safeguarding.


Valued experience

• Within an IB World School and with pathways beyond the full IB Diploma.
• Supporting applications across multiple countries and higher education systems.
• Working with platforms such as Unifrog, UCAS, Common Application and Studielink.
• Coordinating university fairs, admissions events or career-related learning.
• Supporting experiential, service or impact-based programmes such as the Global Impact Diploma.
• Supporting multilingual learners and students with diverse learning needs.
• Using French and/or German.
• Membership or qualifications in higher education, university admissions or careers counselling.


You'll thrive in this role if you...

...are a relationship builder and thoughtful listener who creates space for students to talk openly about their aspirations and uncertainties.
...believe in student agency and use coaching, questioning and reflection to help young people make their own informed decisions.
...are internationally minded, culturally responsive and open-minded, recognising that there is no single pathway or definition of future success.
...are an organised and collaborative professional who can make complex admissions processes understandable while managing multiple priorities and deadlines.
...remain curious and reflective, keeping your knowledge current as higher education, careers and the world of work continue to evolve.


Interested in joining our learning community?

At XXXX, future planning is about more than helping students decide where they will go next. It is about helping them understand who they are, what matters to them and how they can contribute.
As our Higher Education & Careers Counsellor, you will help students explore possibilities, navigate choices and develop the skills and confidence to shape their own futures.
XXXX is committed to safeguarding and prioritising the wellbeing of children and young people and expects all staff to share this commitment.


Recruitment timeline:

• If you are shortlisted, you will receive a notification email to book your interview.
• If you have not been contacted after the video deadline, your application is potentially unsuccessful but, in any case, you will receive an official answer.

jobs.description:
WISSEN. MENSCHEN. ZUKUNFT.

Wir suchen DICH – Pflegepädagoge (m/w/d)!

Weil gute Pflege mit Menschen beginnt, die andere Menschen begeistern.

Du liebst die Pflege, aber Deine Leidenschaft geht über den Pflegealltag hinaus? Du möchtest Wissen vermitteln, Menschen stärken und die Pflege von morgen aktiv mitgestalten?

Dann könnte die KSG genau der Ort sein, an dem Du nicht nur beruflich, sondern auch persönlich etwas bewegen kannst.

Willkommen im Kompetenzzentrum für Sozial- und Gesundheitsberufe in Erftstadt!

Bei uns geht es um mehr als Unterricht, Lehrpläne und Prüfungen.

Es geht um Menschen. Um ihre Geschichten, ihre Talente, ihre Träume und manchmal auch um den Mut, einen ganz neuen Weg einzuschlagen.

Unsere Auszubildenden bringen unterschiedliche Lebenswege, Kulturen und Erfahrungen mit. Was sie verbindet, ist der Wunsch, einen Beruf zu erlernen, in dem sie für andere Menschen da sein können.

Und genau dafür suchen wir Dich!

Eine Persönlichkeit, die nicht nur Fachwissen vermittelt, sondern Begeisterung weckt. Die Potenziale erkennt, Orientierung gibt und jungen Menschen ebenso wie berufserfahrenen Quereinsteigern zeigt, was in ihnen steckt.

Was macht die KSG besonders?

Wir glauben daran, dass gute Bildung dort entsteht, wo Menschen sich gesehen, ernst genommen und ermutigt fühlen.

Deshalb möchten wir einen Arbeitsplatz gestalten, an dem nicht nur unsere Auszubildenden wachsen, sondern auch die Menschen, die sie begleiten.

Bei uns erwarten Dich:

- Mitgestalten statt nur verwalten: Bringe Deine Ideen ein, entwickle kreative Unterrichtskonzepte und gestalte die Pflegeausbildung aktiv mit.
- Unterrichten mit Herz und Verstand: Nutze praxisnahe Fallbeispiele, Simulationen, digitale Lernmethoden und innovative pädagogische Ansätze.
- Ein internationales Lernumfeld: Begleite Menschen unterschiedlicher Herkunft und erlebe, wie bereichernd kulturelle Vielfalt sein kann.
- Ein Team mit kölscher Herzlichkeit: Wir möchten ein Miteinander leben, das von Offenheit, gegenseitiger Unterstützung, Respekt und einer guten Portion Humor geprägt ist.
- Raum für Deine persönliche Entwicklung: Wir freuen uns auf Deine fachlichen Interessen, Deine Erfahrungen und Deine Vorstellungen für die Weiterentwicklung unserer Bildungsangebote.
- Eine Aufgabe mit Sinn: Erlebe, wie aus Unsicherheit Selbstvertrauen wird, aus Wissen berufliche Handlungskompetenz und aus Auszubildenden verantwortungsbewusste Pflegefachpersonen.

Was Du bei uns bewegen kannst

Du gestaltest kompetenzorientierten, lebendigen Unterricht in der generalistischen Pflegeausbildung.

Du begleitest unsere Auszubildenden auf ihrem Weg zu fachlich kompetenten, empathischen und selbstbewussten Pflegefachpersonen.

Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit Deinen Kolleginnen und Kollegen neue Lernideen, arbeitest an der Weiterentwicklung unserer Bildungsangebote mit und bringst Deine pflegepädagogische Expertise ein.

Und vor allem: Du wirst zu einem Menschen, an den sich unsere Auszubildenden auch Jahre später noch gerne erinnern.

Nicht, weil Du ihnen jede Antwort gegeben hast, sondern weil Du sie befähigt hast, eigene Antworten zu finden.

Wen wir uns wünschen

Vielleicht bist Du bereits erfahrene Pflegepädagogin oder erfahrener Pflegepädagoge.

Vielleicht stehst Du nach Deinem Studium gerade am Anfang Deiner Lehrtätigkeit.

Vielleicht möchtest Du nach vielen Jahren in der Pflege Deine Erfahrungen an die nächste Generation weitergeben.

Entscheidend ist für uns nicht allein Dein Lebenslauf, sondern auch die Persönlichkeit dahinter.

Du bringst ein einschlägiges abgeschlossenes Hochschulstudium mit, beispielsweise in der Pflegepädagogik oder Berufspädagogik im Gesundheitswesen, und erfüllst die für Deinen Einsatz geltenden gesetzlichen Qualifikationsanforderungen.

Du hast Freude daran, Wissen verständlich, praxisnah und abwechslungsreich zu vermitteln.

Du begegnest Menschen mit Wertschätzung, Offenheit und Humor.

Du möchtest Verantwortung übernehmen, Deine Ideen einbringen und gemeinsam mit anderen etwas entwickeln.

Und Du bist überzeugt:

Gute Pflege braucht gute Bildung. Gute Bildung braucht Menschen mit Leidenschaft.

Warum solltest Du Dich gerade bei der KSG bewerben?

Weil wir nicht einfach nur eine weitere Lehrkraft suchen.

Wir suchen einen Menschen, der mit uns etwas bewegen möchte.

Jemanden, der Herausforderungen als Chance begreift.

Der neugierig bleibt, auch wenn er selbst unterrichtet.

Der gerne im Team arbeitet, aber auch eigene Ideen entwickelt.

Der fachliche Qualität mit Menschlichkeit verbindet.

Und der am Ende eines Arbeitstages nicht nur fragen möchte: „Was habe ich heute unterrichtet?“, sondern auch:

„Wen habe ich heute ein Stück weitergebracht?“

Denn genau darin liegt für uns der besondere Wert der Pflegepädagogik.

NEUGIERIG GEWORDEN? DANN LERN UNS KENNEN!

Du musst nicht sofort eine perfekte Bewerbung schreiben.

Vielleicht möchtest Du erst einmal wissen, wer wir sind, wie wir arbeiten und ob wir zueinander passen.

Sehr gerne!

Komm vorbei, schau Dir unser Kompetenzzentrum an, lerne unsere Auszubildenden und unser Team kennen und mach Dir selbst ein Bild.

Vielleicht wird aus einem ersten Gespräch schon bald Dein nächster beruflicher Schritt.

Wir freuen uns auf Dich – auf Deine Ideen, Deine Persönlichkeit und Deine Begeisterung für die Pflegebildung!
