jobs.description:
Kom du ikke ind på drømmestudiet - No worries – vi har en plan B klar til dig.

Du tjekkede optagelse.dk, loggede ind, og der stod det: ikke optaget. Surt, ja. Men lige nu har du faktisk flere muligheder, end du tror.

Spørgsmålet er bare: skal efteråret og vinteren gå med at vente på næste ansøgningsrunde – eller skal den bruges på noget, der faktisk rykker dig?

Forestil dig i stedet, at du pakker kufferten og tager til udlandet for at arbejde en periode. Varmere vejr. Nye mennesker. Oplevelser, du kommer til at fortælle om resten af livet.

Men hvad giver det egentlig dig, ud over sol og gode oplevelser?

Et arbejde i udlandet er ikke bare en pause fra hverdagen – det er faktisk noget af det, der skiller dig ud fra alle de andre ansøgere, næste gang du søger ind på studiet (eller søger job).

Det løfter dit CV markant
Arbejdsgivere og optagelsesudvalg elsker at se selvstændighed. At du har boet i et andet land, klaret dig selv, tilpasset dig en ny kultur og et nyt sprog – det viser, at du kan tage ansvar og løse problemer, uden at mor og far står lige bag dig. Det er præcis den type erfaring, der får et CV til at skille sig ud fra bunken.

Du bygger et netværk, der rækker ud over Danmark
Du kommer til at arbejde sammen med mennesker fra hele verden – andre unge i samme situation som dig, lokale kolleger, ledere med international erfaring. Det netværk kan du trække på resten af livet, uanset om det er til fremtidige jobs, praktikpladser eller bare venner, du kan besøge på den anden side af kloden.

Du udvikler kompetencer, du ikke lærer i et klasseværelse
Sprogkundskaber. Kulturel forståelse. Evnen til at begå dig i uvante situationer. Selvstændighed og ansvarlighed. Det er de "bløde" kompetencer, som rigtig mange arbejdsgivere efterspørger – og som er svære at få, hvis du bliver hjemme og venter.

Du finder ud af, hvad du faktisk vil
Mange af dem, vi sender ud, kommer hjem med en helt ny klarhed over, hvad de vil studere – eller opdager, at de brænder for noget helt andet, end de troede. Den erfaring er guld værd, når du skal træffe en beslutning, der påvirker de næste mange år af dit liv.

Kort sagt: den tid, du alligevel skal vente, kan enten gå med at se Netflix og tælle dage – eller den kan blive det, der gør dig til en stærkere kandidat, et mere selvstændigt menneske og en bedre version af dig selv, næste gang chancen byder sig.

Vi har jobmuligheder i bl.a.:

  • Spanien

  • Portugal

  • Grækenland

  • Bulgarien

  • Malta

  • Cypern

…og flere destinationer end det. Du står ikke med det hele selv – vi sørger for tryghed og fællesskab hele vejen, fra du lander til du rejser hjem igen.

Så: skal tiden bare gå? Eller skal du bruge den på noget, du faktisk får noget ud af?

Klar til at høre mere?

  • Eller book et opkald direkte på vores hjemmeside – jeg sidder klar på telefonen 10-18.

jobs.title: Product Owner Finance
jobs.description:
About Weezevent

From iconic festivals such as Tomorrowland, Lollapalooza, BBK, and Boomtown to major sporting events like the Mexico GP or the Paris 2024 Olympic and Paralympic Games, Weezevent supports events of all sizes and formats.

We are the French leader in online ticketing and the European leader in cashless payments. Through all the companies forming up the Weezevent Group, we offer a comprehensive suite of solutions including access control, CRM and staff management, used across a wide variety of events all over the world.

Founded in 2008, Weezevent received the European Fast 500 Innovation Award in 2014 and was included in the French Tech Next40 ranking in both 2024 and 2025. Today, the group employs over 180 people across France, the UK, Spain, Switzerland, Germany, the Netherlands, Belgium, Portugal and Canada, and deploys its solutions at around 1.000 major events each year.

Weezevent is looking for a Product Owner Finance (M/F based in Clichy).

Key Responsibilities:

Product Vision and Strategy: execute the overall vision and strategy for financial products (from ticketing sells to cashless payments, financial reporting, fiscal reporting, and accounting), ensuring alignment with business goals, country regulations and market demands.

Stakeholder Collaboration: act as the primary liaison between stakeholders (finance, compliance, sales, marketing) and the development team to gather requirements and prioritize features.
Detect and report payments incidents when impacting organizers appreciation.
Communicate the product vision and strategy effectively to stakeholders and team members.
Provide operational support to the Client success and Finance teams. Providing help for PSP configurations, responding to questions in Slack, triaging RUN requests and generating custom exports is key for the well functioning of the company.

Product Backlog Management: create, maintain, and prioritize the product backlog based on business value, customer feedback, market trends, and regulatory requirements.
Write clear, actionable user stories and acceptance criteria for the development team.

Development and Delivery: work closely with the development team during sprints to ensure the product is being built according to specifications and timelines.
Review, QA and accept completed user stories to ensure they meet the acceptance criteria and deliver the expected value.

Market and User Research: analyze user data and metrics to inform product decisions and identify areas for improvement, particularly in payments technology.

Compliance and Risk Management: ensure that financial products comply with relevant country/tax/fiscal regulations, standards, and best practices, including GDPR, PCI-DSS, and other industry-specific requirements.
Identify and mitigate risks associated with financial products and solutions with a strong emphasis on compliance and regulatory adherence.

Performance Monitoring: monitor product performance and customer satisfaction, using data and analytics to track key performance indicators.
Implement changes and improvements based on performance metrics and user feedback.

Why it's a good move ?
You will be responsible for executing the vision, strategy, and roadmap for finance functionalities, infrastructure and operational capabilities related to all our products. This role involves collaborating closely with cross-functional teams, developers, designers, and business stakeholders, to ensure the successful delivery of financial products that meet market needs and regulatory requirements, with a strong focus on compliance.

Fundamentals to join us :

  • You have a Master’s degree in Finance, Business Administration, Information Technology, or a related field. MBA or relevant certification (e.g., Certified Scrum Product Owner) ;

  • You have +5 years of experience as a Product Owner, Consultant, or similar role, in a start-up, company or function where payment is core. Having a strong understanding of payments & financial concepts, markets, and instruments is mandatory.

  • You have a proven track record of managing all aspects of a successful product throughout its lifecycle.

  • You speak French fluently.

Just like you, we prefer to work with energetic, friendly and highly committed person. Take on new challenges in a creative sector, send us your CV and let's talk !

All of our positions are open to people with disabilities.

Compensation and benefits

We offer a salary of EUR 50,400–65,000 per year for this permanent contract based in Clichy with a hybrid working arrangement. Private health insurance is provided to cover your medical needs. Public transportation benefits support your daily commute. Paid sick leave ensures you have time to recover when needed. Home Office options offer flexibility in your weekly schedule. A casual dress code allows you to wear what makes you comfortable at work. Regular team events and social activities keep you connected with colleagues. A company laptop is provided from your first day.

jobs.description:
Who we are:

We're one of Europe's fastest-growing fintech companies – on a mission to create the world's most empowering way to pay.

We launched the product in 2020 and achieved double unicorn status, valued at $2 billion, and since then have taken on more than 6 million customers.

 

Our mission is to become the best way to pay for anything, anywhere and say goodbye to credit costs for everyone. This is huge. Want to join us?

About the role.


We’re looking for a UX copywriter to join our copy team and help bring the Zilch brand to life across every digital customer touchpoint.

Your primary focus will be partnering with Product Design to create clear and intuitive experiences across our app and website. Working closely with product designers, product managers and engineers, you'll contribute to creating customer journeys from discovery through to launch.

You'll also collaborate with teams across the business, including Marketing, Customer Support and Operations, providing specialist copy support wherever it's needed – from SEO content and help articles to customer communications and product launches.

This isn't just about writing functional copy. It's about creating experiences customers understand, trust and enjoy. You'll know when to keep things simple, when to inject personality and how to bring the Zilch tone of voice to life in even the smallest moments.

We're looking for a creative and tactical thinker who understands that great UX copy does more than guide users from A to B. It solves problems, removes friction and creates experiences that feel simple, human and unmistakably Zilch.

Day to day responsibilities.

  • Partner with Product Design to create clear, engaging copy across the app and website, from new features to end-to-end customer journeys.

  • Collaborate with product managers, designers and engineers throughout the product development process, from discovery through to launch.

  • Write and optimise customer-facing content across digital touchpoints, including help articles, FAQs, SEO content and operational communications.

  • Balance customer needs, business goals and regulatory requirements to create content that's clear, helpful and compliant.

  • Use customer insight, data and testing to improve the content and customer journeys.

  • Champion accessibility, consistency and best practice in UX writing and content design.

  • Support wider business priorities with copy for product launches, campaigns and new initiatives when needed.

What we’re looking for...

  • You're a brilliant writer with experience creating content for digital products. Whether you've called yourself a UX Writer, Content Designer or Copywriter, you know how to use words to solve problems.

  • You can switch effectively between product thinking and brand thinking. One minute you're refining onboarding copy, the next you're shaping a product launch or crafting a headline that makes someone smile.

  • You know that the best digital experiences don't happen by accident. You're curious, ask the right questions and enjoy getting to the root of a problem before putting pen to paper.

  • You care about craft. Every word has a purpose, every interaction has intent and you're never afraid to rewrite something until it feels just right.

  • You understand our tone of voice and apply it consistently across customer communications, recognising how a brand comes to life through product. You know how to create experiences that feel consistent, human and unmistakably Zilch.

  • You're a natural collaborator who enjoys bouncing ideas around with designers, product managers, marketers and developers. You know the best work happens when different disciplines come together.

  • You're comfortable working in a fast-moving environment where priorities evolve, and you enjoy the variety that comes with it.

  • Experience with Figma is important. Experience writing for SEO or in a regulated industry would be a bonus.

jobs.title: Finance Manager
jobs.description:
We’re building the next generation of employee benefits infrastructure.

At Happl, we help global teams design, manage, and scale benefits that actually work for their people by using AI, across flex allowances, benefits, insurance, recognition, and wellbeing, all in one intelligent platform.

Happl is backed by leading investors such as YCombinator, 6Degrees Capital, Haatch, Portage, and more, known for backing leading companies such as Deel, Rippling, Airbnb, Coinbase, Dropbox, and most recently was awarded a place in the UK’s top 100 startups for 2026.

About the role

As Financial Controller at Happl, you’ll own the financial engine of the business — everything from the cash in the bank to the numbers our board and investors use to make decisions runs through you. You’ll run the monthly close, the full revenue cycle, the compliance calendar across two jurisdictions, and our treasury position, and you’ll decide how all of it gets built, systemised, and automated.

This is a hands-on, high-autonomy role with a direct line to leadership. You won’t be managing a process someone else designed — you’ll be deciding what good looks like across revenue, cash, compliance, and reporting, then making it happen. You’ll work closely with the CEO, the board, our investors, and our outsourced bookkeeping, audit, and tax partners, holding all of it to a standard that matches the product we’ve built.

We’re FCA-regulated and YCombinator-backed, having raised $11m to date, and we give global employers a single place to design, deliver, and manage benefits across 160+ countries and 70+ languages — which means the finance function behind the product has to be just as sharp as the product itself. We’re entering our next phase of growth, with an ambitious revenue trajectory and an expanding international footprint, and this role sits at the centre of it.

What you’ll be doing

  • Owning the monthly close on a fixed timetable — management accounts, balance sheet integrity, accruals, prepayments, and the revenue and cost reconciliations that sit behind them

  • Writing the commentary that explains what’s actually happened in the business, not just what the numbers say

  • Producing the monthly investor reporting pack and the financial sections of board materials — ARR and revenue analysis, cash and runway, burn efficiency, unit economics, cohort and retention metrics, and budget versus actual

  • Owning the full revenue cycle — invoicing, collections, aged debt, and revenue recognition across a multi-currency, multi-contract subscription base

  • Leading the rollout of automated billing and revenue recognition tooling, moving us from manual tracking to a system that scales without adding headcount

  • Managing our two legal entities — a US TopCo and a UK operating company — including statutory accounts, audit preparation, intercompany accounting, transfer pricing mechanics, and FX exposure between them

  • Owning the compliance calendar end to end across both jurisdictions — UK VAT returns, corporation tax, US federal and state filings, sales tax where applicable, and payroll taxes

  • Supporting our FCA regulatory reporting obligations and the financial controls that sit behind them

  • Running monthly payroll across jurisdictions, pension and benefits administration, employee expenses, and the finance side of onboarding and offboarding

  • Owning the cash position and treasury strategy — cash flow forecasting, working capital, FX management, and structuring how we hold company funds to earn a sensible return without taking risk we shouldn’t

  • Managing our outsourced bookkeeping, accounting, and tax partners — holding them to deadlines and quality, and pulling work in-house where doing so makes us faster

  • Owning the finance tech stack and having a strong opinion on it, actively replacing manual work with automation and AI-assisted workflows across reconciliations, invoice processing, variance analysis, and reporting drafts

  • Leveraging AI tools like Claude and ChatGPT to speed up your own work and build the systems that let finance scale without adding headcount

  • Acting as the financial conscience of the business, with a direct line to the founders and a real say in how we grow

What we’re looking for

  • Qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA or CIMA), or qualified by experience with a track record that stands up to scrutiny

  • Genuine ownership of a monthly close cycle and management reporting pack, start to finish

  • Strong technical grounding in revenue recognition, accruals accounting, and balance sheet control

  • Comfortable with tax and compliance across VAT, corporation tax, and payroll, ideally spanning both the UK and US

  • AI-native in your approach — you already use AI tools in your day-to-day work and can talk specifically about what you’ve automated and what it saved you

  • Exceptional attention to detail, alongside the judgement to know when precision matters and when speed does

  • A clear communicator — you can explain a number to a non-finance audience without patronising them or losing them

  • Ideally, SaaS or subscription business experience, particularly ARR reporting and deferred revenue, and familiarity with modern billing infrastructure like Xero or Stripe

  • Comfort with SQL, Python, or low-code automation tools is a bonus, not a requirement, but it will make your life here significantly easier

What to expect

Being Financial Controller at Happl is not a maintenance role. You’ll be building the finance function as you run it — choosing the systems, designing the controls, and deciding how billing, revenue recognition, and reporting should work as we scale into new markets and currencies. That’s not a caveat; it’s the role.

Some weeks will be genuinely rewarding — a reporting pack you built gives the board real clarity, a manual process you automated saves the team hours every month, a treasury decision you made puts real value on the table. Some will be hard — closing the books on a fixed timetable, holding partners and advisors to a deadline, and making judgement calls across two jurisdictions with incomplete information.

What you get in return is real scope. You’ll own the whole picture — revenue, cash, compliance, treasury, and reporting — across two jurisdictions and 160+ countries of operations, with a direct line to the founders and reporting that goes straight to the board and our investors. This is the foundation of a finance function that will grow with the business, and the right person grows with it.

Why join Happl

  • Be part of building something that genuinely matters — the future of how companies support their people

  • Competitive salary that reflects the impact you’ll have

  • Real equity — a meaningful stake in what we’re building together

  • Hybrid working from day one, with the trust and flexibility to do your best work

  • Your own Happl account — use the platform you’re helping to build and shape

  • Private Health Insurance, because we genuinely care about how you’re doing

  • Dental insurance, including family cover

  • A personal Wellbeing budget to spend however wellbeing works for you — no questions asked

  • A dedicated L&D budget to grow in the direction that excites you

  • Pension — we’re invested in your future, not just the short term

About the Interview

  • Stage 1: 20-min Intro call with Ben Shorrock (Head of Operations)

  • Stage 2: Short task

  • Stage 3: 30-min deep dive and task review with Ben T (CEO) & Ben S (Ops)

Additional Details

  • Location: London, Holborn

  • Team: Finance

  • Reports to: CEO

  • Working arrangement: Hybrid (4+ Days in Office)

About Notabene

Notabene is building infrastructure that’s transforming how money moves in the digital economy. We’re evolving beyond our compliance foundations to enable the next generation of digital financial services between regulated institutions with unprecedented efficiency. With nearly 50 employees across 14 countries and having recently closed our Series B round last November with support from leading investors including Y Combinator, DRW, F-Prime, Jump Capital, Castle Island, and Green Visor Capital, we’re looking for people like you to help shape the future rails of the crypto industry.

At Notabene, the success of our customers drives everything that we do, and our Customer Success team is at the heart of that. You will own a book of customers across EMEA, from crypto-native exchanges and payment providers through to the financial institutions and fintechs now launching digital asset products.

Sales closes the initial deal and hands the customer over at signature. From there they are yours: get them live, get them using the product, renew them and grow them. The commercial conversation sits with you, which means renewals, pricing and upsells are yours to run.

You are also a technical point of contact for your customers. These conversations get technical early, and you should be able to sit with a customer's integration team and be useful. Comfort with APIs and the curiosity to work things out yourself matter more here than an engineering background.

Within a year you are successful if…

  • Net retention across your book has grown, and you can name the renewals and upsells that did it

  • Your customers are live and using the product, and the ones at risk were identified early

Vacature: Senior Growth Marketeer (B2B SaaS) @ Snelstart

•            Uren: 32–40 uur

•            Salaris: €4.800 – €7.000 o.b.v. 40 uur

 

Voor onze opdrachtgever Snelstart zoekt Sound People een senior growth marketeer die strategie en data naadloos verbindt. Snelstart helpt dagelijks ondernemers, boekhouders en accountants slimmer te werken en groeit hard. Met 180.000 gebruikers is het een van de grootste boekhoud en accountancy software platforms van Nederland Jij wordt eigenaar van de volledige growth-loop: acquisitie, activatie en engagement, en werkt nauw samen met Marketing, Product, Data en Sales.

 

De rol van senior growth marketeer bij Snelstart

•   Ontwikkel, voer uit en schaal de growth-strategie voor self-serve en sales-led acquisitie.

•   Ontwerp en run high-impact experimenten over de hele funnel (campagnes, onboarding, pricing, funnels, content, AI-automatisering).

•   Analyseer gedrag en data diepgaand; identificeer patronen, kansen en bottlenecks.

•   Bouw repeatable growth loops en automatisering voor schaal.

•   Optimaliseer paid performance kanalen (creatives, audiences, attributie).

•   Co-creëer met Product voor betere activation, onboarding en retention.

•   Zet moderne tooling in: AI-personalisatie, marketing automation, tracking, testing, analytics.

•   Werk met leadership aan prioritering, rapportage en roadmap-invloed.

Waarom is deze rol interessant voor jou?

Er is veel te doen en je krijgt veel vrijheid én verantwoordelijkheid. Je maakt diepe impact en je mening wordt serieus genomen. Jouw data inzichten en suggesties vormen de basis voor belangrijke beslissingen en keuze die Snelstart gaat maken in de toekomst. Je zit én aan de knoppen én je bepaalt mede de richting voor verdere groei van de organisatie o.a. mbt tot klantinzichten. Daarnaast kun je experimenteren, testen, AI inzetten, optimaliseren en nauw samenwerken met product, marketing automation, marketing director en het MT.

 

Wat biedt Snelstart

•   Brutosalaris €4.800 – €7.000 (40 u/pw), afhankelijk van ervaring.

•   30 vakantiedagen (o.b.v. 40 uur), maandelijks vakantiegeld en pensioenbijdrage.

•   Hybride werken, modern benefits-pakket, laptop en ergonomische werkplek (zit-sta).

•   Toegang tot sportschool met bedrijfskorting.

•   Cultuur die data, snelheid en creativiteit omarmt; ruimte en budget voor tooling/experimenten.

•   Directe invloed op product, strategie en roadmap; doorgroeimogelijkheden in een schaalbare omgeving.

•   Een betrokken team met 200+ collega’s.

Spreekt dit jou aan?  Neem contact op met Sound People via Sven Fremeijer (

Wat is de procedure?

Na een succesvolle telefonische kennismaking volgt een face to face gesprek met Sven Fremeijer. Als we beiden voldoende aanleiding zien om verder te gaan stelt Sound je voor bij SnelStart. Daar volgen 2 gesprekrondes.

De eerste gespreksronde wordt gezamenlijk gevoerd door de directeur commercie en product en HR. De tweede ronde zal plaatsvinden met de directeur commercie en product en een externe adviseur. Daarna volgt een arbeidsvoorwaarden gesprek.

Slotopmerking

Deze functie is bedoeld voor een daadkrachtige verbinder die marketing discipline met pragmatisme combineert. Als jij de marketing van SnelStart wilt professionaliseren en de organisatie wilt helpen naar een voorspelbare, succesvolle ‘marketingmachine’, dan horen we graag van je!


Jouw profiel

Ervaring en competenties

•   Hbo werk- en denkniveau.

•   7+ jaar in growth/performance marketing of vergelijkbare data-gedreven SaaS-rol.

•   Sterk in strategie én executie; van visie naar vandaag nog live experimenten.

•   Analytisch: hypotheses, statistiek, funnel metrics, cohort analyses, CAC, LTV, incrementality.

•   Ervaring met A/B-testing, experiment design, CRO en gedragspsychologie.

•   Ervaren in samenwerking met Product, Design en Data; comfortabel in technisch productteam.

•   Bekend met GA4, HubSpot, Mixpanel/Amplitude, Looker/Power BI, Segment/Stitch, AI-tooling.

•   Creatief, schaal- en impactgericht, pragmatisch, eigenaarschap, hoog tempo.

•   Kwaliteitsgericht in de breedste zin.

Motivatie; je optimaliseert wordt blij van groei. En wordt blij van resultaat en je vindt de marketing puzzel leuk en enthousiasmeert je collega’s voor jouw vak en de impact die je maakt.

Persoonlijk: je gedreven en betrokken, oprecht en geeft je mening graag. Je deelt en geeft inzichten en werkt graag samen omdat het dan beter wordt. Je kan omgaan met feedback.  Je neemt graag verantwoordelijkheid en neemt de regie voor jouw werk

jobs.title: Closed Procedure: Senior Account Director - Strategic Account in Maritime Logistics for SITA
jobs.description:
Senior Account Director - Strategic Account in Maritime Logistics for SITA

 

Executive summary: A senior international key account role for a professional who excels in relationship management, stakeholder engagement, and strategic account development. In this position, you will be responsible for retaining, deepening, and further strengthening the partnership with one of SITA’s ( https://www.sita.aero/about-us/ )  most strategic clients.

Highlights: Senior Account Director - Strategic Account in Maritime Logistics | SITA

·      End-to-end responsibility for a strategic international key account

·      Strong focus on relationship management, retention, and deepening the partnership with C-level, IT directors, Enterprise architects, both on the IT organization of the client as well the Business organization.

·      International sales and stakeholder management role with high visibility in the customer environment

·      Significant impact on client satisfaction, continuity and commercial development, including revenue management

·      Strong focus on managed IT and Connectivity services (infrastructure) and differentiated value propositions, based on the portfolio of SITA

·      Key position within an international team and complex IT enterprise and Business environment

·      Operational / dotted leadership of a highly skilled IT team of 6 FTE at client site

 

Purpose of the role

For SITA, we are looking for a Senior Account Director who will take international responsibility for the strategic international key account. In this role, the emphasis is on retaining, deepening, and future-proofing an existing client relationship with significant commercial and operational value. The focus is not on aggressive revenue growth, but on stability, continuity and additional commercial opportunities within an established international account.

 

About the role, building future proof relationships

As Senior Account Director, you will be responsible for managing and further developing the strategic international key account within SITA. You will operate in an international environment where relationship development focusing on account retention, you understand the complexity of enterprise. IT, data and connectivity sales and know how to create structural value within an existing client relationship.

 

The ideal candidate is an experienced sales professional with proven knowledge of strategic international key account as an organization, for example from a previous role as a supplier or strategic partner. IT knowledge and experience with managed services are important, but deep client knowledge, insight into decision-making structures, and an understanding of international stakeholder dynamics are even more critical in this position. You can build sustainable relationships at multiple levels, create internal and external alignment in a smart and distinctive way.

 

About SITA

SITA has been a leading technology partner for the international travel and transport sector since 1949. In its early years, the SITA company built one of the first large-scale communications networks for aviation and today continues to play a global role in making travel and logistics processes smarter, safer, and more efficient. SITA has since expanded this expertise into maritime services and managed services for logistics organizations

 

SITA supports organizations with contact center solutions, connectivity, digital collaboration, security, and managed services. Within this context, strategic international key account for whom SITA delivers services worldwide that directly contribute to customer contact, collaboration, and operational continuity.

Client context

The strategic international key account one of the world’s leading container shipping and logistics companies, with approximately 18.000 employees globally, 340 + offices in 120 + countries, and connections to more than 550 ports worldwide. The organization is known for its strong focus on quality, digitalization, customer centricity, and operational excellence.

For this role, insight into the international dynamics of a complex logistics organization is essential. You understand how technology, service delivery, and stakeholder management come together in an environment where continuity, reliability, and client satisfaction have a direct impact on the business.

The partnership between SITA and the strategic international key account is built on a strong foundation. Your assignment will be to further deepen this relationship, strengthen SITA’s position, and carefully and strategically develop new opportunities within the account.

 

Portfolio and services at the key account

·       Contact centre and voice solutions

·       Global connectivity solutions

·       Managed services for communication and office environments

·       Management of digital workplaces and office environments

·       Security solutions

 

What will you do?

·       You will have end-to-end responsibility for the international account management strategic key account within SITA.

·       You will build and deepen sustainable relationships with stakeholders at operational, tactical, and strategic levels.

·       You will safeguard the existing revenue base and drive maximum client retention in an environment where managed services are largely viewed as a commodity.

·       You will identify commercial opportunities and translate them into distinctive, relevant, and viable propositions.

·       You will clearly operate as a farmer rather than a hunter account retention, and strategic growth is the main focus.

·       You will position SITA as a partner that adds value more intelligently, effectively, and innovatively than the market expects.

·       You will work effectively with internal teams, senior stakeholders, and specialists to serve the client optimally.

·       You will provide day-to-day direction to a highly skilled IT delivery team of 6 FTE at the client (virtual and extended account team).

 

Terms of employment

This position offers a fixed gross monthly salary between €9.000,- and €11.000,- gross monthly, complemented by an attractive variable compensation model. The bonus structure consists of a sales incentive based on revenue, with approximately 40% of the variable compensation linked to renewals. In addition, you will receive commission on closed deals. With strong performance, a total package of up to approximately €160,000 OTE is achievable.

Procedure

Following a successful introductory phone call, you will have 2 face-to-face meetings with a SoundPeople senior consultant. If both sides see sufficient reason to move forward, we will introduce you to SITA. You will then go through three interview rounds with the client:

 

The first interview round will take place with a Account Executive of SITA (Central Europe) and an HR professional. The second round will be with the SVP of Central Europe and the current Account Director. In the final stage, the ultimate selection and terms of employment will be aligned with the President of Europe and the COO.

 

Interested?

 

This opportunity is designed for an accomplished enterprise account leader who understands that a mature strategic relationship still requires energy, precision and continuous development. If you can combine executive stakeholder management with commercial ownership and coordinated delivery, we would like to hear from you.

 

Contact Sven Fremeijer at Sound People BV, Executive Search

LinkedIn:  https://www.linkedin.com/in/svenfremeijer/


Who are we looking for?

We are looking for a senior sales professional with extensive experience in complex enterprise environments and a strong understanding of international client dynamics. Ideally, you know the strategic international key account from a supplier or partner perspective and understand the organization, its decision-making processes, and the interests at play. You combine commercial sharpness with high-level know how to create momentum based on trust, substance, and personal leadership.

 

·      Proven experience in MSP, IT, managed services and/or Telco environments

·      Deep client knowledge and preferably previous experience with strategic key account

·      Creative, innovative, and strategically strong in commercial positioning

·      Excellent networker and a credible sparring partner at C-level

·      Structured, results-driven, and operationally strong

·      Able to move organizations forward through relationships and trust, rather than hierarchy or pressure

·      Must: Excellent communication skills in an international environment.

DAS BIST DU

Wenn du dich leidenschaftlich für Nachhaltigkeit engagieren möchtest und hochmotiviert bist, mit uns die Welt ein bisschen sauberer zu machen, dann finden wir dich richtig gut!

Wenn du außerdem gerne proaktiv und im Team arbeitest, und du jede kleine und große Herausforderung als eine Chance ansiehst, noch besser zu werden – dann sind wir schon ein ganz kleines bisschen verknallt.

  • Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau (C2) sowie verhandlungssichere Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift; weitere Sprachen oder internationale Handelserfahrung sind ein Plus.

  • Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium (BWL, Marketing oder vergleichbar) oder eine äquivalente kaufmännische Qualifikation.


DAS IST EVERDROP


Unsere Mission 💚🌱🌎

Wir wollen die Welt verändern – gemeinsam mit dir! Die Alltagsprodukte von everdrop helfen den Menschen, ganz einfach ihren ökologischen Fußabdruck im Haushalt zu reduzieren. Seitdem haben unsere Haushalts- und Pflegeprodukte bereits mehr als 20 Millionen Einweg-Plastikflaschen und Tausende Tonnen unnötige CO2-Emissionen und chemische Rohstoffe eingespart. Seit 2023 sind wir übrigens eine zertifizierte B Corp. Und mit deiner Hilfe wollen wir everdrop aufs nächste Level bringen. Schließ dich unserer Mission an – und hilf uns, einen nachhaltigen Lifestyle so einfach zu machen, dass er zum neuen Standard in unserer Gesellschaft wird.

Bei everdrop wollen wir eine Kultur der Inklusion, Vielfalt und Chancengleichheit leben. Das Commitment, die Welt ein bisschen besser zu machen, ist Teil unseres alltäglichen Handelns. Vor allem wollen wir das Bewusstsein für unseren Planeten und für andere Menschen fördern.

jobs.title: Freelance Acquisition Paid Media (Google Ads, Meta Ads)
jobs.description:
Nous recherchons un(e) consultant(e) freelance spécialisé(e) en acquisition payante pour intervenir sur plusieurs projets e-commerce dans la beauté, la nutrition et la santé.

Notre terrain de jeu : l'acquisition payante nourrie par les contenus de créateurs. Spark Ads, whitelisting, Partnership Ads, amplification de contenus UGC. Si vous savez transformer une vidéo de créatrice en campagne rentable, cette mission est pour vous.

Nous recherchons un partenaire capable aussi bien d'optimiser des dispositifs existants que de construire une stratégie paid media de A à Z pour de nouvelles marques ou de nouveaux marchés. Cette première mission pourra déboucher sur une collaboration récurrente.

Vos missions

1. Audit et optimisation de l'existant

  • Auditer les comptes Google Ads, Meta Ads et TikTok Ads.

  • Identifier les principaux freins à la performance (tracking, structure des campagnes, ciblages, créas, audiences, budget, attribution).

  • Construire un plan d'actions priorisé selon l'impact business, puis le mettre en œuvre.

  • Suivre les performances et formuler de nouvelles recommandations.

2. Amplification des contenus créateurs

  • Sélectionner les contenus UGC et créateurs à fort potentiel publicitaire.

  • Mettre en place les autorisations (Spark Ads, whitelisting, Partnership Ads) avec les créateurs.

  • Tester les hooks, formats et angles, puis industrialiser ce qui performe.

3. Construction d'une stratégie d'acquisition sur un nouveau marché

Sur l'un des projets, vous définirez et déploierez une stratégie d'acquisition payante sur les réseaux sociaux pour accompagner le lancement d'un concept sur le marché américain : choix des plateformes et des formats, architecture des campagnes, audiences, premiers tests, optimisation continue.

Selon les projets, la mission pourra évoluer vers un pilotage mensuel des campagnes.

Vos compétences

Nous recherchons un profil senior, opérationnel, qui pilote lui-même les comptes.

  • Indispensable : une expérience réelle des Spark Ads, du whitelisting ou des Creator Ads, avec des résultats à montrer.

  • Une excellente maîtrise de Meta Ads et TikTok Ads.

  • Une solide expérience sur Google Ads (Search, Shopping, Performance Max).

  • Un tracking propre : GA4, GTM, Pixel, API Conversions.

  • Une approche orientée rentabilité : ROAS, CPA, marge.

  • Une expérience de marques e-commerce D2C (cosmétique, beauté, nutrition, santé) sera particulièrement appréciée, tout comme une expérience à l'international.

Conditions

  • Mission freelance, 350 à 380 € par jour selon profil.

  • 100 % à distance, depuis l'Europe : nous travaillons sur le fuseau de Paris et les échanges se font en journée (UTC-1 à UTC+3).

  • Statut d'indépendant en règle.

Pour postuler

Merci de nous donner un résultat chiffré avant / après sur une campagne que vous avez pilotée (ROAS, CPA ou CAC, budget mensuel, période). Les candidatures sans aucun chiffre ne seront pas étudiées.

Joignez aussi :

  • deux ou trois références de missions similaires, idéalement avec des contenus créateurs ;

  • votre niveau sur Google Ads, Meta Ads et TikTok Ads ;

  • votre disponibilité pour démarrer.

2. Je werkt soms alleen en soms stuur je enkele flexi’s aan. Je dient daarbij instructies te geven en deze ook op te volgen. Naast het samenwerken met collega’s sta je ook in nauw contact met de klanten. Je vertelt hen iets over het eten en helpt hen verder bij vragen.

3. Je bent ook bezig met de planning en organisatie van de maaltijden. Je anticipeert daarbij op de planning van de dag/ week, ziet werk, signaleert tekorten en communiceert hierover met de vaste collega’s.

4. Je werk gaat ook breder: je doet soms de afwas, aanvulling frigo’s en koffiebuffet, groenten wassen, zorgen voor een goede catering flow etc.

Je hebt een hart voor koken en bent benieuwd naar onze lokale keuken. Je bent bereid om te leren koken volgens onze recepten: seizoensgebonden, verse groenten, lokale producten, eenvoudig en heerlijk. Je hebt interesse in veggie- en veganistische maaltijden, maar bent ook bereid om met vlees en vis te werken.

Wij verwachten een open en directe communicatie naar de collega’s en een open houding naar feedback. Daarnaast vragen we een klantgerichte communicatie naar de gasten .

Je kan omgaan met deadlines en anticipeert op drukke momenten.

Je wil de dingen graag efficiënt organiseren. Je kan daarbij nadenken over: welke groep eet waar, hoeveel buffetten zijn er nodig, hoe zorgen we dat klanten niet te lang moeten aanschuiven…

We verwachten dat je bereidheid toont om te blijven gaan voor verbetering zowel naar bereiding als organisatie.

Je kan je flexibel opstellen en bent bereid om in hoogseizoen soms meer te werken waardoor je in schoolvakanties en de wintermaanden soms langere periodes overuren kan opnemen.

Je hebt eigen vervoer om je te verplaatsen.

We werken een vast uurrooster, dat in overleg met jou worden vastgelegd. Je werkt per dag ongeveer 8u en je uren liggen meestal tussen 7u – 21u.

jobs.title: Koulutettu hieroja
jobs.description:
Haussa koulutettuja hierojia uuteen hyvinvointikeskukseen!

Etsimme joukkoomme ammattitaitoisia hierojia uuteen avattavaan hyvinvointikeskukseen Joutsensillalle.

Oletko sinä:

- koulutettu hieroja (Hierojan ammattitutkinto)

- ammattitaitoinen ja asiakkaan luottamusta herättävä

- hyvä työkaveri


Meillä pääset:

- mukaan rakentamaan laadukasta hyvinvointikeskusta

- työskentelemään viihtyisässä ja arvostavassa työyhteisössä, jossa jokainen saa kokea olevansa tärkeä osa yhteisöämme

- osaksi henkilöstömme jatkuvaa jatkokoulutusta - haluamme, että meillä työskentelee alan osaavimmat ja ammattitaitoisimmat tekijät

- suunnittelemaan työaikasi joustavasti ammatinharjoittajana


Toimit meillä itsenäisenä ammatinharjoittajana, ja ansaintasi muodostuu tekemistäsi hierontahoidoista. Jokaisen asiakaskäynnin tuotosta suurin osa kuuluu sinulle ja sovittu osuus meille.

Meidän tehtävämme on tehdä sinun työstäsi mahdollisimman sujuvaa. Huolehdimme tiloista, ajanvarauksesta, myynnistä ja markkinoinnista sekä monista niistä käytännön asioista, joita toimivan hierontapalvelun arki vaatii. Järjestämme tarvittavat välineet ja tarvikkeet, huolehdimme asiakaskokemuksen ympärillä olevista käytännön järjestelyistä ja teemme töitä sen eteen, että kalenterissasi riittää asiakkaita.

Haluamme myös, että meillä työskentelevillä ammattilaisilla on mahdollisuus kehittyä ja pysyä alansa huipulla. Siksi panostamme aktiivisesti osaamisen kehittämiseen ja koulutuksiin.

Ajatus on yksinkertainen: sinä saat keskittyä siihen, minkä osaat parhaiten – asiakkaiden kohtaamiseen ja laadukkaaseen hierontatyöhön. Me puolestamme hoidamme ympärillä olevan kokonaisuuden ja rakennamme yhdessä edellytykset sille, että sinun on hyvä tehdä työtäsi.

Mikäli yrittäjänä/ammatinharjoittajana toimiminen on sinulle uutta tai vierasta, niin autamme sinua kädestä pitäen oman yrityksesi perustamisessa ja toiminnan aloittamisessa.

Kiinnostuitko?

Lähetä meille napakka videohakemus, jossa kerrot itsestäsi, osaamisestasi ja siitä, mitä toisit joukkoomme. Mikäli videohakemuksen lähettäminen ei ole sinulle mahdollista, voit lähettää hakemuksen ja CV:n.

Tartu rohkeasti toimeen ja lähetä meille hakemus.

Odotamme, että pääsemme tutustumaan sinuun!

jobs.title: Global Talent Acquisition Partner (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
At Moss, we give finance professionals the power to automate their day-to-day and make forward-thinking decisions.

Our culture is what makes that possible: we play to win, we obsess over quality, and we win as One Moss, and it works. Moss closed a €35 million Series C in August 2026, crossing a €1 billion valuation, and became one of Europe's fintech unicorns. Join us for what's next.

Our Talent Acquisition team is searching for a Talent Acquisition Partner. You will play a pivotal role in helping Moss attract and hire the right talent for our our teams across Europe, mostly across our Commercial, Marketing and Operations departments. Reporting to the TA Director, you will join a team of five Talent Acquisition Partners across Berlin and London, covering every market and every role up to C-suite.

Your responsibilities 

  • Sourcing, screening & managing candidates  - identify, attract and engage with talent by using different sourcing techniques and channels. Manage the entire candidate journey from initial contact, coordinating interviews to offer management, ensuring a high quality candidate experience.

  • Business Partnering - Own full-cycle hiring for your vertical end to end, from sourcing through offer, across Germany, the UK and the Netherlands. Work directly with the leadership and hiring managers on all their hiring needs. Develop deep understanding of the businesses you support to help them make better hiring decisions, not just fill vacancies.

  • Process improvement - Identify opportunities to reduce friction points across the interview process and the candidate journey, and implement experiments and improvements. Share sourcing techniques and hiring intelligence with the wider TA team across verticals and markets.

  • AI & Tooling - Contribute to making us more efficient and faster by leveraging existing AI workflows and helping us build new ones (Claude, chatGPT, n8n).

About you

We think you’ll need the following experience and qualifications to succeed in the role:

  • Track record sourcing and closing high-calibre and hard-to-reach candidates, including through sourcing and direct outreach.

  • Proven experience as a full-cycle recruiter, ideally hiring across multiple functions/locales.

  • Demonstrated use of AI tools across daily recruiting workflow (a big plus if you're the one building them).

  • Fluent in English (C1 minimum). Other languages, esp. German, a plus.

In addition, here are the skills and attributes we are looking for:

  • Inquisitive mindset - you ask sharp, insightful questions to really understand stakeholders and candidates

  • Good judgement - you weigh information and observations to make sound judgement calls in ambiguous situations.

  • Trustworthy and credible - you manage expectations, and build relationships based on a desire to help and support.

  • Adaptive communication - you bring structure and clarity to how you present information, and this enables you to guide, advise, and influence those you engage with.

The interview process will include an online assessment as an initial step, followed by an Intro Call, Hiring Manager Call, a Live Case Study and a Final In-person Interview in one of our offices.

About Moss

Moss is the Finance AI platform for Europe's mid-sized businesses, giving companies real-time visibility and full control over their spend. By automating card issuing, invoice management and expenses, Moss simplifies financial workflows and frees finance and accounting teams from manual, administrative work.

Founded in Berlin and used by more than 10,000 businesses including Flink, Schufa, n8n and Auto1, Moss has raised €220+ million to date and operates in Germany, the Netherlands, the UK and further EU markets. In August 2026, Moss closed a €35 million Series C led by Portage, crossing a €1 billion valuation and becoming one of Europe's newest fintech unicorns. Moss is backed by investors including Valar Ventures, Tiger Global, Global Founders Capital, Cherry Ventures, A-Star.

We're a team of 300+ people from 50+ nationalities across 5 offices in Europe and we hire, reward, and grow people based on Moss DNA: playing to win, obsessing over quality, winning as One Moss. If that's how you want to work, we want to hear from you. - here's what else to expect:

  • Our vibrant offices are at the heart of our culture, where in-person time fuels collaboration and connection over weekly breakfasts and Friday demos.

  • Additional benefits include: 20 days “work from abroad”, 600EUR/GBP Learning & Development Budget, and other local benefits.

Unless stated otherwise, benefits apply to full-time positions (interns and working students receive a tailored package).

Join a growing data team and take ownership of our tracking data infrastructure, which captures millions of user events across our web platform every day.

You will focus on operating, improving, and scaling existing data systems, ensuring data is reliable, cost-efficient, and accessible for analytics teams.

What success looks like

  • You take ownership of a high-volume data domain and keep it stable and scalable

jobs.title: Product Lead - AI Finance App
jobs.description:
About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe.

 

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

 

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

 

The Role

We are looking for product leads to shape and drive major product areas within Doit's AI Finance App.

This role is for senior product builders who can own direction, execution, product quality and outcomes across multiple workstreams or squads.

 

What You'll Own

  • Lead product direction for major AI Neobank app areas.

  • Define priorities, roadmap, product standards and success metrics across multiple features or squads.

  • Guide PMs, Product Owners, designers and engineers toward clear execution.

  • Work across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel and other financial services.

  • Turn regulatory, operational and business constraints into practical product decisions.

  • Drive launch quality, post-launch learning and continuous improvement.

  • Help build a product culture focused on speed, clarity, user value and honest measurement.


What We're Looking For

  • Strong experience leading digital product areas, not just individual features.

  • Able to balance strategy, execution, UX, data, engineering and business outcomes.

  • Strong judgement on prioritization, trade-offs and product sequencing.

  • Experience leading or mentoring PMs / POs / cross-functional squads is a strong advantage.

  • Comfortable with high ambiguity, fast changes and senior stakeholder pressure.

  • Able to simplify complex financial products into usable journeys.

  • Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or regulated products is a strong advantage.


The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Can set direction and still go deep into details.

  • Pushes teams to move faster without lowering product quality.

  • Knows when to simplify, when to scale and when to say no.

  • Can lead through clarity, not bureaucracy.

  • Avoids false claims and understands that product impact usually comes from many iterations and teams.


This Role Is Not For

  • Product leaders who only manage people and meetings.

  • People who cannot go deep into product details.

  • Candidates who are too slow for a high-growth environment.

  • Leaders who push vanity metrics without understanding real user impact.

  • People who need large teams before they can create progress.


Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Germany. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Germany.

 

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

 

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

 

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.title: Senior software developer (C# / .NET, Data Analysis)
jobs.description:
Senior software developer (C# / .NET, Data Analysis)
Build the software that turns ultrasonic inspection data into safety-critical pipeline decisions worldwide, and lift the team around you.

Location: Utrecht region (head office in Tricht, Gelderland)


About Intero Integrity

Intero Integrity is an internationally operating specialist in the inspection, maintenance and emission monitoring of pipelines and industrial assets. We develop our inspection technology entirely in-house: from ultrasonic measurement systems and FPGA signal processing to the software our analysts use to interpret hundreds of kilometres of pipeline data.

The inspection results our software produces are used for safety-critical decisions about the integrity of pipelines and industrial installations such as heat exchangers. Reliability and correctness are therefore not a nice-to-have, but an absolute requirement.

We operate across Europe, North America and the Middle East. Our software products sit at the heart of that work: they are used every day by our data analysis organisation around the world. Whatever you build here has a direct, global impact.

The opportunity

This is a role for a senior engineer who enjoys both sides of the craft: building excellent software, and helping people around you get better. You will work hands-on on the C#/.NET software behind our data analysis, turning large volumes of ultrasonic inspection data into reliable insights that our organisation uses worldwide.

What makes it attractive is the mix. You mentor and guide our internal developers, setting an example in how we design, review and test. At the same time you work side by side with our external development partners. Learning from them, challenging them and making sure the work meets a high bar. You'll grow as an engineer and as a mentor, often in the same week.

Because our data is used for safety-critical decisions, a strong sense of software quality runs through the role: it shapes how you design, how you review and where you set the standard for the team. If you value knowledge transfer and a healthy engineering culture as much as writing good code, you will feel at home here.


What you will do

Hands-on software development

•      You design, build and maintain C# applications for the analysis and reporting of inspection data

•      You work with large volumes of ultrasonic signal data and binary data streams

•      You build web applications and REST APIs on the ASP.NET platform

•      You contribute to bringing machine learning / Human-in-the-Loop capabilities into the data analysis workflow

•      You work with cloud-native services, preferably on Azure

•      You contribute to test strategies at functional, integration and system level, with an eye for the safety-critical use of the software

•      You work closely with hardware engineers, test engineers and domain specialists (UT inspection)

Mentorship & working with partners

•      You mentor and coach our internal developers and help them grow their technical skills

•      You lead by example in code reviews, pairing and knowledge sharing

•      You work side by side with external development partners, challenging their choices and making sure the work meets a high standard

•      You help establish and document engineering standards: coding guidelines, review processes, testing strategies and release policy

•      You make sure design decisions and domain knowledge are documented and transferable, so the team can operate independently

•      You help shape a development culture where quality and continuous improvement are the norm


What you bring

Technical expertise

•      Extensive experience with C# and the .NET platform

•      Solid knowledge of software architecture, design principles and design patterns

•      Experience building web applications and REST APIs (ASP.NET)

•      Experience writing maintainable, testable, high-quality software

•      Experience with automated testing and CI/CD

•      The ability to mentor others and lift the level of a team

•      Good communication skills and the ability to clearly substantiate technical choices


A plus

•      Experience with cloud development, preferably Azure

•      Experience with machine learning and/or image recognition, and operationalising ML in production

•      Affinity with signal processing, measurement data and data streams, preferably in an industrial or technical context

•      Experience with WPF and complex desktop applications

•      Experience in a domain where software quality and reliability have direct impact (industrial automation, medical software, measurement & inspection or similar)

When do we see you as a senior?

For us, seniority goes beyond years of experience or technical skill. We are looking for someone who understands that technical choices affect the product, the organisation and our customers, and who actively takes responsibility for that.

You:

•      Form an independent view on architecture and technology

•      Think critically about requirements, assumptions and existing ways of working

•      Take responsibility for quality, also outside your own code, and recognise that in a safety-critical domain the bar is higher

•      Consciously build team knowledge: you document, explain and help colleagues grow

•      Are comfortable in an environment where not everything is fixed yet, and know how to bring structure to it

•      Actively contribute to knowledge sharing and continuous improvement within the team


What we offer

A senior role with real influence on our software products and how we build them, the chance to mentor and grow a team, and the variety of working alongside experienced external partners, in a domain where technology genuinely matters.


Salary & terms of employment

•      Gross monthly salary between € 5.328,- and € 6.715,- based on a 40-hour week, depending on knowledge and experience

•      Year-end bonus, dependent on company results

•      25 holiday days per year

•      Hybrid working (3 days per week at the office in Tricht as standard) and flexible working hours

•      Collective pension scheme, with Intero contributing 50% of the premium

•      Laptop and phone provided


Working environment

•      Technically challenging problems at the intersection of software, hardware and data

•      Collaboration with experienced specialists across a range of technical disciplines

•      Free fruit at work, access to the Intero Gym, company fitness options and a bike leasing scheme

•      An international, technically driven working environment with plenty of room for ownership and initiative


Ready to build with us?

Do you want to write excellent software, help a team grow around you and work alongside strong external partners? Then we would like to meet you.

Send your application and CV or LinkedIn profile to Questions about this vacancy? Get in touch with our Corporate Recruiter Veroniek Smits at the same address.

Please note that for this role we do not work with recruitment agencies, and we're unable to accept unsolicited candidate submissions or related fees.

jobs.title: Senior Integrity Engineer
jobs.description:
Senior Integrity Engineer

Europe | Remote (hybrid near an Intero office) | 32-40 hours

An inspection shows a client what is wrong. You show them what to do about it.

Are you the integrity engineer people turn to when the inspection data is in and a decision has to be made? Do you enjoy combining fracture mechanics, corrosion growth and sound engineering judgment into advice an operator can actually act on? Then we would like to meet you. We are growing our Integrity team and are looking for our first Senior Integrity Engineer based in Europe.

About Intero

Intero Integrity Services helps pipeline operators and industrial companies keep their assets safe, compliant and running. With our own in-line inspection technology (including MFL and UT) we inspect pipelines and installations all over the world and tell clients exactly what condition their assets are in. Headquartered in Tricht, the Netherlands, we have over 40 years of experience and 650+ professionals from 25+ nationalities.
Learn more about our Inspection service line in this video: Intero - The Power of Integrity.

Your team

You join a close-knit Integrity team of five, including you: a Principal Integrity Engineer and Team Lead in Vancouver, an Integrity Engineer in Mexico City and two Junior Integrity Engineers in Toronto and Calgary. The team is part of our Data Analysis (DA) department.

Together the team delivers integrity reports for clients around the globe. You will be in daily contact with your teammates. The atmosphere is informal, communication is clear and transparent, and the pace follows the workload: some weeks are calm, others are full on. As the first team member in Europe, you strengthen our coverage of European time zones and clients.

Why this role matters

An inspection delivers a list of findings. For our clients, especially in highly regulated markets, a list of problems without a solution is not enough. That is where you come in. The Integrity team turns inspection results into a complete solution package: assessments, remaining life, and clear recommendations that help operators make well-founded decisions about the continued operation of their systems. In this role you raise the quality and consistency of that package, review the work of junior engineers, and help develop the tools and methods the team relies on.

What your week looks like

Part of your week goes to performing integrity assessments on pipelines, piping, heaters and boilers. The other part goes to supporting business development, developing methods and giving technical support. From day one you will work on Corrosion Growth (CG) reports and Fitness-for-Service (FFS) assessments.

·        Perform Level 1 and Level 2 FFS assessments and advanced Corrosion Growth Analysis (CGA); review or prepare Level 3 FFS assessments where projects require it.

·        Review the work of junior engineers, such as Run Comparison reports, dent strain and bending strain analyses, against the applicable codes and standards.

·        Act as the technical point of contact for project managers and clients on structural integrity questions, and support proposals and client-facing technical activities.

·        Align recommendations with local and national regulations, and build knowledge of codes and standards across jurisdictions.

·        Validate and help develop our in-house engineering tools, and write Python or VBA scripts to automate evaluations based on MFL and UT inspection data.

·        Set up and maintain internal procedures, technical questionnaires and quality checklists so every deliverable meets client and internal standards.

·        Manage several projects at the same time, and flag risks and priorities early.

What you bring

Must-haves

·        A degree in Mechanical and/or Materials (or Metallurgical) Engineering, ideally a combination of both. A Master's degree is a strong plus.

·        At least 5 years of relevant experience in the structural integrity of pressurised equipment, preferably pipelines, including independently performing and reviewing FFS assessments and remaining life calculations.

·        Strong working knowledge of fracture mechanics and corrosion and fatigue damage mechanisms.

·        Working knowledge of API 579 / ASME FFS-1, API 530, ASME B31G, DNV-RP-F101, API 1183, ASME VIII Div. 2 and ASME PCC-2, and of the international regulations for pipeline and pressure equipment integrity.

·        Experience with risk assessments and turning results into clear, actionable recommendations.

·        Strong mathematics and statistics, including probabilistic methods.

·        Programming skills to solve engineering problems, preferably in Python, VBA or MATLAB.

·        Mid to advanced-level training in integrity assessment methods.

·        You write clear, professional technical reports and explain complex topics to both technical and non-technical audiences.

·        You work independently with minimal supervision, keep your agreements, and are flexible with working hours to collaborate with colleagues in Canada and Mexico.

·        You are curious, proactive and a team player who suggests improvements to help the team work better and avoid rework.

Nice-to-haves

·        Hands-on experience with finite element analysis (FEA), preferably ABAQUS.

·        Experience with creep assessment of boilers and heaters.

·        Exposure to Level 3 FFS assessments.

·        Experience with pipeline ILI data analysis (MFL/UT).

·        Experience with client-facing technical activities or proposals.

·        Experience in highly regulated industries.

Why Intero

·        Work that makes a difference. Your recommendations directly determine whether critical pipelines and installations can keep operating safely.

·        Variety. Pipelines, piping, heaters and boilers; FFS Level 1 to 3, corrosion growth, dent strain and more, for clients all over the world.

·        Real influence. You help shape the team's methods, procedures and in-house tools, and see your ideas put into practice.

·        International team, flexible set-up. Daily collaboration with colleagues in Canada and Mexico, remote working from Europe, and once or twice a year a visit to our HQ in Tricht.

·        Growth. Within one to three years you can take on a larger share of Run Comparison and FFS reviews and expand into dent strain analysis.

What we offer

·        A contract for 32-40 hours per week.

·        A competitive salary and benefits package, tailored to the country you're based in. Because pay and conditions vary by location, we'll discuss the details with you personally during the process.

·        Remote working from Europe, or hybrid if you live near one of our offices with available space.

·        Flexible start of the day between 6:00 and 10:00, with occasional early or late meetings to overlap with our North American team.


Application process

1. Introductory interview with our recruiter.
2. Technical interview with our Principal Integrity Engineer and Team Lead.
3. Final interview with Manager and Business Director.
4. Job offer.

We would like the new colleague to start as soon as possible. Interested? Apply via the button below with your CV and a short motivation. For questions, please contact Veroniek Smits, our Corporate Recruiter, at

Personeel en Organisatie

Veiligheid

Kwaliteit, Veiligheid en Milieu

  • Procedures en richtlijnen naleven zoals vastgelegd in het QSE-managementsysteem

Wat bieden wij?

3 redenen om voor deze job te kiezen

  • De job is afwisselend met doorgroeimogelijkheden

Zo ziet je job er uit

Als Assistent Restaurantmanager bij deze fastfoodketen ben jij de onmisbare rechterhand van de manager en draag je bij aan het dagelijks succes van de vestiging.

Jouw job bestaat uit:

  • het opnemen van de eindverantwoordelijkheid bij afwezigheid van de manager

Je draagt kortom bij aan de groei van het restaurant door je enthousiasme en klantgerichtheid, en je bent steeds bereid om operationele uitdagingen aan te pakken.

Dit heb je nodig voor de job

De perfecte Assistant Restaurantmanager herkent zich in onderstaande eigenschappen:

  • je hebt ervaring in horeca
  • je kan terugblikken op een eerste leidinggevende ervaring waarbij je een team moest aansturen
  • je bent enerzijds klantgericht, maar ook een echte teamplayer naar collega's toe
  • je bent energiek, positief en hands-on ingesteld
  • je kan goed plannen, organiseren en motiveren
  • je werkt graag in een afwisselend uurrooster met werkuren tussen 4u 's ochtends en 23u 's avonds
  • je bent bereid om in het weekend te werken, zowel op zaterdag als zondag
De ideale collega is...

De ideale collega is een geboren leider met een passie voor voeding en horeca.

Je hebt zin om te groeien in een leidinggevende functie, waarbij je administratieve taken combineert met operationeel meewerken op de vloer.

Je haalt energie uit een afwisselende job en bent in staat om een team te coachen en aan te sturen. Jij bent een expert in organiseren, delegeren en het nemen van initiatief. Ook onder druk weet je steeds het overzicht te bewaren.

Werken met een variabel uurrooster, inclusief weekends, schrikt jou niet af – integendeel, je geniet van de dynamiek die dit met zich meebrengt.

Je houdt van orde, netheid en zorgt ervoor dat de vestiging er altijd piekfijn uitziet. Je bent nauwkeurig bij het uitvoeren van papier- en kassawerk en weet klanten altijd met een grote glimlach te verwelkomen.

Je volgt samen met de manager de commerciële en financiële resultaten op en bent steeds op zoek naar verbeteringen.

Je steekt graag de handen uit de mouwen en bent flexibel inzetbaar.

Kortom, jij bent een enthousiaste Assistant Restaurantmanager die het verschil maakt.

    En fast rute og et stabilt arbejdsområde.

    Egen lift-bil med plads til 8 paller – klar til hver udfordring 

    Et kollegialt team, der støtter og trækker i samme åg

    Løn i overenskomst og klare rammer for dit arbejde

Våra sällskapspersoner kallas Guldvänner. Vi matchar varje kund med en Guldvän utifrån behov, personlighet och intressen. Målet är en trygg och långsiktig relation.

Guldvän sökes till äldre person i Bromma

Vi söker en Guldvän till en äldre person med demenssjukdom som bor på ett vård- och omsorgsboende i Bromma.

Kunden vill komma ut på promenader, cafébesök, museer och andra utflykter. Kunden använder rullstol och har begränsad förmåga till samtal.

Vi söker dig som är varm, positiv och initiativrik. Du behöver kunna skapa trygghet och gemenskap även när samtalet är begränsat. Du ska trivas med att hitta på aktiviteter och kunna anpassa dig efter kundens dagsform.

Plats: Bromma

Omfattning: 6 timmar per vecka, fördelade på två träffar

Start: Så snart som möjligt

Uppdragets längd: Långsiktigt

Krav för uppdraget

    Ett varmt, positivt och tryggt bemötande.
    Förmåga att skapa gemenskap även utan samtal.
    Förmåga att ta initiativ och genomföra utflykter.
    Trygghet i att följa med personer med kognitiva svårigheter i offentliga miljöer.

Meriterande: Undersköterskeutbildning eller erfarenhet från vård- och omsorgsboende.

Om arbetet som Guldvän

Som Guldvän träffar du samma kund regelbundet. Träffarna anpassas efter kundens behov och önskemål och kan innehålla samtal, promenader, utflykter, musik och andra aktiviteter.

Vi söker dig som är empatisk, lyhörd, pålitlig och ansvarstagande. Du behöver tala god svenska och vilja bygga en långsiktig relation med kunden.

Arbetet passar som extraarbete eller deltidsarbete och kan kombineras med studier, pension eller annan sysselsättning.

Efter godkänd rekrytering blir du en del av Guldtids Guldvänsdatabas och kan matchas med fler kunder. Vi kan inte garantera ett visst antal arbetstimmar.

jobs.title: Head of Product & Growth
jobs.description:
About us

Nordic Fulfillment Group is a fast-growing e-commerce company based in Skövde, Sweden. We export Scandinavian and European goods to customers on more than four continents, through both our webshop and our wholesale channel. We’re now entering our next phase of growth, and we’re looking for the right person to lead it.

The role

As Head of Product & Growth, you’ll own our growth agenda from strategy to execution. You’ll report directly to the CEO, sit on the management team, and play a key part in building our commercial team as we scale.

Location: Skövde, Sweden. The role is based at our office in Skövde, with the option to work partly from home.

Employment: Permanent (tillsvidareanställning), full-time

Start date: By agreement

What you’ll do

    Set and drive the growth strategy: new customer segments, markets, channels and revenue streams
    Own the full customer funnel for our webshop, from acquisition and conversion to retention and repeat purchases
    Grow and develop our wholesale and B2B business
    Lead our expansion into new international markets, taking local regulations and import rules into account
    Build a data-driven culture: define KPIs such as CAC, LTV, AOV, churn and conversion, and run experiments to improve them
    Identify and develop partnerships with brands, suppliers and distributors

Who you are

    Experience leading growth, marketing or commercial functions, ideally in e-commerce or D2C
    A proven track record of scaling revenue, preferably across multiple international markets
    Strong analytical skills, comfortable making decisions based on data
    Strategic yet hands-on, able to set direction and execute yourself in a small, fast-moving team
    Fluent in English, written and spoken

What we offer

    A key leadership role with real influence over the company’s direction
    The chance to shape a company in a strong growth phase
    Competitive salary
    Occupational pension, health insurance, life insurance and occupational injury insurance through private insurance
    Hybrid setup and flexible hours
    Relocation support for candidates moving to Sweden

We welcome applicants from outside the EU and will support the work permit process for the right candidate.

How to apply

Send your CV and a short cover letter to valter@nordicfulfillment.com no later than 8 November 2026. We review applications on an ongoing basis, so don’t wait to apply.

Questions? Contact Valter Johansson at valter@nordicfulfillment.com.

jobs.title: SoC Architect
jobs.description:
Join our cutting-edge start-up adventure!

Who are we?

Join the Revolution in GNSS and IoT Connectivity

At Qualinx, we’re not just building chips, we’re engineering the future fabric of the connected world. As a pioneering semiconductor scale-up, we’re transforming how devices connect, communicate, and operate through our ground-breaking Digital RF technology. Our mission goes beyond ultra-low power GNSS: we’re redefining what’s possible in adaptive, scalable, and intelligent connectivity for the Internet of Things.

Born from deep-tech innovation at TU Delft, our team of visionary engineers and bold thinkers is tackling the toughest challenges in GNSS and IoT, starting with power consumption and expanding into dynamic, context-aware solutions that adapt to any environment or use case. We’ve already achieved what many thought impossible: the world’s most advanced GNSS chipset. But that’s just the beginning.

At Qualinx, we believe that the future of connectivity lies in precision, efficiency, and adaptability. Our ambition is to become the invisible thread that seamlessly interconnects billions of devices: powering a smarter, more responsive world.

What Sets Us Apart

Joining Qualinx is about becoming part of a culture that’s as ambitious as it is authentic. We hold ourselves to high standards, thrive on solving the unexpected, and push boundaries together. But we also know how to enjoy the ride. Our culture is a unique blend of curiosity, team spirit, and a touch of unconventional charm. It’s fast-paced, fun, and grounded in a sober sense of purpose and perspective. Whether we’re deep in design reviews or sharing laughs over lunch, we’re building something meaningful together. At Qualinx, you’re not just contributing to a ground-breaking technology, you’re helping shape a team that’s redefining what it means to work in deep tech.

De uitdaging 
Als Teamleider Brandveiligheid bij Deerns sta jij aan het roer van een groeiend team van specialisten en geef je richting aan de verdere ontwikkeling ervan. Het team bestaat momenteel uit een mix van ervaren experts en talentvolle adviseurs en bevindt zich in een fase van sterke groei. Aan jou de uitdaging om deze groei in goede banen te leiden, het team verder uit te bouwen en te versterken zowel in omvang als in kwaliteit en positionering.

Je combineert strategisch leiderschap met inhoudelijke diepgang en bent bepalend voor de kwaliteit, koers en groei van het team. Je creëert een omgeving waarin professionals excelleren, kennis wordt gedeeld en innovatie wordt gestimuleerd.

Brandveiligheid zit in ieder project. Of het nu gaat om de nieuwbouw van een ziekenhuis, een ‘state of the art’ cleanroom, de bouw van een (houten) woontoren, of de nieuwbouw, renovatie of transformatie van een (multi-tenant) kantoorcomplex.
