jobs.title: Head of Technology
jobs.description:
We are hiring a Head of Technology for the garden3d creative collective, to lead engineering at Sanctuary Computer and garden3d in the era of agentic computer code.

Original job posting link

About garden3d

We are worker owned creative collective, innovating on everything from brands and IRL communities to IoT devices and cross platform apps. We share profit, open source everything, spin out new businesses, and invest in exciting ideas through financial and/or in-kind contributions.

Our client roster includes Google, Stripe, Figma, Hinge, Black Socialists in America, ACLU, Pratt, Parsons, Mozilla, The Nobel Prize, MIT, Gnosis, Etsy & Gagosian.

Weâre the software team behind innovative products like The Light Phone & Mill, and we operate a global, decentralized community space collective called Index Space.

We think of our garden3d as collective for creative people, prioritizing a happy, talented, and diverse studio culture. We work on projects that bring value to our world, and we balance deep care for the work we do with a genuine curiosity about life outside of our jobs.

Sanctuary Computer - Development

At Sanctuary Computer weâre building a different type of technology shop â one that prioritizes close collaboration between the client and the craftsperson.

Our projects range from design-forward websites, to robust web apps, to native mobile development.

XXIX - Design

When we started XXIX in 2013, we set out to create a different kind of design studio and weâve thrived because we continually ask what a creative practice can be.

Weâre building a radically different kind of organization that values autonomy, growth, transparency, and shared responsibility.

Index - Community

Index is network of physical spaces all around the world, Index provides space for the exchange of knowledge and tools.

We nurture trust within the creative community through generosity and abundance of ideas and care.

garden3d TK â Media

At garden3d, weâre in the early stages of building an experimental media company exploring emerging themes related to the evolving landscape of technology, design and culture.

We aim to monetize this outlet, publish books, produce screenplays, and release music.

Plus, our partner organizations

Lightphone
Mill
IngredientAI

â°ï¸ The Head of Technology Role

The garden3d Head of Technology has one mandate: everything we build works, holds up in production, and gets built the smartest way available to us. We are a house of brands - Sanctuary Computer (development), XXIX (design), Index Space (community), USB Club (digital community), and the garden3d umbrella itself - and a lot of what all of them ship runs on software we wrote. Working in close partnership with our founder & president Hugh Francis, this person sets the engineering standard, and builds the culture that holds it.

You can be based anywhere. A lot of our people are in New York and there's some gravity here, but we already work across timezones and we would happily hire in Europe, Singapore, Chicago, or wherever you are. If you're the right person, we want to hear from you.

This role works with studio leads, developers, designers, project managers and clients across every garden3d vertical.

This person can move between a Rails migration, a Next.js app, a firmware release plan and an agent loop in the same week, and raise the bar on each of them.

They span all of garden3d, but their home base is Sanctuary Computer, where roughly 70% of their time goes. Our development studio is where the engineering standard gets set, and where it either holds or slips: architecture, code review, estimation, and the hardest technical calls on our biggest projects. The other 30% goes to garden3d's broader technology story: how we ship product for USB Club, build with agents across the collective, which tools and platforms we bet on, and what we build for ourselves.

They are also how we get better people. Our work is only as good as the engineers making it, so this person hunts for exceptional talent, sells them on us, and sets them up to do the best work of their careers. The ideal candidate looks at a worker-owned collective with four studios, an open P&L and clients like Google, Stripe, Brooklyn Museum and The Nobel Prize, and sees an engineering practice they can propel among the best in the world.

Responsibilities & Mandates

ï¸ Systems that hold up

We build web apps, native apps, data pipelines, content platforms and connected devices for clients who can't afford for them to fall over. This person has engineered complex systems for a long time, and it shows in the architecture they draw before a line is written. They own the technical blueprint on our most important projects, and they make the hard calls on the rest: what to build, what to buy, and what to leave out.

All in on agentic development

The way software gets built changed, and we intend to be ahead of it. This person is already deep in it: loop engineering, agents running against evals, agents that open their own PRs, and the guardrails that make all of that trustworthy. They make agentic development the default way Sanctuary Computer works, and they can tell the difference between a demo and a system a team can rely on.

Practical engineering

We strongly prefer convention over configuration, boring technology, and platforms that let a small team ship a lot. TypeScript is the default language, Rails and Phoenix handle what they're best at, and we'd rather deploy to a platform like Render or Heroku than run our own infrastructure. This person practices value engineering: the simplest thing that works, built well, at a cost the client is glad to pay.

Code quality at Sanctuary Computer

Sanctuary Computer is where our engineering standard lives, so this is where most of their energy goes. They set what good code review looks like, keep our senior developers sharp on architecture and quality, and make sure that bar holds without slowing the team down.

Hiring and empowering the very best

They are a magnet for exceptional engineers. They know where to find them, how to convince them, and how to give them enough room to do their best work while still holding them to the standard. People who work for this person should get visibly better, and should say so.

Estimation, scoping and delivery

They make sure our teams can reliably estimate and story point the work ahead, and that we deliver at a pace that meets the dates we promised and protects our margins. When an estimate is wrong, they find out why and fix the process.

The technical voice in new business

Our clients include Google, Stripe, Figma, Mozilla and The Nobel Prize. This person joins new business calls as the trusted technical consultant, scopes the work, writes the technical side of proposals, and can explain a hard tradeoff to a client's CTO and their CEO in the same meeting.

Hardware sense

We're the software team behind The Light Phone and Mill, so a good share of our work touches devices. This person doesn't need to be a firmware engineer, but they understand how hardware works, where it constrains the software, and how to plan a project that spans both.

The garden3d technology story

Across the collective, they decide which tools and platforms we bet on, how every studio uses agents, and which internal tools are worth turning into products. When someone at garden3d asks "how should we build this?", this person has the answer, or knows who does.

Culture

They model garden3d's values of partnership, curiosity, and accountability. The engineers they lead do the best work of their careers here, because the feedback is honest, the recognition is earned, and the craft rubs off

Â Special Projects

In addition to day to day responsibilities, hereâs an idea of some of the projects this role may spearhead or support in coming years â

  • Making agentic development the default way Sanctuary Computer builds, with loops and evals the whole team trusts
  • Setting the shared technical conventions every garden3d studio builds from
  • Landing the kind of flagship engineering engagement that changes what people think we do
  • Hiring the next generation of the engineering team, across every garden3d studio
  • Turning the internal tools and agents we build for ourselves into products
  • Partnering with the Head of Design so our own studio websites are as well engineered as they are designed

Qualifications

This is a great opportunity for someone looking to make a significant impact in a growing, dynamic company. Based on the responsibilities of this role, we think the right candidate has the following experience and skills:

Must have:

  • 12+ years building software, at least three of them leading engineers inside a studio, agency, startup or founder-led company
  • Deep experience engineering complex systems, shipped and run in production: distributed services, data pipelines, multi-platform products
  • A true technology generalist, comfortable across frontend, backend, data, infrastructure and native
  • A strong preference for practical engineering: convention over configuration, boring technology, and platforms as a service over bespoke infrastructure
  • All in on agentic development: loop engineering, evals, and agents doing real work in a real codebase
  • Fluency across most of our stack: React, Next.js, Ruby on Rails, Elixir & Phoenix, Sanity, Postgres, Redis. You won't use all of it every week, but you should be able to review any of it
  • Experience as the technical lead in winning work: scoping, estimating and pitching to clients
  • A track record of hiring exceptional engineers, and of people who got measurably better working for them
  • Hands-on. This person can still write the code, not only review it (and will get on the tools when the need arises)

Nice-to-have:

  • A sense of how hardware works: firmware, embedded systems, IoT, and shipping software for physical products
  • Experience in a client services environment (a consultancy, agency or studio)
  • Experience in a Sales Engineer or Solutions Architect role
  • Open source projects they've started or maintained
  • Experience fostering close collaboration between design and engineering teams
  • Experience inside a worker-owned, open-book, or otherwise unusual company
  • A network in the engineering community: the meetups, the conferences, the people worth hiring
  • Interests in design, art, music, food or fashion. We find these people have a well rounded sense of quality

Who you are

The person weâre looking for is happy, relaxed and easy to get along with and appreciates a commitment to a culture of transparency, non-dictatorial leadership styles, and alternative methodologies. Theyâre flexible on anything except conceits that will lower their usually outstanding work quality. They work âsmartâ by carefully managing their workflow and team.

How we interview

After you submit your application, a member of our team will reach out. Our interview process starts with an intro call to answer any questions you have about the role and to learn a bit more about your experience and interests.

From there, weâll follow up with a panel interview call where you get to meet a few members of our team, to openly discuss some of our challenges and ensure your skills and interests align with where weâre going as a business.

For qualified candidates, the process wraps with a reference call, and an offer to follow.

Compensation

This is a permanent leadership role. If this individual exceeds expectations in their first four months, we'll shape the permanent role together, with scope and compensation that grow as the studios and their revenue do. After a period of proven success (12 - 24 months), they become eligible to join our worker ownership program.

We start with a 4-month fraction trial contract, paid hourly between $110 - $175 p/hr pending seniority & experience. In the first few weeks of the trial, this individual will propose their own goals to define success in their trial, and present them to our leadership team for approval.

At garden3d, we believe that those who shoulder the most responsibility and create the greatest impact should be paid accordingly. This role greatly favors autonomous, competent & ambitious operators.

â How we work:

We believe that thereâs a better balance between the poles of freelancing & full time, and for that reason we work differently to most shops:

  • Transparency & Ownership:Â We release out Profit & Loss statements to the community each year, open source our best ideas, and talk business & money with everyone in the company. Weâre proud to run our business with integrity, and for that reason we share everything with our team & community.
  • 150% Carbon Negative: Our studio offsets 150% of the carbon we use to do business each year, dated back to our founding in 2015. We turn down work that is not in-line with our morals, and we encourage our peers to do the same. We have been certified climate neutral since 2021.
  • Strong Morals: Since our founding, we've turned down somewhere between $1mm - $2mm of work that didn't meet our moral standards. (Most of that was DTC brands that can't show a valid sustainability initiative).
  • Async & Decentralized: We use tools optimized for calm, thoughtful communication, and opt for async whenever possible. We fight hard to maintain our focus time.
  • Remote Friendly:Â Our company is fluent in remote work, making our workplace more decentralized, and democratized in the process.
  • Ideas & Products:Â In our spare studio time, we work to build our own open source or internal products to diversify & bolster our income. We create amazing technology products for our clients, so why not for the studio?

â Read more on our Substack, over here.

How to apply

Weâre excited to hear from you! â¤

Kindly submit a complete and thoughtful application, including relevant links that help verify your work experience and identity. Applications with missing or insufficient information will not move forward in the review process.

Our team carefully reviews every complete submission, and we truly appreciate the time and effort you put into applying! :)

jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day

Join us in shaping the future of gas turbine technology. In this role, you will combine fluid mechanics, heat transfer and engineering judgement to develop secondary air systems and whole-engine models that improve performance, reliability and sustainability. You will work in a supportive international team where collaboration, curiosity and different perspectives are valued.

Your days will be varied: you may analyse a design, improve an in-house calculation tool, discuss test results with colleagues or support a technical investigation. You do not need to know every aspect of the role from day one. We will support your development through knowledge sharing, collaboration and opportunities to deepen your expertise.

How You’ll Make an Impact

    Design and analyze secondary air systems and whole-engine models using in-house and established engineering tools.
    Contribute to the development of new and existing gas turbine products, methods and calculation tools.
    Collaborate across disciplines and locations to create robust, efficient and cost-effective solutions.
    Plan and evaluate gas turbine and laboratory tests, turning results into practical engineering improvements.
    Support technical investigations and help identify root causes and effective solutions.
    Share knowledge, contribute ideas and help strengthen the team’s collective expertise.
    Provide technical support to colleagues in manufacturing, purchasing, sales and service.

What You Bring

We are looking for someone who enjoys solving technical problems with others and is motivated to keep learning. You may be a strong match if you bring:

    A master’s degree in mechanical engineering, aerospace engineering, engineering physics, or a related field is required. Doctoral studies are welcome but not required.
    A foundation in fluid mechanics and heat transfer, gained through studies, research or professional experience.
    An analytical and structured approach to problem-solving.
    Using and developing in-house tools complemented by CFD tools.
    The ability to communicate and collaborate in English in an international environment.

Experience with gas turbines, secondary air systems, whole-engine models or test evaluation is an advantage, but it is not essential. If the role interests you and your experience does not match every point, we still encourage you to apply. Your transferable skills, perspective and motivation may be exactly what our team needs.

You will join an experienced, international team in Finspång and India working with aerodynamics and secondary air systems. We support one another, share knowledge and welcome questions and new ideas. We believe that different experiences and perspectives lead to better engineering decisions, stronger collaboration and more innovative solutions.

We are committed to an inclusive working environment where everyone has an equal opportunity to contribute, develop and succeed. We value sustainable ways of working, open communication and flexibility where the role allows. We especially welcome applications from people who are currently underrepresented in engineering and technology.

Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.

jobs.title: Sales Manager, Parts and Services - Central & Northern Europe / Normet
jobs.description:
Normet is now seeking a Sales Manager to drive parts and services revenue growth and manage key customer relationships across the European mining and tunneling sector. If you are an expert within the mining sector and sales, love to travel and eager to take the next challenge in your career, don't hesitate to apply!

About the role

The Sales Manager serves as the primary point of contact for customers and is responsible for driving parts and services sales and revenue growth by maintaining and expanding existing accounts. As an active account management team member, you need to pay special attention to inventory planning, parts consumption, training, and service requirements at the mine and tunneling site level.

What we offer?

    Key role in industry growth: A pivotal position driving Normet’s parts and services expansion across the European mining and tunneling sector.
    International environment & dynamic travel: Work with diverse European clients and cross-functional teams, traveling up to 75% to key customer sites in central- and northern Europe.
    Impact & ownership: Full accountability for key account planning, TCO modeling, and developing tailored customer solutions.
    Collaborative culture: Close synergy with Service, Equipment Sales, and technical support teams across local and international offices.

Work tasks

Key responsibilities involve

Business Growth and Functional

    Execution of the sales strategy for parts and services, growth within current and new customer base; responsible for leading and delivering on customer-specific monthly revenue targets.
    Active management in customer planning with spare parts, consumption levels, and portfolio offerings available within Normet. Identify gaps in customer purchasing behavior and work to create solutions to penetrate new sales.
    Active involvement with recommended spare parts kits and total cost of ownership modeling, pursuit of rental and used equipment opportunities.
    Lead on-site review meetings (monthly/quarterly as needed) with regular site visits and interactions.
    Address technical inquiries, on-site spare parts management reviews with recommended adjustments, review equipment performance and identify upgrades.
    Provide feedback for engineering and production regarding quality, parts reliability, and service with an understanding of bringing forward the voice of the customer.
    Active sales opportunity pipeline and customer fleet data management within Normet systems.

Financials

    Assist with forecasting, aligned with expected growth and actual order intake.
    Responsible for developing and executing the sales plan in a profitable and accountable fashion.
    Follow up on accounts receivables of orders as required.

Collaboration and Customer Relations

    Proactive customer focus to positively support the growth of Normet.
    Work alongside with Service Manager and Service teams to manage regional accounts.
    Coordinate with the local / international Normet order processing and technical teams.
    Collaborate closely with the Equipment Sales team throughout the sales process to identify future capital and after-sales opportunities.
    Develop and collect market knowledge. Identify and review the competition and relay this information to the Normet Sales and Service Teams.

We are looking for

    A minimum of 5 years’ experience in mining and aftermarket sales support. Account Management experience is considered an advantage.
    Excellence in written and verbal communication in English. Other Central and/or Northern European languages are seen as benefit.
    Willingness to travel up to 75% of working time within Europe.
    Experience with MS Office Suite, CRM systems, and sales analytics tools.
    Budget/forecasting skills.
    Capacity to operate in a demanding environment with competing priorities.
    Strong negotiation, communication, and presentation skills.
    An elevated level of responsiveness, organization, and interpersonal skills.
    Detail orientation, financial acumen and a strong command of sales tools and account management.

Other Information

    Permanent and fulltime position.
    Travel up to 75% of working time within Europe. Your home office could be in Sweden, Norway or Austria.
    Start: as soos as possible.

Our recruitment process

This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our client’s wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.

Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

jobs.title: KOTA CHEF – TRADITIONAL FINNISH CAMPFIRE COOKING
jobs.description:
**Levi, Finnish Lapland | Winter Season 2026–2027**

**Scandinavian Travel Group (STG) – Safarimarket** is looking for an experienced Kota Chef to join our winter team in Levi.

You will prepare and serve traditional Finnish food and drinks at our outdoor venues, including cosy wooden kotas, snow igloos and Arctic wilderness camps in Levi and occasionally Rovaniemi.

This is a hands-on, guest-facing role for someone who enjoys cooking over an open fire, sharing Finnish food traditions and creating a welcoming atmosphere for visitors from around the world.

The position is **part-time, approximately 20–30 hours per week**, with daytime and evening shifts depending on guest bookings. It is a great opportunity to combine work with skiing, outdoor activities and winter life in Lapland.

**YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES**

- Prepare food in advance at our company kitchen, including soups, berry jams, Finnish pancake batter and other simple dishes.

- Cook and serve traditional Finnish food over an open fire in our kotas, including _lettu_ (Finnish pancakes), warm _leipäjuusto_ (Finnish squeaky cheese) and grilled sausages.

- Prepare coffee and traditional pot-brewed tea over the fire.

- Welcome guests, introduce the dishes and share Finnish food traditions in a friendly, engaging way.

- Set up the cooking and dining areas before programs, ensuring everything is ready for groups of approximately 10–20 guests.

- Follow established recipes and menus, with opportunities to suggest improvements.

- Manage food storage, ingredient stocks and kitchen supplies, coordinating purchasing needs with the office.

- Handle cleaning, hygiene and proper food storage at both the kitchen and outdoor venues.


**WHAT WE EXPECT**

- **Previous practical experience cooking over an open fire in a Finnish kota is required.**

- Experience in hospitality, catering or customer service, with confidence interacting with international guests.

- **Valid Finnish Hygiene Passport (Hygieniapassi).**

- Good conversational English; Finnish and other languages are an advantage.

- **Valid Category B driving licence** and willingness to drive company vehicles between venues, transporting food and equipment when needed.

- Good organisational skills and the ability to work independently.

- A friendly, reliable and service-minded attitude.

- Readiness to work outdoors in cold winter conditions, including evening shifts.


**WHAT WE OFFER**

- Seasonal position from **1 November 2026 to 31 March 2027**.

- Part-time work, approximately **20–30 hours per week**, with shifts based on guest programs.

- Hourly pay, agreed individually based on experience.

- Fixed-term seasonal employment or the possibility of working as a self-employed contractor.

- Winter work clothing, necessary equipment and training.

- Additional leisure-time accident insurance and limited additional healthcare through Pihlajalinna for eligible employees.

- Staff accommodation in Levi available at **€400 per person/month + electricity**.

- A friendly international team and the opportunity to enjoy Lapland's winter lifestyle alongside your work.


**HOW TO APPLY**

Send your CV and a short introduction describing your **campfire cooking, hospitality and customer service experience** to **hr@gostg.fi**.

**Applications are open until the position is filled.**

Join our team and help us share the warmth, flavours and traditions of Finnish Lapland with our guests!

jobs.title: Strategic Account Executive - San Francisco
Personlig assistent till ung kvinna i Umeå  fast schemarad
jobs.description:
Om Provide Assistans. Vi är ett familjärt företag inom personlig assistans som är verksamma i Västerbotten. Vi hjälper människor, som är beviljad personlig assistans, att utifrån sina behov och önskemål kunna leva ett så rikt liv som man vill och kan. Våra grundvärderingar är inflytande, omtanke och kunskap. Dessa styr vår verksamhet i grunden och gör oss till det vi är. Det guidar såväl företaget som våra medarbetares vardag i mötet med kunder, samarbetspartners och kollegor. Vi tycker det är viktigt med hållbarhet, inkludering och jämställdhet. Vi vill definitivt vara med och bidra till en hållbar utveckling och göra vad vi kan för att minska vår egen klimatpåverkan genom att påverka de vi möter i vår egen verksamhet samt i vår närhet.

Vi söker nu dig som vill vara med och skapa en varm, trygg och glädjefylld vardag för en ung kvinna i Umeå. Hon tycker om musik, dans, god mat, att resa men också lugnare stunder med pyssel eller annat. Din roll blir att stötta henne i att fortsätta med det som får henne att må bra – rörelse, gemenskap, upplevelser och små stunder av vardagsglädje.



Stödet handlar mycket om att vara lyhörd, närvarande och att bygga en trygg relation. Du kommer att hjälpa henne i kommunikationen och få möjlighet att lära dig förstå hennes sätt att uttrycka tankar, känslor och önskemål. Tillsammans får ni träna och utveckla kommunikationen i vardagen, vilket är en viktig del av uppdraget och hennes möjlighet till delaktighet och självbestämmande.



I rollen ingår även viss hjälp med personlig hygien, så det är viktigt att du känner dig bekväm med det. Hon har daglig verksamhet på vardagar, vilket innebär att arbetspassen främst är förlagda till andra tider. När du arbetar hos henne är du den som bidrar med lugn, trygghet, struktur och ett positivt bemötande.

Om tjänsten

    Fast schemarad på ca 40 %
    Arbetspass förlagda till dag, kväll och natt med sovande jour
    Utdrag ur belastningsregistret kommer att begäras innan anställning

Vi tror att du:

    Är varm, lyhörd och uppmärksam på individens behov
    Tycker om att skapa delaktighet och uppmuntra till aktiviteter som ger glädje och livskvalitet
    Har tålamod och tycker att det är givande att utveckla kommunikation och samspel tillsammans med en annan person
    Är trygg, ansvarstagande och engagerad

Önskade kvalifikationer

    Är varm, lyhörd och trygg i mötet med andra människor
    Har tålamod och tycker om att bygga relationer
    Tycker om att skapa glädje, delaktighet och meningsfulla aktiviteter i vardagen
    Har goda kunskaper i svenska, både i tal och skrift

Meriterande:

    Erfarenhet av personlig assistans, omsorg eller liknande arbete
    Erfarenhet av AKK eller andra kommunikationsstöd

Övrig information:

    I det här uppdraget söker vi en kvinnlig assistent och stor vikt läggs vid personlig lämplighet.
    Du behöver inte ha körkort!
    Tillträde: Omgående, inskolning sker på studs.
    Vi tillämpar individuell lönesättning och har kollektivavtal. Intervjuer sker löpande och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag.

Vid frågor om tjänsten, är du varmt välkommen att kontakta: Andreas Elveljung, kundansvarig via info@provideassistans.se alternativt via 070-2929319.

Varmt välkommen med din ansökan innehållande ett cv samt ett personligt brev.

jobs.title: Regional Sales Director - France
Validation Engineer Sterilization (MS&T)
jobs.description:
At Galderma, we are advancing dermatology for every skin story. We are now looking for a highly experienced Validation Engineer Sterilization to join our MS&T team in Uppsala. This is a key role for someone who wants to combine deep technical expertise with cross-functional collaboration in a highly regulated manufacturing environment.

In this position, you will act as the subject matter expert for sterilization processes with a particular focus on autoclaves with moist heat sterilization and VHP (Vaporized Hydrogen Peroxide) decontamination systems.

You will play a critical role in ensuring that sterilization processes remain compliant, scientifically sound, and in a validated state throughout the product lifecycle, supporting patient safety and product quality.

The Role

As Validation Engineer Sterilization, you will lead and drive validation and qualification activities across sterilization systems and processes. Working closely with Manufacturing, Engineering, Quality, and other stakeholders, you will provide technical leadership and ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and industry best practices.

Your responsibilities will include:

    Acting as the SME for autoclave-based moist heat sterilization and VHP decontamination of isolators and controlled environments.

    Leading autoclave cycle development, qualification, and validation activities for equipment, components, and finished products.

    Planning and executing equipment qualification and process validation activities, including IQ/OQ/PQ.

    Maintaining sterilization cycle parameters, load configurations, and process definitions.

    Driving requalification programs and lifecycle management of validated systems.

    Performing thermal mapping, heat penetration studies, biological indicator evaluations, and cold spot identification.

    Establishing and maintaining scientifically justified sterilization cycles aligned with regulatory expectations.

    Authoring, reviewing, and approving validation protocols, reports, risk assessments, deviations, CAPAs, and change controls.

Who You Are

We are looking for a technically strong and quality-focused professional who thrives in a collaborative environment. You enjoy solving complex problems, influencing stakeholders, and driving activities from concept through execution while maintaining a strong compliance mindset.

To be successful in this role, you bring:

    A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Chemistry, Biochemistry, Biotechnology, Pharmaceutical Sciences, or a related field.

    Approximately 10 years or more of relevant experience within qualification and validation in a GMP-regulated environment.

    Demonstrated expertise in moist heat sterilization, autoclave validation, and sterilization science.

    Experience with VHP decontamination systems and controlled manufacturing environments.

    Strong knowledge of validation methodologies, qualification activities, and lifecycle validation.

    Solid understanding of cGMP requirements and regulatory expectations.

    Excellent technical writing, documentation, communication, and collaboration skills.

    Strong analytical abilities with experience in root cause analysis and risk-based decision making.

Experience from pharmaceutical, biopharmaceutical, medical device, or other regulated manufacturing environments is highly valued.

Please note, applications will be reviewed continuously and we may fill the position before the closing date, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

Why Galderma?

At Galderma, you'll have the opportunity to work in a company dedicated to innovation, quality, and improving patient outcomes. You will join a collaborative and science-driven environment where your expertise will have a direct impact on product quality, operational excellence, and the future growth of our Uppsala site.

We look forward to hearing from you.

jobs.title: Renovasjonssjåfør
jobs.description:
NordRen AS department Asker

We are looking for:

• Motivated individuals who are solution-oriented, have experience driving a truck and enjoy being physically active while working. You must enjoy working outdoors, regardless of weather conditions.

• Hold a valid Class C driving licence and a valid Driver CPC/CAP (Code 95). Be ready to operate our truck with precision and responsibility.

• Good language skills in English. You must be able to participate in an online interview in English.

• Digital skills – Comfortable using maps on a tablet in the trucks.

Work tasks:

• Collection and transport of household waste on established routes. With maps on pad in the trucks.

• Responsibility for the truck, including weekly washing and weekly/daily maintenance according to routines.

• Monitoring of waste sorting and discrepancy recording.

• Communicating with and guiding customers when necessary.

• Other tasks typically associated with the waste collection profession.

We offer:

• Environmentally conscious: NordRen AS is committed to contributing to a sustainable future. As one of Norway's leading companies in waste management, we are proud of our environmental focus and our commitment to waste sorting.

• Secure workplace: Join a company that has experienced steady growth since its establishment in 2013. NordRen AS offers you the opportunity to help shape the future of waste management.

• Performing a socially beneficial and socially critical service.

• Gain valuable experience in handling challenging situations in traffic.

• Varied workday.

• 7.5-hour workday during daytime (06:00-13:30) Rotational work or shift work is not possible.

• Secure job with Class C License.

• Annual salary from NOK 516 750- 528 450, - (€ 48 249 – 49 342) depending on experience.

• NordRen covers further education (35 hours) related to CPC.

• NordRen can help with accommodation for a period 3-6 months. (Considering the location and working hours, having your own car is an advantage.)

• NordRen covers Norwegian language courses (A2) after 3 months of employment.

How to apply:

Send CV and application letter to: rekruttering@nordren.no.

Please mark the application with Department Asker

Om arbeidsgiveren:

In NordRen departement Asker, we have 23 trucks. Some are small Volvo and Iveco single-operator trucks, while the larger ones are Scania three-axle trucks with two-person crews. The trucks have two compartments: One for paper and one for plastic, one for food and one for residual waste.

Each two-person crew handles between 300 and 350 stops per day, meaning they empty around 600–700 bins daily. All bins are equipped with RFID chips, which are scanned by antennas on the lifting mechanism during collection. This records the chip number, time of collection, and waste type and kilos of waste

We empty approximately 1.8 million waste containers on an annual basis.

On average, we empty about 7000 - 7500 containers per day, totaling around 36 000 containers per week.

jobs.title: Product Sourcing Leader
jobs.description:
Inter IKEA Group connects IKEA franchisees with range development and suppliers and ensures alignment of the overall IKEA strategic direction. Every day, we strive to develop, produce, and sell products and services that are affordable and accessible to everyone.

In Purchasing Development, we bring IKEA products to life by working closely with suppliers and partners. Together, we turn designs into real, affordable and responsibly produced products. We secure IWAY requirements, improve materials, strengthen sourcing and keep costs low while helping the IKEA value chain stand strong when the world changes.

Within Purchasing Development, Category Area Food is part of the Food total value chain transformation. We are creating simpler and more connected ways of working, with clearer ownership and faster decisions closer to where value is created for our customers. For sourcing, this means using supplier competence earlier, reducing handovers and creating stronger conditions for speed, availability, affordability and growth.

We are now looking for 3 Product Sourcing Leaders who wants to help shape the next chapter of IKEA Food sourcing. In this role, you will connect product development, supplier capability and sourcing optimisation, from early development ideas to sourcing implementation.

Food operates in an industry with short shelf life, strong requirements on freshness, quality and food safety, and a supplier landscape that calls for both strategic partnerships and simpler sourcing solutions. You will bring fact-based sourcing input early, support clear choices and help create feasible, cost-conscious sourcing setups that work in real business life.

Job Description

As Product Sourcing Leader, you will lead sourcing and supplier capability input to product development and portfolio planning. You will support the move towards a more industry-fit sourcing setup by evaluating supplier options, deciding on development suppliers and securing sourcing readiness for news, moves, improves, launches, changes and market expansion.

Your home base will be a dedicated development team, while you also collaborate across development teams within your assigned segment. You will work closely with Range Areas, Category business teams, Regional Sourcing Specialists, Supply Chain and suppliers to align priorities, plan sourcing activities and follow up segment, sourcing and supplier-base performance.

In this role, you will:

    Lead sourcing and supplier capability input to product development and portfolio planning.
    Use supplier competence early to secure realistic product development, cost and availability preconditions.
    Provide sourcing expertise to development teams, decide on development suppliers and secure early supplier alignment and production feasibility.
    Evaluate sourcing alternatives, including strategic partnerships and simpler sourcing solutions where relevant.
    Secure implementation and on-time sales start together with business teams.
    Coordinate product development agreements and sourcing readiness for launches, changes and market expansion.
    Lead creation and implementation of segment sourcing strategies in line with Category Business Plans and Purchasing Development Plans.
    Identify supplier capability gaps, consolidation opportunities and sourcing setups that support speed, affordability and availability.
    Lead or coordinate RFQs, RFPs and RFIs together with Regional Sourcing Specialists when needed.
    Drive fact-based decisions through data, risk assessment, scenario planning and clear prioritisation.

Qualifications

We are looking for someone who:

    Has experience in product development, sourcing, purchasing development, supplier development or food sourcing.
    Understands the Food business context and how sourcing choices affect quality, food safety, speed, availability, affordability and growth.
    Has strong knowledge of sourcing strategy, supplier capability and sourcing implementation.
    Understands product development, portfolio planning and how sourcing input affects feasibility, cost and readiness.
    Has good understanding of supplier capability, materials, production techniques and sourcing alternatives.
    Uses supplier, cost, risk and performance data to create insight, assess scenarios and support clear decisions.
    Can influence and coordinate stakeholders across category, range and development, supply chain and supplier interfaces.
    Communicates clearly in English and can connect different perspectives into practical sourcing outcomes.

At IKEA, strong sourcing helps good ideas become affordable, sustainable and relevant food products for the many people. As Product Sourcing Leader in Food, your work will help us strengthen sourcing readiness, use supplier capability earlier and support faster product development from idea to implementation.

You will be part of strengthening the Food value chain by working close to colleagues across Purchasing Development, Category Area Food, Range Areas, regional sourcing teams and Supply Chain. Together, we reduce complexity, make sourcing choices clearer and create the conditions for better growth at lower cost.

To succeed in this role, we believe you are curious about how products, suppliers and the total Food value chain connect. You enjoy creating clarity when many needs meet, and you are comfortable making choices based on facts, risks and business priorities. jobs.title: Rotor Dynamics and Vibration Engineer
jobs.description:
Job Description: Rotor Dynamics and Vibration Engineer



Join us as a Rotor Dynamics Engineer and help shape the next generation of gas turbines, heat pumps, and selected steam turbine applications. Your analysis and engineering judgement will directly influence product reliability, efficiency, and performance.



A Snapshot of Your Day



You will improve engineering methods, develop practical analysis tools, and turn complex rotor-dynamic challenges into better products. Working closely with experienced colleagues across several disciplines, you will contribute throughout the development cycle—from early concepts and simulation to testing and product support.



How You’ll Make an Impact



    Have responsibility over the design and evaluation of the rotor and stator structure of robust, reliable, and highly efficient turbomachinery engines by using in-house developed and commercial software.
    Be a part of the whole engine development process starting from the concept design of engines to the test evaluation and further behavior in the product’s life cycle.
    Be responsible to drive the innovation and technology within the field of rotor and structural dynamics.
    As part of a global organization, you will have the opportunity to build a network that expands across the world, from Europe to North America and Asia. On top of that, your multi-disciplinary collaborations will, for example, include Mechanical Design, Mechanical Integrity, Test department and Manufacturing.



What You Bring



    A master’s degree or PhD in mechanical engineering, aerospace engineering, engineering physics, or a related field.
    Knowledge of and a strong interest in structural dynamics.
    Experience in rotor dynamics is highly desirable.
    Knowledge of finite element analysis, mechanical integrity, mechanical design, tribology, or related areas is an advantage.
    Experience with engineering tools such as Abaqus, Simcenter 3D, MATLAB, Python, or equivalent software is beneficial.
    A proactive and committed approach to analysing and resolving technical challenges.
    The ability to work across disciplines, both independently and as part of a team, while contributing to effective and efficient delivery.
    Proficiency in English is required; Swedish is an advantage.



We welcome applicants ranging from early-career engineers to experienced specialists. This role provides opportunities to develop technical expertise, contribute to engineering methods and tools, and work with challenging dynamics problems across a broad range of products.



About the Team



You will join a diverse R&D group of 14 highly skilled engineers specializing in rotor dynamics and aeromechanics. We work closely together and bring a wide range of backgrounds and experience to the team. As part of an R&D organization of nearly 300 people, you will have access to a unique breadth of expertise as we work together to develop world-class gas turbines.

jobs.description:
Etsimme automekaanikkoa vakituiseen työsuhteeseen Paraisille! Asiakasyrityksemme on ollut toiminnassa jo yli kolmen vuosikymmenen ja he tarjoavat monipuolisesti palveluitaan liittyen ajoneuvojen huolto- ja korjauspalveluihin. Laadun takeena heillä on eri automerkkien sekä nykypäivän standardien monipuolinen ja pitkä tuntemus.

Tehtävässä keskityt tekemään ajoneuvojen huolto- ja korjaustehtäviä bensiini-, diesel-, hybrid- ja sähköautoille, on sitten kyseessä avustavat tai haastavemmat tehtävät. Työpäiviisi voi sisältyä esim. lisävarusteasennuksia, vikojen etsintää, alustatöitä, sähköistyksiä, moottorin korjauksia, vaihteistotöitä, jarrutöitä tai sitten yksinkertaisempia määräaikaishuoltoja kuten öljyjen ja suodattimien vaihdot sekä paljon muuta. Töitä tehdään asiakasyrityksen toimipisteellä ma-pe klo 8-16 ja 37,5h/viikko. Kuuntelemme palkkatoiveita, joten voit halutessasi esittää toiveesi hakemuksen yhteydessä.

Mitä toivomme sinulta?

\- B-ajokorttia ja SFS 6002 sähkötyöturvallisuuskorttia.

\- Olet suorittanut tehtävään soveltuvan koulutuksen ja sinulla on aikaisempaa työkokemusta vastaavista työtehtävistä sekä omaat monipuolisen merkkituntemuksen.

\- Tärkeänä pidämme myös kykyä sitoutua työhön, halua oppia ja omaksua uusia asioita, pitkäjänteisyyttä, ongelmanratkaisu- ja asiakaspalvelutaitoja, kädentaitoja, joustavuutta sekä itsenäistä, rehtiä ja ammattimaista työskentelyotetta.

Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?

\- Ammattitaitoisen yhteyshenkilön.

\- Palkanmaksun kahden viikon välein.

\- Lakisääteistä kattavamman työterveyshuollon ensimmäisestä päivästä alkaen.

\- Työn edellyttämän vaatetuksen, sekä tarvittaessa avustamme SFS 6002 sähkötyöturvallisuuskortin hankinnassa.

Paikka täytetään sopivan henkilön löydyttyä ja työt alkavat sopimuksen mukaan. Täytä hakemuksesi ohessa olevan linkin kautta ja kerro siinä mahdollisimman kattavasti itsestäsi, osaamisestasi sekä aikaisemmasta työkokemuksestasi. jobs.title: Production Worker - Nakskov (Day/night)
jobs.description:
Would you like to help ensure a more sustainable future? Vestas is currently looking for unskilled workers with experience in production work. We are looking for someone who wants to help ensure quality and prioritize safety and well-being in the workplace.
 
Being hired as a production worker at Vestas is not just about experience, it's about motivation, curiosity, and interest in learning new things. Through thorough training and instruction, we will provide you with all the tools to become skilled at making wind turbines.

The Nakskov factory produces blades for our offshore wind turbines; the factory is an epoxy workplace, so everyone must complete an epoxy course or have a certificate no older than 5 years.

This posting is for those who thrive on working 12-hour shifts, either day or night.
 
Responsibilities

  • Safety: At Vestas, safety is the first priority, which means you must prioritize your own and your colleagues' safety, both physically and mentally.

  • Quality: Our next priority is top-notch quality, so we expect you to take pride in producing a product that meets standards.

  • Production Plan: At Vestas, we also have some plans that need to be met to deliver on time. So, we expect an employee who is diligent and strives to meet deadlines without compromising safety or quality.


Qualifications

  • You are in good physical shape and accustomed to standing and walking throughout the workday.

  • It is advantageous if you have experience with 5S and Lean.

  • It is advantageous if you have experience with production work, but if you are willing to learn, we would like to hear from you.


Competencies

  • You are quality-conscious and focus on safety.

  • You contribute to creating a good atmosphere at work.

  • You don't mind changing tasks.

  • You have an interest in learning new things and are curious.



We Offer
A workplace with a focus on employees, their safety, and providing them with the tools to create quality in their work. We offer an attractive salary package with health insurance, dental insurance, and a canteen arrangement.
 
Additional Information

  • Workplace: Nakskov

  • Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis.

  • Reference check will occur after interviews. Please state in your application if you have a reference. 



Our commitment to a fair hiring.
 At Vestas, we evaluate all candidates solely based on their professional experience, education, and relevant skills. To support a fair recruitment process, we kindly ask that you remove any photos, dates of birth or graduation, gender pronouns, marital status, or other personal information not relevant to the role before submitting your CV/resume. Your CV/resume should focus on your professional and educational background, along with the necessary contact details (email and phone number). We train our hiring teams in inclusive evaluation and regularly review process outcomes to ensure fairness.

DEIB Statement
 At Vestas, we recognize the value of diversity, equity, and inclusion in driving innovation and success. We strongly encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply, particularly those who may hesitate due to their identity or feel they do not meet every criterion. As our CEO states, "Expertise and talent come in many forms, and a diverse workforce enhances our ability to think differently and solve the complex challenges of our industry". Your unique perspective is what will help us powering the solution for a sustainable, green energy future.

BEWARE – RECRUITMENT FRAUD
It has come to our attention that there are a number of fraudulent emails from people pretending to work for Vestas. Read more via this link, https://www.vestas.com/en/careers/our-recruitment-process
 
About Vestas
Vestas is the energy industry’s global partner on sustainable energy solutions. We are specialised in designing, manufacturing, installing, and servicing wind turbines, both onshore and offshore. Across the globe, we have installed more wind power than anyone else. We consider ourselves pioneers within the industry, as we continuously aim to design new solutions and technologies to create a more sustainable future for all of us. With more than 200 GW of wind power installed worldwide and 40+ years of experience in wind energy, we have an unmatched track record demonstrating our expertise within the field. With 39,000 employees globally, we are a diverse team united by a common goal: to power the solution – today, tomorrow, and far into the future. Vestas promotes a diverse workforce which embraces all social identities and is free of any discrimination. We commit to create and sustain an environment that acknowledges and harvests different experiences, skills, and perspectives. We also aim to give everyone equal access to opportunity. To learn more about our company and life at Vestas, we invite you to visit our website at www.vestas.com and follow us on our social media channels. We also encourage you to join our Talent Universe to receive notifications on new and relevant postings.

jobs.title: Fuldtidsstilling i salg - Aarhus
jobs.description:
Telefonsælger til Vivo Sales nye afdeling i Aarhus

Vil du udvikle dig inden for salg og kommunikation og samtidig blive en del af en arbejdsplads med højt humør, stærkt sammenhold og fokus på personlig udvikling?

Hos Vivo Sales i Aarhus søger vi nye kolleger til vores salgsteam. Du behøver ikke have erfaring med salg i forvejen, det vigtigste er, at du har lyst til at lære, udvikle dig og blive dygtigere.

Uanset om du har afsluttet din uddannelse, holder sabbatår eller blot er klar til nye udfordringer, kan stillingen være et godt næste skridt.

Om jobbet 

Som telefonsælger hos Vivo Sales kontakter du privatpersoner og rådgiver om a-kasse, fagforening og lønsikring.

Din opgave er at skabe en god og professionel dialog, afdække kundens behov og præsentere de løsninger, der passer til den enkelte.

Du får grundig oplæring i både produkter, salg og samtaleteknik, så du bliver godt klædt på til jobbet. Derfor er tidligere salgserfaring ikke et krav. 

Om Vivo Sales

Vivo Sales arbejder med mødebooking og direkte salg og har afdelinger i Vejle, Silkeborg og Aarhus. Vi er omkring 50 medarbejdere på tværs af afdelingerne.

Hos os går faglig udvikling og et godt arbejdsmiljø hånd i hånd. Vi lægger vægt på, at vores medarbejdere trives, udvikler deres kompetencer og samtidig bliver en del af et socialt fællesskab.

Vi tilbyder dig

  • Grundig oplæring og løbende sparring

  • Mulighed for at udvikle dine kompetencer inden for salg og kommunikation

  • Et socialt arbejdsmiljø med engagerede kolleger,

  • En arbejdsplads med fokus på både faglig og personlig udvikling

  • Mulighed for at opbygge værdifuld erfaring med salg, kundedialog og behovsafdækning

  • Sociale arrangementer og aktiviteter, der styrker fællesskabet på tværs af lokationer.

  • Små faste traditioner i hverdagen, blandt andet juice hver torsdag

Vi forestiller os, at du

  • Trives med at tale med mange forskellige mennesker

  • Har lyst til at lære og udvikle dig

  • Er engageret og møder på arbejde med en positiv indstilling

  • Motiveres af at arbejde med salg og resultater

  • Bidrager positivt til fællesskabet og stemningen på arbejdspladsen

Det vigtigste for os er ikke, hvad der allerede står på dit CV, men at du har motivationen til at lære og blive dygtig til jobbet.

Praktisk information

Arbejdssted: Toldbodgade 8, st. 8000 Aarhus C
Arbejdstid: Fuldtid
Ansøgning: Via ansøgningslinket på siden

Lyder det som noget for dig?

Så send din ansøgning til os. Vi afholder samtaler løbende og glæder os til at høre mere om dig.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen eller ansøgningsprocessen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Recruiting på 55 55 64 64 på hverdage mellem kl. 9.00 og 15.00.

Vi glæder os til at modtage din ansøgning.

Team Vivo Sales

jobs.title: Ravintolapäällikkö, Amarillo Porvoo / Restaurangchef, Amarillo Borgå
jobs.description:
Primary location:
PORVOO

RAVINTOLAPÄÄLLIKKÖ 30–37,5 H/VK, AMARILLO PORVOO
Amarillo Porvoo tarjoaa rennon ja elämyksellisen ravintolakokemuksen Porvoon sydämessä osana Varuboden-Oslaa – ihan tavallista työtä poikkeuksellisen monipuolisessa ympäristössä ja merkityksellisessä roolissa!

Haemme ravintolapäällikköä määräaikaiseen sijaisuuteen 31.12.2027 asti vastaamaan Porvoon Amarillon ravintolatoiminnoista. Työaika on sovittavissa joustavasti 30–37,5 tuntiin viikossa.

Etsimme tulosnälkäistä esihenkilöä, joka innostuu tavoitteista, myynnin kasvattamisesta ja erinomaisen asiakaskokemuksen kehittämisestä. Sinulle on luontevaa toimia esihenkilönä monikulttuurisessa työyhteisössä, johtaa esimerkillä eturivistä ja rakentaa myynnillistä palvelukulttuuria, jossa jokainen ymmärtää oman roolinsa tuloksen tekemisessä. Henkilöstön kehittäminen, valmentava johtaminen ja sujuvan arjen organisointi ovat vahvuuksiasi. Työ on vahvasti operatiivista, joten työskentelet pääsääntöisesti tiimisi rinnalla.
Ravintolapäällikkönä vastaat kokonaisvaltaisesti toiminnan laadusta, kannattavuudesta ja konseptin toimivuudesta. Johdat ja kehität asiakaspalvelua, tuotteiden laatua, työtyytyväisyyttä sekä myynti- ja liiketoimintatavoitteiden toteutumista kohti entistä parempia tuloksia ja elämyksiä.

Mitä sinulta toivomme?
- Aiempaa ravintola-alan esihenkilöosaamista ja kokemusta tulosvastuullisesta roolista.
- Määrätietoisuutta, tuloshakuisuutta ja intoa kehittää myyntiä ja asiakaskokemusta.
- Valmentavaa ja innostavaa johtamistyyliä sekä kykyä rakentaa myynnillistä palvelukulttuuria.
- Kykyä organisoida arkea, kehittää henkilöstöä ja osallistua operatiiviseen työhön.
Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?
- Työpaikan, johon on kiva tulla ja jossa on kiva olla. Ei tarvitse olla yhtä iloista perhettä, mutta älä ylläty, jos työkavereista tulee kavereita.
- Tehtävän vaativuuden mukaisen palkan. Kokoaikaisessa, 37,5 tunnin viikkotyössä palkka on 3 600–4 000 €/kk, ja se määräytyy sovitun työajan, kokemuksen, koulutuksen ja kielitaidon perusteella.
- Mahdollisuuden vuosittaiseen, enintään kahden kuukauden palkkaa vastaavaan päälliköiden tulospalkkioon sekä koko henkilökunnan yhteiseen, yrityksen tulokseen perustuvaan tulospalkkioon, joka on enintään 1,70 €/tehty työtunti.
- Alennuksia S-ryhmän tuotteista ja palveluista, kuten ruoasta, juomasta, kosmetiikasta, elektroniikasta, ravintoloista ja hotelleista.
- Mahdollisuuden vaihtaa tulevaisuudessa alaa tai tehtäviä saman työnantajan palveluksessa – mutta vain, jos haluat.

Meillä ei tarvitse kiivetä uratikkaita, mutta joskus seuraava askelma vain puhuttelee. Jos näin on, hae nyt!
Jätä hakemuksesi palkkatoiveineen viimeistään sunnuntaina 25.10.2026. Käsittelemme hakemuksia ja kutsumme haastatteluihin jo hakuaikana. Emme huomioi sähköpostitse lähetettyjä hakemuksia. Lisätietoja antaa ryhmäpäällikkö Jarno Sorasahi (jarno.sorasahi@sok.fi). Työ alkaa sopimuksen mukaan, kuitenkin viimeistään 1.1.2027.

--------

RESTAURANGCHEF 30–37,5 H/VECKA, AMARILLO BORGÅ
Amarillo Borgå erbjuder en avslappnad restaurangupplevelse med det lilla extra i hjärtat av Borgå som en del av Varuboden-Osla – ett helt vanligt jobb i en ovanligt mångsidig miljö och i en betydelsefull roll!

Vi söker en restaurangchef för ett tidsbundet vikariat till och med 31.12.2027 med ansvar för restaurangverksamheten på Amarillo i Borgå. Arbetstiden kan avtalas flexibelt till 30–37,5 timmar i veckan.

Vi söker en resultatinriktad chef som inspireras av tydliga mål, ökad försäljning och utvecklingen av en utmärkt kundupplevelse. Du känner dig hemma i chefsrollen i en mångkulturell arbetsgemenskap, leder genom eget exempel i det dagliga arbetet och bygger en försäljningsinriktad servicekultur där var och en förstår sin roll i att skapa resultat. Att utveckla personalen, leda coachande och organisera en smidig vardag hör till dina styrkor. Arbetet är i hög grad operativt, så du arbetar huvudsakligen sida vid sida med ditt team.
Som restaurangchef ansvarar du för verksamhetens kvalitet och lönsamhet samt för att konceptet fungerar som det ska. Du leder och utvecklar kundservicen, produktkvaliteten och arbetstillfredsställelsen samt ser till att försäljnings- och affärsmålen nås. Målet är ännu bättre resultat och upplevelser.

Vad önskar vi av dig?
- Tidigare erfarenhet av chefsuppgifter inom restaurangbranschen och av en roll med resultatansvar.
- Målmedvetenhet, resultatinriktning och vilja att utveckla försäljningen och kundupplevelsen.
- Ett coachande och inspirerande sätt att leda samt förmåga att bygga en försäljningsinriktad servicekultur.
- Förmåga att organisera vardagen, utveckla personalen och delta i det operativa arbetet.
Vad erbjuder vi dig?
- En arbetsplats som det är trevligt att komma till och vara på. Alla behöver inte vara en enda glad familj, men bli inte förvånad om kollegor blir vänner.
- En lön som motsvarar uppdragets kravnivå. Vid heltidsarbete på 37,5 timmar i veckan är lönen 3 600–4 000 euro i månaden. Lönen fastställs utifrån den överenskomna arbetstiden, erfarenheten, utbildningen och språkkunskaperna.
- Möjlighet till en årlig resultatpremie för chefer på högst två månadslöner samt till hela personalens gemensamma, företagsresultatbaserade resultatpremie på högst 1,70 euro per arbetad timme.
- Personalrabatt på S-gruppens produkter och tjänster, till exempel på mat, dryck, kosmetik, elektronik, restauranger och hotell.
- Möjlighet att i framtiden byta bransch eller arbetsuppgifter hos samma arbetsgivare – men bara om du själv vill.

Hos oss behöver du inte klättra på karriärstegen, men ibland känns nästa steg helt enkelt rätt. Om det gör det – sök nu!
Lämna in din ansökan med löneanspråk senast söndag 25.10.2026. Vi behandlar ansökningar och kallar till intervjuer redan under ansökningstiden. Ansökningar som skickas per e-post beaktas inte. För mer information om tjänsten, vänligen kontakta gruppchef Jarno Sorasahi (jarno.sorasahi@sok.fi). Arbetet börjar enligt avtal, dock senast 1.1.2027.

jobs.title: Sovitteluohjaaja
jobs.description:
**Laki rikosasioiden ja eräiden riita-asioiden sovittelusta (1015/2005) määrittää sovitteluohjaajan työtehtävän kuvausta.** Sovittelua tuotetaan koko Suomessa, ja sen järjestämisestä vastaa THL vuoden 2026 loppuun saakka. Vuoden 2027 alusta järjestämisvastuu siirtyy Oikeuspalveluvirastolle. Sovittelu ry on yksi Suomen 17 sovittelupalveluntuottajasta. Työyhteisöön kuuluu seitsemän sovitteluohjaajaa ja sovittelun vastuuhenkilö.

Rikosasioiden sovittelulla (_sovittelu_) tarkoitetaan maksutonta palvelua, jossa rikoksesta epäillylle ja rikoksen uhrille järjestetään mahdollisuus puolueettoman, koulutetun sovittelijan välityksellä kohdata toisensa luottamuksellisesti, käsitellä rikoksesta sen uhrille aiheutuneita henkisiä ja aineellisia haittoja sekä pyrkiä omatoimisesti sopimaan toimenpiteistä niiden hyvittämiseksi.

_Sovittelun ohjaaja on henkilö_, jonka tehtävänä on ohjata ja valvoa sovittelijoiden toimintaa sekä toimia tarvittaessa sovittelijana.

Sovittelulain **16 § :n mukaisesti sovittelumenettelyyn liittyvät sovittelutoimiston tehtävät**

Kun sovittelutoimisto on ottanut asian soviteltavakseen, sen tulee:

1)nimetä asiaa sovittelemaan sellainen sovittelija, joka soveltuu tehtävään kokemuksensa ja henkilökohtaisten ominaisuuksiensa perusteella eikä ole esteellinen hallintolaissa (434/2003) tarkoitetulla tavalla;

2)hankkia sovittelua varten tarvittavat asiakirjat osapuolten suostumuksella poliisi- tai syyttäjäviranomaiselta, tuomioistuimelta taikka muilta tahoilta;

3)huolehtia tulkin tai kääntäjän hankkimisesta, jos osapuoli ei hallitse sovittelussa käytettävää kieltä taikka ei aisti- tai puhevian tai muun syyn vuoksi voi ymmärtää sovittelussa käytävää keskustelua tai tulla ymmärretyksi siinä; sekä

4)sovittelun päätyttyä toimittaa poliisi- tai syyttäjäviranomaiselle salassapitoa koskevien säännösten estämättä tieto sovittelun kulusta ja lopputuloksesta.

jobs.title: Sales Manager
jobs.description:
We are looking for an experienced _Sales Manager_ to join us on our journey toward zero-emission shipping!

**About WE Tech Solutions**

WE Tech Solutions is a Finnish marine technology company leading the way in marine electrification. We develop and deliver advanced energy solutions that help the global shipping industry improve energy efficiency, reduce fuel consumption and lower emissions.

Our technologies combine variable frequency drives, permanent magnet generators, DC power distribution and intelligent energy management into integrated solutions for modern vessels.

Our offering covers Shaft Generator Solutions, Electrification Solutions and Retrofits & Conversions, serving customers across a wide range of vessel types worldwide. With solutions installed on more than 300 vessels, WE Tech combines proven marine technology with an ambitious drive to shape the next generation of efficient and increasingly electrified shipping.

**Sales Manager**

We are looking for a technically strong and commercially driven Sales Manager to grow WE Techs business globally.

The role covers both our Shaft Generator Solutions and Electrification Solutions, ranging from our established variable-speed shaft generator business to hybrid and full-electric propulsion, energy storage integration, DC power distribution and shore power solutions.

The Sales Manager will work directly with shipowners, shipyards, ship designers and technology partners to develop technically and commercially competitive solutions and convert customer needs into successful projects.

**Responsibilities**

The Sales Manager is responsible for designated Sales projects and is reporting to the Sales Director. The Sales Manager is expected to actively sell and develop business across both WE Techs Merchant Marine and Electrification Solutions, combining commercial responsibility with sufficient technical competence to develop solutions together with customers and WE Tech Engineering.

- Actively sell and promote WE Techs complete solution portfolio across both Merchant Marine and Electrification business

- Identify customer needs and develop technically and commercially competitive system solutions together with customers and WE Tech Engineering

- Understand customer vessel electrical architecture, operational requirements and interfaces

- Prepare and negotiate Technical Agreements with customers

- Negotiate and sign Sales Agreements within given authorization

- Represent WE Tech Solutions at trade shows, customer meetings and industry events

- Prepare quotations, technical proposals and other sales documentation

- Calculate and keep up to date Sales project-specific Sales Calculations

- Identify requirements from customer technical specifications, both documented and verbally

- Register and mitigate Sales project risks

- Budget responsibility for designated Sales projects

- Request quotations from sub-suppliers and technology partners

- Ensure quality, technical compliance and validity of sub-supplier quotations

- Coordinate solution definition with Engineering, Product Management, Sourcing and relevant technology partners

- Be part of the Sales Team and peer review related documentation

- Communicate directly with customers and support technical and commercial discussions throughout the sales process

- Communicate Sales projects with Delivery Project Management and Engineering

- Responsible for handover of Sales projects to Delivery Project Management upon closing

- Ensure timely submission of technically correct and commercially competitive quotations

- Develop and maintain Sales-related documentation

- Contribute to Sales network and customer relationship development

- Collect and register market and competitor intelligence

- Maintain and keep Sales project data up to date in CRM


**Competence requirements**

- M.Sc or B.Sc in Electrical, Automation, Marine or equivalent Engineering

- Minimum 3 years of relevant experience in technical sales, marine electrical systems, system integration or similar tasks

- Good understanding of marine electrical power systems, power conversion, drives and system integration

- Ability to understand electrical single-line diagrams, technical specifications and system interfaces

- Commercial mindset and ability to translate customer technical requirements into competitive solutions

- Fluency in English, written and spoken

- Business-minded and result-driven

- Willingness to travel internationally

- Strong negotiation and customer communication skills

- Able to perform under pressure and time constraints

- Excellent teamwork and communication skills in multicultural environments

- Ability to take responsibility and make decisions independently


**Strong advantages**

- Ability to prepare and modify P&I diagrams

- Experience with hybrid and/or full-electric marine propulsion systems

- Knowledge of ESS/battery systems, shore charging, DC distribution, propulsion drives and electrical power management

- Experience in marine system integration and multidisciplinary vessel projects

- Experience working directly with shipowners, shipyards, ship designers and equipment suppliers


Please apply before 31.10.2026.

We are a fast-growing, multidisciplinary engineering team working on technologies with real-world applications in defence and critical infrastructure protection.

The Role

We are looking for a highly skilled Signal Processing Engineer with a strong background in digital signal processing (DSP), preferably specializing in acoustics.

You will work on complex signal-processing challenges, developing algorithms that extract meaningful information from real-world acoustic data. Your work will involve advanced mathematical modelling, spectral analysis, filtering, detection, and statistical signal processing.

We are particularly interested in engineers who enjoy exploring signals, understanding their underlying physical characteristics, and pushing the boundaries of what can be extracted through classical signal-processing techniques.

This is a research-intensive, hands-on engineering position with significant technical freedom and ownership.

You will work closely with our embedded software, electronics, and AI teams, taking ideas from mathematical concepts through experimental validation and practical implementation.

Key Responsibilities

  • Research, design, and implement advanced digital signal-processing algorithms.

  • Analyze complex acoustic signals in both time and frequency domains.

  • Develop techniques for spectral analysis, digital filtering, noise reduction, and signal detection.

  • Apply statistical signal processing and estimation theory to extract meaningful information from noisy measurements.

  • Investigate new signal-processing approaches and evaluate their performance using real-world data.

  • Develop efficient implementations of algorithms for practical applications.

  • Design experiments, analyze results, and continuously improve algorithm performance.

  • Collaborate with our multidisciplinary engineering team to integrate signal-processing solutions into operational systems.

Qualifications

We value technical ability, curiosity, and problem-solving skills more than specific degrees or years of experience.

We would like you to have:

  • An MSc or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Signal Processing, Applied Physics, Mathematics, or a related field.

  • A strong theoretical foundation in digital signal processing.

  • Experience with spectral analysis, FFT, digital filters, and time-frequency analysis.

  • Knowledge of statistical signal processing, detection theory, and estimation methods.

  • Experience developing and evaluating signal-processing algorithms.

  • Strong programming skills in Python, MATLAB, and/or C++.

  • Experience working with real-world measurement data, including noisy or low-SNR signals.

  • The ability to independently investigate complex technical problems and develop practical solutions.

It would be an advantage if you have experience with:

  • Acoustic signal processing.

  • Adaptive filtering and advanced noise-reduction techniques.

  • Passive sensing systems.

  • Real-time or embedded DSP.

  • Advanced mathematical modelling and numerical methods.

  • Signal processing within defence, aerospace, telecommunications, or scientific instrumentation.

  • Academic research, including publications or a PhD in a relevant field.

Experience in the defence industry is not required. We welcome candidates from both industry and academia, including researchers looking to apply their expertise to real-world engineering challenges.

What We Offer

Work on meaningful challenges. Contribute to advanced technologies addressing real-world security challenges.

Technical freedom and ownership. Take responsibility for complex engineering problems, explore new approaches, and influence the technical direction of our products.

From research to reality. See your algorithms move beyond simulations and become part of real systems deployed in demanding environments.

A multidisciplinary engineering environment. Work alongside talented engineers specializing in embedded software, electronics, artificial intelligence, and systems engineering.

A growing defence technology company. Join Triton Depth at an exciting stage, where individual contributions have a direct impact on the company's technology and future.

Who You Are

You are someone who genuinely enjoys understanding signals.

You are curious about the information hidden within complex measurements and have the mathematical knowledge and practical skills to uncover it.

You are equally comfortable exploring theoretical concepts, experimenting with algorithms, and analyzing real-world data.

You enjoy difficult, open-ended technical challenges and take pride in developing solutions that work outside controlled laboratory environments.

Above all, you are motivated by the opportunity to turn advanced signal-processing research into technology with real-world impact.

Apply

If this sounds like you, we would love to hear from you.

Send us your CV and a short introduction describing your background and relevant experience.

We are particularly interested in hearing about signal-processing projects, research, or technical challenges you have worked on.

Location: Copenhagen, Denmark
Employment: Full-time

jobs.title: Kokki
jobs.description:
**Kokki, tule tekemään Saimaan makuja Sahanlahteen!**

Sahanlahti Resort on perheomisteinen, ympäri vuoden palveleva matkailukohde Saimaan rannalla Puumalassa. Meille tullaan hyvän ruoan, viihtyisän majoituksen, järviluonnon ja lämminhenkisten kohtaamisten vuoksi. Vieraanamme on niin lomailijoita, juhlaseurueita kuin yritysryhmiä Suomesta ja maailmalta. Haluamme, että jokainen tuntee olonsa tervetulleeksi ja saa mukaansa syyn palata.

Ruoka on Sahanlahden sydän. Keittiössämme lähiruoka tarkoittaa lähiseudun tuottajia, sesongin raaka-aineita ja omin käsin tekemistä. Lautasillemme päätyvät lähijärvien kalat, metsien sienet ja marjat sekä lähitilojen parhaat antimet. Arvostamme raaka-aineiden alkuperää, selkeitä makuja ja huolellista käsityötä.

Kolme erilaista ravintolaamme – maisemaravintola Koskivahti, avotuliravintola Pajapirtti ja kesäravintola Rantamakasiini – tarjoavat monipuolisen ympäristön kokin työhön. Pajapirtin avotuli-illallinen valittiin **Suomen parhaaksi ruokamatkailutuotteeksi Hungry for Finland -ruokamatkailukilpailussa 2026**. Olemme saavutuksesta ylpeitä ja haluamme jatkaa ruokatuotteemme kehittämistä yhdessä osaavan tiimin kanssa.

**Etsimme nyt ammattiylpeää kokkia joukkoomme**

Toivomme sinulta vähintään viiden vuoden työkokemusta kokin tehtävistä sekä innostusta ruokaan, ravintola-alaan ja lähiruokaan perustuvaan tapaamme tehdä työtä. Haluat oppia uutta, kehittää omaa osaamistasi ja tuoda ajatuksiasi yhteiseen tekemiseen.

Osaat suunnitella ja viedä työsi läpi itsenäisesti sekä toimia osana tiimiä. **Järjestelmällisyys ja siisteys ovat meille erityisen tärkeitä:** pidät työpisteesi kunnossa, ennakoit tulevaa ja huolehdit siitä, että keittiön arki sujuu myös kiireessä. Arvostamme hyvää yhteistyötä, vastuullista työotetta ja reilua suhtautumista työkavereihin.

**Työ elää vuodenaikojen mukana**

Sahanlahdessa työtehtävät ja työyhteisön koko vaihtelevat sesonkien mukaan. Kesäkaudella keittiötiimissämme työskentelee noin 15 henkilöä. Talvikaudella olet osa kolmen hengen keittiötiimiä, joka täydentyy tarpeen mukaan lisäkäsillä.

Työssäsi osallistut monipuolisesti ravintoloidemme ja tilaisuuksiemme ruoanvalmistukseen, esivalmisteluista annosten viimeistelyyn. Pienessä talvitiimissä korostuvat itsenäisyys ja kokonaisuuden hallinta, kesällä puolestaan yhteistyö suuremman tiimin kanssa. Ympäri vuoden yhteistä ovat hyvä maku, huolellinen tekeminen ja ylpeys omasta työstä.

Tarjoamme sinulle monipuolisen työn lähiruoan parissa, mahdollisuuden kehittää osaamistasi ja olla mukana rakentamassa Sahanlahden ruokaelämyksiä. Meillä laadukas tekeminen ja lupsakka yhdessäolo kuuluvat samaan keittiöön.

**Puumalassa on tilaa hyvälle arjelle**

Puumala tarjoaa Saimaan maisemien ja luonnon lisäksi myös käytännön etuja: maksuttoman varhaiskasvatuksen, alhaisen kunnallisveron sekä hyvin saatavilla olevia vuokra- ja omistusasuntoja. Täällä on tilaa asua, harrastaa ja viihtyä myös työpäivän jälkeen.

Työn aloitus sovitaan joustavasti, kuitenkin viimeistään **helmikuussa 2027**.

Kiinnostuitko? Kerro meille itsestäsi, kokemuksestasi ja siitä, mikä sinua ruoan tekemisessä innostaa.

**Tervetuloa tekemään hyvää ruokaa ja hyvää arkea Sahanlahteen!**

jobs.description:
**YOUR OPPORTUNITY**

As our global installed base continues to grow, so does the opportunity to develop long-term lifecycle business with our customers. We are looking for an experienced Service Sales Manager to strengthen our team and take an active role in further developing and scaling WE Techs global lifecycle service business.

This is a hands-on international sales role where you will work directly with shipowners, operators and ship management companies. You will develop existing customer relationships, identify new opportunities and turn customer needs into valuable service solutions and long-term business.

Your portfolio will include service agreements, maintenance, spare parts, training, remote services, system updates and upgrades, as well as retrofit and modernisation opportunities for vessels equipped with WE Tech solutions.

The role goes beyond responding to enquiries and preparing quotations. We are looking for someone who proactively develops customers and opportunities, understands the commercial potential of the installed base and helps us continuously improve how we sell and develop lifecycle services.

You will also play an important role in identifying opportunities where WE Techs wider Shaft Generator and Electrification Solutions can create additional value for existing customers.

**WHAT YOU WILL DO**

· Develop an assigned customer portfolio and grow lifecycle service business within WE Techs installed base

· Identify and pursue new service business opportunities with shipowners, operators and ship management companies

· Drive sales of service agreements, maintenance, spare parts, training, remote services, and system updates and upgrades

· Identify opportunities for system upgrades, modernisations and retrofits across WE Techs installed base, including opportunities related to both Shaft Generator Solutions and Electrification Solutions

jobs.description:
