WE Tech Solutions is a Finnish clean-tech company that supplies shaft generator systems, hybrid and electric propulsion, energy storage and other electrification solutions for new and existing vessels.

**Your Opportunity**

This is a hands-on engineering role in an international team. You will develop and configure the control software for our WE Drive solutions, which measure and control electric power generation, distribution and energy storage on board ships. You will follow your work from design through manufacturing and factory testing to commissioning on board, in line with marine standards and the rules of the major classification societies.

**What will you do?**

- Develop and configure control system software for WE Drive solutions, mainly in IEC 61131-3 (Structured Text) on PLC-based platforms

- Build control systems that are secure by design, in line with IACS UR E27 and validate system functionality against customer and class requirements (DNV, ABS, LR, BV and others)

- Prepare and maintain project documentation, including functional descriptions, system block diagrams and other relevant or required documentation

- Give technical support to internal teams, customers, shipyards and partners during development, manufacturing and commissioning


**What are we looking for?**

We are looking for an experienced engineer who enjoys solving technical problems, takes ownership of their work and communicates well with colleagues and other stakeholders. You are comfortable working independently and as part of a project team.

**We expect you have**

- M.Sc. or B.Sc. in Automation or Electrical Engineering, or similar

- Relevant experience with industrial control systems, including PLCs and VFDs and a good understanding of electrical power systems and how power electronics work

- Hands-on programming experience with Structured Text and PLC development environments

- A structured way of working and high attention to detail, especially in documentation

- Full professional proficiency in English, both written and spoken

- Eligibility to live and work in Finland


**Strong advantages**

- Experience with control system development in marine or offshore projects and working with class requirements

- Knowledge of power electronics, variable frequency drives, DC grids or battery systems as well as experience with industrial communication protocols

- Knowledge of or previous experience with cyber security for industrial control systems, especially IACS UR E26/E27 is seen as an advantage.


**Why WE Tech?**

- Meaningful, hands-on work with clean technology for the global shipping industry

- Real ownership of your work, from design to commissioning on board

- Varied engineering tasks and interesting international projects

- A team of skilled professionals and real opportunities to grow your competence

- Hybrid working and flexible working hours


You will join a growing international company with an expanding global installed base and significant opportunities to develop lifecycle business with existing and future customers.

**What we offer**

- Hybrid working solutions and flexible work hours

- Competitive salary

- Culture and sports benefits (Epassi)

- Extensive lunch benefits

- Diverse working environment

- Meaningful, hands-on role where your participation is seen

- Central office location in the heart of Vaasa


Does this sound like a good fit for you?

Please apply before the 9th of November 2026. Learn more about WE Tech at **www.wetech.fi**.

**Mitä pääset myymään?**

Kimbtronin tuotevalikoimaan kuuluu muun muassa:

- **Johdon raportointi ja päätöksenteon tuki:** Ratkaisut yritysten tiedonhallintaan, raportointiin ja liiketoiminnan seurantaan.

- **Älykäs perehdytys ja työntekijöiden tuki:** Tekoälyratkaisut perehdytykseen, ohjeistukseen ja monikieliseen työntekijätukeen.

- **AI-tuotehaku:** Ratkaisut teknisen kaupan tuotetietojen, dokumenttien ja tuotteiden nopeaan löytämiseen.


Tuotteita kehitetään jatkuvasti, ja myyntiedustajilla on mahdollisuus päästä mukaan myös uusien ratkaisujen kaupallistamiseen.

**Mitä tehtävä sisältää?**

Tehtävässä vastaat uusien yritysasiakkaiden hankinnasta, asiakaskontaktien avaamisesta ja myyntimahdollisuuksien edistämisestä.

Sinun ei tarvitse olla tekoälyn tekninen asiantuntija. Saat tueksesi tuote-esittelyt, demot sekä Kimbtronin teknisen asiantuntemuksen.

Tärkeintä on kyky tunnistaa asiakkaiden tarpeita, rakentaa luottamusta ja saada kauppaa aikaan.

**Mitä tarjoamme?**

- Kiinnostavat ja kilpailukykyiset tuotteet nopeasti kasvavalla tekoälyalalla

- Selkeän provisiopohjaisen ansaintamallin, jossa oma aktiivisuus ja tulokset vaikuttavat ansioihin

- Valmiit tuotedemot ja teknisen asiantuntijatuen myyntiin

- Joustavuutta oman myyntityön organisointiin

- Mahdollisuuden rakentaa pitkäaikaisia asiakassuhteita

- **Etenemismahdollisuuksia** esimerkiksi myynnin vetovastuuseen, uusien tuotteiden kaupallistamiseen tai laajempiin liiketoiminnan kehitystehtäviin


**Mitä odotamme sinulta?**

Arvostamme erityisesti:

- Myyntihenkisyyttä, tavoitteellisuutta ja oma-aloitteisuutta

- Kykyä lähestyä yrityspäättäjiä ja avata uusia asiakassuhteita

- Kiinnostusta teknologiaan ja tekoälyn mahdollisuuksiin

- Hyviä vuorovaikutus- ja neuvottelutaitoja

- Halua kehittyä ja edetä urallasi


Aiempi kokemus B2B-myynnistä tai olemassa olevat yritysverkostot katsotaan eduksi, mutta ratkaisevinta on asenne ja kyky saada tuloksia aikaan.

**Kiinnostuitko?**

Haluatko päästä mukaan rakentamaan seuraavan sukupolven tekoälyliiketoimintaa?

Lähetä hakemuksesi ja kerro lyhyesti itsestäsi, myyntikokemuksestasi sekä siitä, miksi juuri sinä sopisit tähän myyntitiimiin.

**_Staffgate Oy_** _on suomalainen henkilöstövuokraus- ja rekrytointipalveluja tarjoava yritys. Asiakkaamme toimivat monilla eri toimialoilla. Autamme työntekijöitä löytämään työtä ja onnistumaan työelämässä mahdollisimman hyvin._ **_Lue lisää sivustoltamme Staffgate.fi_**

jobs.title: Site Supervisors

Your key responsibilities

- Managing site logistics: ensuring materials, machinery, and resources arrive on site at the right time

- Scheduling construction activities and managing resources

- Ensuring quality in execution and reporting

- Monitoring site costs

- Supervising subcontracting and ensuring contractual obligations are fulfilled

- Onboarding work crews and supporting their well-being

You will work closely with the Site Manager, other supervisors, designers, and other stakeholders. In this role, you will have a concrete opportunity to influence how efficiently and successfully projects are delivered.

jobs.title: Hoitaja sympaattiselle asiakkaalle Kempeleeseen
jobs.description:
Hoiva-avustaja sympaattiselle seniorille Kempeleeseen

Haemme hoiva-avustajia osa-aikaiseen työhön avustamaan sympaattista asiakastamme Kempeleessä.

Haluaisitko tehdä hoiva-avustajan työtä osa-aikaisesti, kiireettömästi ja ilman sairaanhoidollisia työtehtäviä sympaattisten ikäihmisten kanssa? Saatat olet tuleva hoitaja-helpperimme! Olit sitten opiskelija, kerryttänyt jo kokemusta hoiva-avustajana tai etsit muuten vain osa-aikatyötä, tässä roolissa ratkaisee innokkuus ja aito halu auttaa suurella sydämellä!

Me olemme Hemby, ikääntyneiden palveluita rohkeasti uudistava yritys, joka tarjoaa iloa ja turvaa ikäihmisten arkeen. Mottomme on: autamme ikääntyviä kuin omaa äitiämme.

Kasvamme jatkuvasti ja etsimme lisää hoiva-avustajan koulutuksen omaavia helppereitä tiimiimme. Löydät lyhyen ja helposti täytettävän hakulomakkeemme täältä: https://helpper.hemby.fi/apply

Mitä hoitaja-helpperi tekee?

Hoitaja-helpperi on sosiaali- ja terveysalan koulutettu henkilö, joka tarjoaa arjen apua ja seuraa omalle nimetylle ikäihmiselle. Hoitaja-helpperi tukee ikäihmistä kaikenlaisissa arjen askareissa, kuten ulkoilu ja kauppareissut, kodin ylläpito, ruokailussa tukeminen, saattoapu, yhdessäolo ja jutustelu.

Hoitaja-helpperi tukee seniorin hyvinvointia kokonaisvaltaisesti. Hoivan ja huolenpidon tehtävät sisältävät:

- suihkuapua

- voinnin tarkkailua

- kotona pärjäämisen tukemista

- liikkumisessa tukemista


Lisäksi voit auttaa asiakasta suihkussa ja henkilökohtaisessa hygieniassa. Työtehtäviin ei kuitenkaan kuulu sairaanhoidollisten palveluiden toteutusta, kuten lääkehoitoa.

Mitä hoitaja-helpperin työ vaatii?

Sitä, että palat halusta auttaa ikäihmisiä. Lisäksi hoitaja-helpperin työ vaatii sosiaali- ja terveysalan tai hoiva-avustajan koulutuksen tai vankan kokemuksen hoiva-avustajan työstä.

Tärkeintä on, että haluat viettää aikaa ikäihmisten kanssa ja tehdä omalla toiminnallasi heidän arjestaan parempaa. Työtä voi tehdä oman tilanteen mukaan ja työajat ovat hyvin joustavat.

Mikä on parasta hoitaja-helpperin työssä?

Kysyimme tätä hoitaja-helppereiltämme, ja näin he vastasivat:

"Ihmisten kiireetön kohtaaminen ja ystävystyminen seniorin kanssa."

"Toisen auttaminen ja merkityksellisyyden tunne."

Auttaminen kokonaisvaltaisesti seniorin tarpeiden mukaan."

Hoitaja-helpperinä saat:

Oman nimetyn ikäihmisen, jota autat arjen askareissa ja olet hänelle seurana Joustavat työajat, jotka sopivat mainiosti esimerkiksi opiskelun ohelle tai lisätyöksi. Tavallisin työaika on 2-10h/vko. Kilpailukykyisen palkan: 15,29-17,29 €/h + työehtosopimuksen mukaiset lisät sekä lomakorvaukset. Hyvät etenemismahdollisuudet: Voit edetä kokemuksen ja hyvän asiakaspalautteen ansiosta pro- tai guru-helpperiksi ja saada korotusta palkkaasi!

Hakemukset lähetetään sähköisen lomakkeen kautta. Olemme kaikkiin hakijoihin yhteydessä hakemuksen lähettämisen jälkeen.

Lähetä hakemus hoitaja-helpperiksi täällä.

Lue lisää Hembystä klikkaamalla tästä.

Mikäli sinulla on kysyttävää hoitaja-helpperiksi ryhtymisestä, laita meille sähköpostia osoitteeseen rekry@hemby.fi, niin jutellaan lisää!

jobs.title: Social- og Sundhedsassistent til aftenvagt på specialiseret demensafdeling
jobs.description:
Social- og Sundhedsassistent til specialiseret indsats for socialt udsatte ældre med demens

Christians Have Plejecenter - Forenede Care

Vil du være med til at styrke en specialiseret indsats for borgere med demens og sociale udfordringer?

Vi etablerer en målrettet indsats for socialt udsatte ældre i vores eksisterende demensafsnit og søger en social- og sundhedsassistent til aftenvagt, som vil være med til at løfte kvaliteten og skabe endnu bedre rammer for vores beboere.

Hos os handler det ikke kun om pleje. Det handler om at skabe et hjem, hvor tryghed, relationer og livskvalitet er i centrum.

Om indsatsen

Vi etablerer en specialiseret indsats for socialt udsatte ældre inden for vores eksisterende demensafsnit.

Indsatsen målrettes borgere med komplekse behov, hvor demens kan være kombineret med psykiske udfordringer, misbrug eller en socialt udsat livssituation.

Det betyder i praksis:

  • En styrket tværfaglig indsats (social- og sundhedsfaglig)
  • Mere tid og plads til relations arbejdet
  • Fleksible rammer i hverdagen
  • Øget fokus på tryghed, struktur og meningsfuldt hverdagsliv
  • Faglige tilgange til borgere med misbrug og psykiske udfordringer
  • Tæt samarbejde på tværs af kommune og sundhedsområde

Indsatsen giver bedre muligheder for nærvær, fordybelse og høj faglig kvalitet i arbejdet med en særlig kompleks målgruppe.

Stillingen

Vi søger en uddannet social- og sundhedsassistent til aftenvagt på 28 timer ugentligt.

  • Fast aftenvagt
  • Arbejde hver 2. weekend
  • Tiltrædelse hurtigst muligt

Vi leder efter en medarbejder, der vil være med til at gøre en mærkbar forskel i hverdagen.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

Som social- og sundhedsassistent hos os vil du blandt andet arbejde med:

  • Helhedsorienteret pleje og omsorg
  • Personlig pleje og hygiejne
  • Medicinhåndtering og sundhedsfaglig dokumentation
  • Relations arbejde og kontaktetablering
  • At skabe struktur og genkendelighed i hverdagen
  • Observation af beboernes trivsel og sundhedstilstand
  • Samarbejde med pårørende og eksterne samarbejdspartnere
  • Sansestimulering og meningsfulde oplevelser

Hvad kan du forvente hos os?

På Christians Have Plejecenter drevet af Forenede Care bliver du en del af en arbejdsplads, hvor respekt, omsorg, engagement og kvalitet er fundamentet.

Vi tilbyder:

  • Et stærkt tværfagligt fællesskab med engagerede kolleger
  • En hverdag med høj faglighed og fokus på kvalitet i plejen
  • Høj trivsel og fokus på nærvær
  • Indflydelse på din arbejdsdag
  • Tæt samarbejde med kommunens demenskonsulent
  • Mulighed for faglig udvikling inden for demensområdet
  • Adgang til Danmarks største sansehave med aktiviteter året rundt

Hos os arbejder vi for at skabe et hjem, ikke bare en arbejdsplads.

Hvem er du?

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Er uddannet social- og sundhedsassistent
  • Har erfaring med eller interesse for demensområdet
  • Har stærke relationelle kompetencer
  • Kan arbejde med borgere med komplekse problemstillinger, herunder psykiske udfordringer og misbrug
  • Er rolig, tydelig og fagligt reflekteret
  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og samtidig indgå i et tværfagligt samarbejde
  • Er en holdspiller med godt humør
  • Tager ansvar og bidrager aktivt til udviklingen af praksis

Ansøgning

Har du spørgsmål, er du velkommen til at kontakte centerchef Katherine Ratgen på telefon 30 78 54 15.

Vi ansætter løbende, så send din ansøgning allerede i dag.

Om os

Christians Have Plejecenter drives af Forenede Care og består af 62 boliger fordelt på 7 boenheder, heraf 3 demensafdelinger.

Vi arbejder hver dag for at skabe en tryg, hjemlig og meningsfuld hverdag med fokus på relationer, livskvalitet og sanselige oplevelser.

Hos os er omsorg ikke bare en opgave. Det er en måde at være i verden på.

We are looking for a Running GearComponent Expert with a main responsibility in 4-stroke diesel engine rotating components research and development work.
The preferred location for this position is Vaasa, Finland. We offer a possibility to hybrid remote work.

Your role and responsibilities
As a Running Gear Component Expert your work will include development projects of new engines engineering work with new fuels, component manufacturing technology, extend of life time against fatigue, vibration analyses, field results analyses and supplier co-operation and developments. The tasks can also be adjusted based on your individual skills and interests. Youll be working as a part of Component Expertise Running Gear team with diverse expertise.

Your work will focus these responsibilities:
* Maintain component technology data base to meet future customer needs

* Conduct and coordinate the component development and technical cooperation with internal and external partners

* Provide support and expert services for new development projects

* Support digitalisation and data-driven development

* Provide support for service organisation in failure and root cause analysis


To be able to succeed in the position we expect you to have:
* M.Sc or B.Sc degree in mechanical engineering

* Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills

* Good written and spoken communication skills in both English and Finnish

* Strong knowhow of material fatigue, tribology and/or vibrations

* At least 3 years of experience working at the industry


Why you and us?
You are valued – as your true self. At Wärtsilä YOU matter. We value diversity and are committed in supporting inclusive work community.
Your growth is supported. We believe in continuous learning & teamwork. Wärtsilian community has your back when it comes to development opportunities – so you can develop beyond your potential.
You get to make a difference. Innovation and sustainability are important for us. Every day, we - Wärtsilians - put our hearts and minds into enabling sustainable societies through innovation in technology and services into reality.

Contact and next steps
Please submit your application before the application deadlinethrough our Careers portal. Applications through email will not be considered.
In case of any questions regarding the position, reach out to: Pasi Halla-aho, Manager, Running Gear, pasi.halla-aho@wartsila.com

jobs.title: Regnskabsmedarbejder - med mulighed for at vokse
jobs.description:
Kan du lide, når tallene stemmer, og er du nysgerrig på, hvordan tingene kan gøres smartere? Så bliv en del af vores økonomiteam på tre i en international fødevarevirksomhed i udvikling. Her får du en rolle, der kan vokse sammen med dig.

Hvem er vi?
AquaPri er blandt Europas førende producenter af ørred, ørredkaviar/rogn og sandart i høj kvalitet. Vi er en del af en dansk/fransk koncern, har hovedkontor i Vejle og sælger til kunder over hele verden. Vi har 125 års erfaring og står selv for hele værdikæden med 13 ørredanlæg, 2 sandartanlæg, 6 havbrug og vores eget forarbejdningsanlæg. Hos os møder du en uformel omgangstone, engagerede kolleger og et solidt fokus på ansvarlig akvakultur og fødevaresikkerhed.

Jobbet
Sammen med dine kolleger i økonomiteamet sørger du for, at lønnen er korrekt og kommer til tiden, at bogføringen er i orden, og at tallene er klar til måneds- og kvartalsafslutningerne. Hvor du får dit primære ansvar, aftaler vi ud fra dine kompetencer og ønsker.

Du starter med de daglige opgaver og lærer forretningen at kende indefra. Når du er kommet godt ind i rollen, får du mulighed for at tage mere ansvar. Det kan f.eks. være at forbedre og automatisere vores processer eller at arbejde tættere sammen med vores CFO om opgaver på tværs af virksomheden.

Teamets opgaver omfatter:

  • Kreditorer, debitorer og finansbogføring

  • Registrering og afstemning af lager

  • Løn til timelønnede og funktionærer, herunder refusioner

  • Løbende afstemninger samt måneds- og kvartalsafslutninger

  • Moms og indberetninger til myndigheder, herunder dataindsamling

  • Forbedring og automatisering af processer

  • Samt relevante ad hoc-opgaver

Dit team

Du bliver en del af et økonomiteam på tre og refererer til vores CFO. I arbejder tæt sammen, deler viden og udvikler sammen teamets rutiner og processer. Hverdagen veksler mellem faste rutiner og opgaver, der skifter, så du skal kunne planlægge din tid og overholde dine deadlines.

Er det dig?

  • Du har 2–5 års erfaring med bogholderi, regnskab eller revision.

  • Du er god til Excel og interesseret i digitale værktøjer, automatisering og AI.

  • Erfaring med Uniconta og med Lessor eller Danløn er en fordel, men ikke et krav.

  • Du taler og skriver dansk og engelsk. Som del af en international koncern med kunder over hele verden bruger du tit engelsk i det daglige.

  • Du lærer hurtigt, er struktureret og detaljeorienteret og bevarer overblikket, også når det går stærkt.

  • Du vil gerne lære, tager selv initiativ og har lyst til at vokse med opgaverne.

Det tilbyder vi:

  • En stilling med reelt ansvar og gode muligheder for at udvikle dig

  • Plads til at komme med idéer og forbedre den måde, vi arbejder på

  • Gode kolleger, en uformel tone og fleksible arbejdstider

  • Pensionsordning og sundhedsforsikring

Praktisk info

Arbejdsstedet er vores hovedkontor i Vejle, og vi ønsker tiltrædelse hurtigst muligt. Vi holder samtaler løbende, så send din ansøgning og dit CV til anna.sandberg@aquapri.dk allerede i dag.

Har du spørgsmål, er du velkommen til at kontakte HR Manager Anna Sandberg på tlf. 23 29 71 82 eller anna.sandberg@aquapri.dk.

Vi behandler dine personoplysninger fortroligt og efter reglerne i GDPR. Vi bruger dem kun i rekrutteringen og gemmer dem ikke længere, end nødvendigt.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

Full time Monday - Friday 39 hours per week €45,000 - €48,000 per annum Opportunities for professional development Plus our Sodexo employee benefits package Compliance Administrator Dublin Airport - Full time At Sodexo, we’re passionate about our people. We know that our teams are the key to delivering exceptional service and creating meaningful experiences for our clients, customers, and employees. We are currently seeking a dedicated and dynamic Compliance Administrator to join our team and play a key role in driving excellence and innovation. As a Compliance Administrator you will: Act as an integral member of the Administration Management Team, sharing collective ownership and accountability for ensuring all service standards are consistently delivered and adhered to. Act as the Authorising Signatory for all vetting and Airport Identity Card requirements for Sodexo personnel working at, and onboarding to, Dublin Airport Authority (DAA). Utilise Sodexo self-audit systems to monitor compliance and collate data for monthly reporting in line with contractual KPIs. Support the implementation and monitoring of Quality Improvement Plans where required. Promote a culture of accountability and responsibility by building effective working relationships, encouraging collaboration and ensuring a coordinated approach to meeting operational deadlines. What we are looking for: Proven experience in an administrative, compliance, coordination or operational support role. Strong organisational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines. Excellent attention to detail, particularly when managing records, documentation, compliance requirements and expiry dates. Experience working with confidential and sensitive information, with a high level of professionalism and discretion. Strong understanding of compliance processes and the ability to ensure procedures and standards are consistently followed. Strong IT and administration skills, with confidence using Microsoft Suite and maintaining accurate records and reports.

jobs.title: Energitekniker Ustekveikja Energi
jobs.description:
Vil du jobbe tett på vannkraftproduksjonen og ha en praktisk og variert arbeidshverdag?

Ustekveikja Energi Holding AS har ansvar for drift og vedlikehold av tre kraftverk i nærområdet rundt Geilo, som eies helt eller delvis av Hol kommune. Nå ønsker vi å styrke produksjonsavdelingen med dyktige og engasjerte energiteknikere.

Hos oss blir du en del av et lite fagmiljø der samarbeid, selvstendighet og sikker drift står sentralt. Arbeidshverdagen er praktisk og variert, med oppmøte på Geilo og arbeidsoppgaver ute ved kraftverkene.

Dette blir noen av dine oppgaver:

  • Drift, tilsyn og vedlikehold av kraftverkene

  • Feilsøking og praktisk problemløsning på tekniske anlegg

  • Planlagte og løpende vedlikeholdsoppgaver

  • Bidra til sikker og stabil drift av anleggene

  • Samarbeide tett med kolleger og relevante fagmiljøer

  • Delta i vaktordningen for kraftverkene

Vi ser etter deg som har:

  • Fagbrev innen elektro, gjerne med erfaring fra høyspentanlegg, og/eller fagbrev som mekaniker, gjerne med erfaring fra kraftbransjen

  • Relevant praktisk erfaring fra teknisk drift og vedlikehold

  • Gode IKT-kunnskaper

  • Førerkort klasse BE

  • Evne til å kjøre snøscooter under krevende forhold

  • Gode norskkunnskaper, muntlig og skriftlig

Hvem vi ser etter?

Vi tror du vil trives hos oss dersom du liker å løse praktiske og tekniske utfordringer, samtidig som du tar sikkerhet på alvor. Du arbeider godt både selvstendig og sammen med andre, tar ansvar for egne oppgaver og bidrar positivt når laget skal finne gode løsninger.

Vi ser gjerne at du er:

  • Løsningsorientert og praktisk anlagt

  • Positiv og nysgjerrig

  • Strukturert og ansvarsbevisst

  • Samarbeidsorientert og tillitsskapende

  • Fleksibel og åpen for varierte arbeidsoppgaver

  • Opptatt av HMS og sikkerhet

Hos oss får du

  • En variert og selvstendig jobb innen fornybar energiproduksjon

  • Mulighet til å arbeide med tre ulike vannkraftverk

  • Et inkluderende og samarbeidsorientert arbeidsmiljø

  • Konkurransedyktige lønnsbetingelser

  • Vaktordning med gode avspaseringsordninger

  • En arbeidshverdag som kombinerer oppmøte på hovedkontoret på Geilo med arbeid ute ved kraftverkene

Interessert? Ta gjerne kontakt med Linda Brusletto på telefon 416 76 428 eller Cathrine Svendsen på telefon 926 06 610

Alle henvendelser behandles konfidensielt.

Søknadsfrist: Snarest, vi behandler søkere fortløpende

Søknad med CV registreres i vårt digitale søknadssystem så snart som mulig.

For å unngå bedrageriforsøk vil vi presisere at vi aldri ber om BankID-informasjon i søknadsprosessen.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Skagerak Consulting er et tverrfaglig miljø innen rekruttering og rådgivning. Vi jobber med å utvikle mennesker og organisasjoner for å skape varige forbedringer og verdier i offentlige og private virksomheter. Vårt arbeid er basert på en kombinasjon av dokumentert metodikk, praktisk erfaring og en god porsjon sunn fornuft.

Vi utvikler mennesker og organisasjoner

Employer: SMP Hire Ltd T/A KR Hire Location: Glen Road, Monaghan, Co. Monaghan, H18 Y206 Number of Positions: 2 Salary: €36,605 per annum Hours: 39 hours per week Contract Type: Full-Time, Permanent Job Description The successful candidates will be responsible for preparing, spraying, refinishing and maintaining the painted surfaces of plant, machinery, vehicles and associated equipment to a high professional standard. Main Duties and Responsibilities Prepare surfaces for painting by cleaning, sanding, filling, masking and carrying out other necessary preparation work. Inspect surfaces and equipment to identify defects, corrosion, damage or areas requiring preparation and refinishing. Select, prepare and mix paints, primers, coatings and finishing materials to the required specification. Candidates should have practical experience in surface preparation, masking, paint mixing and professional spray application. Good knowledge of paints, primers, coatings and finishing techniques is required. Candidates must be able to identify and rectify paint defects and consistently produce a high-quality finish. Good attention to detail, organisational and time-management skills are required, together with the ability to work independently and as part of a workshop team. jobs.title: Dagplejer
jobs.description:
Dagplejer – Små børn, store øjeblikke – bliv dagplejer hos os

Bor du I Brøndby kommune og er du passioneret for at give de mindste børn en tryg og nærværende hverdag? Ønsker du et fleksibelt job med stor frihed og mulighed for at gøre en meningsfuld forskel? Så er jobbet som dagplejer i Brøndby Kommune måske noget for dig!

Som dagplejer arbejder du i dit eget hjem og skaber trygge rammer for børnene, samtidig med at du bliver en del af et fagligt fællesskab, hvor du kan få sparring og støtte til din udvikling.

Hvad kan du forvente?

  • Fleksibilitet og selvbestemmelse: Du planlægger selv din arbejdsdag med aktiviteter, der stimulerer børns læring og udvikling. Fra kreative stunder derhjemme til turer på legepladsen eller i skoven.
  • Meningsfuldt arbejde: Du giver børnene en tryg og stimulerende hverdag, hvor de føler sig set og hørt – du er med til at forme deres første år, som er afgørende for deres udvikling.
  • Trygt fællesskab: Du får støtte fra dygtige kollegaer, dagplejepædagoger og leder, som er til rådighed for sparring og vejledning. Vi udvikler løbende vores faglighed gennem møder og kurser.

Din arbejdsdag:

  • Dagen starter tidligt, hvor børnene ankommer omkring kl. 6.45, og I spiser morgenmad.
  • I løbet af dagen deltager børnene i både indendørs og udendørs aktiviteter som cykelture, kreative stunder, massere af leg og bevægelse mm. 
  • Der er også en fast dag i ugen, hvor du samles med andre dagplejere og børn i vores legestue.

Hvem er du?

Vi søger en engageret person, som:

  • Har pædagogisk erfaring 
  • Er indstillet på at arbejde hjemmefra og skabe et trygt og udviklende miljø
  • Det er et krav, at du er bosiddende i Brøndby Kommune (vester og øster området)
  • Det er et krav, at du har et røgfrit hjem og 
  • Det er et krav, at du kan være en dansk sproglig rollemodel. 

Fordele ved jobbet:

  • Fleksibilitet og stor selvbestemmelse
  • Et berigende job, hvor du gør en forskel i børns liv
  • Mulighed for faglig udvikling og støtte fra kollegaer
  • En arbejdsdag i eget hjem, uden transporttid 
  • Du arbejder 48 timer om ugen. Til gengæld får du 7 ekstra fridage årligt 
  • Som dagplejer har du, sammen med dit personlige fradrag, et skattefradrag på 60%, fordi du har udgifter til børnenes kost og slitage på hjemmet. De 60% i fradrag kommer efter træk af AM-bidrag, pensionsbidrag mv herunder ATP. 

Er du klar til at gøre en forskel for små børn?

Send din ansøgning til os i dag og vær med til at skabe en hverdag fyldt med varme, nærvær og leg.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

Vil du vide mere: Du er mere end velkommen til at ringe til leder af dagplejen Malene Rasmussen på 43282599 eller souschef Anette skov Nørby 43282598 og høre mere om jobbet som dagplejer.

Ellers send dit CV og en kort motiveret ansøgning. Du søger jobbet ved at klikke på ”ANSØG”-knappen. 
 

Ansøgningsfrist:

Vi ansætter løbende 


 Søg stillingen via 'ansøg'-knappen. Her kan du uploade din ansøgning og CV samt evt. relevant dokumentation. 

Alle interesserede ansøgere uanset alder, køn, handicap, religion eller etnisk tilhørsforhold opfordres til at søge stillingen.

I Brøndby Kommune er der en generel politik om, at nyansatte skal forevise straffeattest. Ved beskæftigelse og direkte kontakt med børn under 15 år, indhentes der også en børneattest.

Brøndby Kommune har røgfri arbejdstid. 

Brøndby er en centralt beliggende hovedstadskommune med cirka 40.000 indbyggere. Byens puls er præget af fællesskab, mangfoldighed og en stærk idrætskultur. Vi er en kommune med kant og spændende kontraster med bolig- og erhvervsområder, skove, grønne områder og Strandparken med havet og indsøerne.

jobs.title: CNC Turner, Lohja

Are you an experienced CNC turner with proven Fanuc programming skills? You might be the right fit for the job!

Location: Lohja
Employment: Fixed-term employment with a possibility of long-term employment
Salary: 15 - 22 € / hour depending on skills and work experience

Wellpack is looking for a skilled CNC turner for our client company in Lohja to manufacture demanding industrial products. The client is a long-established Finnish technology industry company that manufactures demanding products and assemblies for industrial applications. Its production is characterized by high quality, strong technical expertise, and the machining of demanding materials.

Could you have the right CNC machining skills for the job? Read more about the job description and qualifications!

What is the work like?

As a CNC turner, you will work on a wide range of machining tasks. You will independently program and operate CNC lathes, so the role requires previous experience with Fanuc controls and programming directly at the machine. The machines used are modern CNC lathes, including machines with sub-spindles and tailstocks.

The materials and component sizes vary, offering a broad range of machining tasks and technically interesting work.

The work is currently carried out in one shift from Monday to Friday, 40 hours per week, with the possibility of moving to a two-shift system. Depending on production needs, there may also be opportunities to work longer days and weekends. The position will start as soon as possible, according to agreement.

We expect you to have

* Previous work experience in CNC turning

* Independent Fanuc control and programming skills

* A precise and quality-oriented approach to work

* Carefulness and a responsible attitude

* A valid Occupational Safety Card

* Good Finnish or English language skills

The following are considered an advantage

* Experience with other controls

* Experience with a CAM-software

* Experience in machining demanding or large components

* Experience in machining titanium and other demanding materials

We offer you

* Full-time work in varied CNC turning tasks

* The opportunity to work with components of different sizes and materials

* A versatile range of machines and technically interesting tasks

* The opportunity to make full use of your CNC programming and turning skills

* The possibility of working longer days and weekends depending on production needs

* Assistance with arranging accommodation, if needed

* Competitive salary

* Salary: 15 - 22 € / hour depending on skills and work experience

You will be employed by Wellpack, a high-quality staffing services company established in 2013. Wellpack is particularly known as a trusted partner in the industrial and defence industries. We connect skilled professionals with high-quality jobs and contribute to employment in Finland.

Got interested? Apply quick!

Submit your application promptly through the Apply for this position link in the job advertisement. Applications will be reviewed and interviews conducted during the application period. The position will be filled as soon as a suitable candidate is found.

In your application, please describe in particular your CNC turning experience, programming skills, the machines you have worked with, and the materials and types of components you have machined.

For more information about the position, please contact Wellpacks recruitment team by email at wellpack@wellpack.fi [wellpack@wellpack.fi].

jobs.title: Site Engineers
jobs.description:
Would you like to help build reliable and safe infrastructure that makes a real difference in people's everyday lives?

Destia is looking for several Site Engineers for projects starting in early 2027. Your role may focus on one of the following areas: scheduling, safety, quantity management, quality, or environmental management.

What kind of role and team would you be joining?

As a Site Engineer, you will play a key role in the project team. Within your area of responsibility, you will help ensure that schedules and quality are managed throughout the construction phase, while making sure that work is carried out safely, with due consideration for the environment and in accordance with agreed requirements.

Your key responsibilities

- Preparing, implementing and monitoring project schedules

- Quantity management, tracking and reporting

- Environmental engineering and management

- Financial management, including cost monitoring, forecasting and invoicing

- Managing additional and variation works, including identifying, calculating and submitting quotations for them

- Safety monitoring, guidance, preventive measures and documentation

- Quality assurance and documentation

- Quantity management and control

- Liaising with authorities and supporting permit processes

In your application, we would be pleased to hear which aspects of site engineering interest you most.

You will work closely with the Site Manager, site supervisors, designers and other stakeholders. In this role, you will have a tangible impact on the quality and smooth execution of our projects.

The position is permanent, and your first project will be located in Northern Ostrobothnia or elsewhere in Northern Finland. The role requires a willingness to travel and regular travel between project sites. If you are based in another location and travel to the project site for work, Destia will reimburse work-related travel expenses, pay daily allowances, and cover accommodation costs in accordance with the company's travel policy.

Watch the video below to hear how your future colleagues describe their experiences on site!
Learn more about Destias services on our website!

How can you succeed best in this role?

At Destia, everything we do is guided by our values: fairness, togetherness, renewal and success.

As a Site Engineer, you will help ensure that figures add up and quality standards are met, while understanding how decisions and solutions affect project delivery.

To succeed in this role, you will have:

- A relevant technical degree, such as a Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a Master of Science in Technology (M.Sc. Tech.) or equivalent qualification

- Experience in similar roles, with a focus on quality, safety, scheduling or environmental management

- Good IT skills and experience with industry-specific software

- Good English skills

You do not need to be an experienced professional; we also welcome applications from professionals at an earlier stage of their careers who are eager to learn and develop. What matters most is a proactive and analytical approach, strong collaboration skills, and a desire to grow as part of a team building high-quality, sustainable infrastructure for people.

What we promise at Destia

At Destia, you get to do meaningful work that impacts peoples everyday lives. We build and maintain infrastructure throughout its lifecycle together with experts from various fields in teams where everyones contribution matters. With us, you can develop your expertise and shape your career path in your own direction, including internationally as part of the Colas Group.

We want everyone to feel welcome at Destia, regardless of their background. We treat each other equally and with respect and believe that the best solutions emerge when people can be themselves at work and bring different perspectives to the table. Through our everyday actions, we take responsibility for people, the environment and society. For us, sustainability is reflected in how we work, how we care for one another, and how we develop infrastructure that serves people far into the future. Most importantly, we want these commitments to be reflected in Destia employees' everyday experiences. [Read more about our sustainability work and the way we operate on our website.](https://destia.fi/en/about-us/sustainability/)

Interested? Here's how to apply

For further information about the position, please contact us at rekrytointi@destia.fi.

Apply for the position using the Apply for this job section in the job advertisement. Please include your CV and cover letter, telling us about your experience, skills and career aspirations.

Keep an eye on your email, as well regularly send you updates on the progress of the recruitment process. We often start interviewing promising candidates while the application period is still open, and may move quickly to a hiring decision once we find the right person.

We also ask all applicants to share their feedback so that we can continuously improve our recruitment process!


Henkilöstöedut

jobs.title: Assistant Professor in Materials for Power Electronics / Printed Electronics
jobs.description:
The cross-border region Denmark-Germany is a powerhouse in industrial electronics. The Centre for Industrial Electronics (CIE) at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) was established by a strong partnership between industry, academia and regional authorities. CIE is located at the campus of SDU Sønderborg and surrounded by a vibrant industrial environment. CIE is part of the Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering at the Faculty of Engineering.

 

Job description 

We are seeking an innovative and visionary Assistant Professor to join the Centre for Industrial Electronics in Sønderborg. The Centre currently has 40 staff, including full and associate professors, assistant professors, postdoctoral researchers, PhD students, and support staff. Funding has been secured to support to establish new research and test laboratories in key areas of industrial electronics. Our ambition is to deliver excellence in research, innovation, and education.

It is our vision that the Centre for Industrial Electronics at SDU will excel in areas of key relevance for companies in the region of Southern Denmark and beyond. 

Candidates are thus required to have a proven research records at least one of the following fields:

  • General power electronics and its reliability

  • Multimaterial additive manufacturing

  • Printed electronics

  • Polymer composites and nanocomposites for energy applications

  • Surface and interface engineering

  • Dielectric materials and capacitor technology

  • Materials for power electronics

  • Energy-device manufacturing

  • Sustainable and circular electronics

 

Qualifications

The candidates must have a PhD in Electrical Engineering/Materials science/Mechanical engineering, or a closely related discipline. 

We also expect:

  • An outstanding research and publication track record 

  • Experience with industrial collaboration

  • Research experience in multi-material additive manufacturing of functional polymer composites

  • Experience developing polymer nanocomposite dielectrics and thin-film capacitors

  • Knowledge of nanoparticle surface modification, dispersion, and interface engineering

  • Hands-on experience in materials processing, device fabrication, and electrical characterization

  • Ability to investigate relationships between material structure, manufacturing conditions, and electrical performance

  • Peer-reviewed publications in functional materials, additive manufacturing, or energy-device research

  • Experience collaborating across materials science and electrical engineering.

Further desirable qualifications:

  • Experience with bio-based, self-healing, or temperature-resistant capacitor materials

  • Knowledge of scalable thin-film fabrication, including layer-by-layer deposition or coating.

  • Experience translating research into industrial applications, particularly embedded heating, sensing, or battery-conditioning systems.

  • Experience preparing research proposals, securing research resources, and training students.

 

Contact and further information

For information about the Institute of Mechanical and Electrical engineering, which encompasses SDU Electrical Engineering please see https://www.sdu.dk/en/ime.

For specific information on section and centre, please visit www.sdu.dk/ee and www.sdu.dk/cie. 

You are also welcome to contact the Head of the CIE, Professor Thomas Ebel (ebel@sdu.dk,  +45 93 50 72 05) for further information. 

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

 

Application

Applicants are advised to read the SDU information on how to apply.

A panel will assess the qualification of the candidate for the described post based on the submitted material. 

The application should include:

  • Curriculum Vitae.

  • Motivated application. 

  • Ideas for research and development activities.

  • Account of significant contributions to innovation in Electrical Engineering and Industrial Engineering Electronics.

  • Complete list of publications.

  • Publications most relevant to the position. 

  • Summary and documentation of teaching experience, including account of experience in training students and outreach. You may attach a Teaching Portfolio. 

  • Master’s and PhD degree certificates or equivalent (original and an official English translation). 

  • References/reference letters may also be included.

  • A statement/documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included. 

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

 

The application deadline is November 15, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation. Read about the Assessment and selection process.  

 

Employment terms

Appointment as an assistant professor is temporary and for an initial 3-year period, and the position is open from start of 2027.

During employment, the assistant professor will complete the Lecturer Training Programme. 

Employment as an assistant professor requires academic qualifications at a minimum of PhD level at the time of employment. Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for assistant professor as described therein. 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

 

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

Further information for international applicants about entering and working in Denmark. You may also visit WorkinDenmark for additional information.

Further information about The Faculty of Engineering.

jobs.title: Sales and Customer Relations Manager
jobs.description:
**We are looking for a SALES AND CUSTOMER RELATIONS MANAGER**

**Do you get a buzz from turning interest into sales?**

**&** Espoo theatre brings surprising performing arts from Finland and around the world to the stage. We are a dynamic theatre with an ambitious programme and an open-minded audience, and now we want to reinvent the way we approach sales.

Join us as our Sales and Customer Relations Manager, finding new audiences for our inspiring productions and building customer relationships that last from one season to the next. In this role, you will help shape who we reach, what we offer them, and how we turn interest into sales.

Your role will combine proactive sales, customer relationship building and sales development.

- **Win new customers.** You will identify opportunities, start conversations – particularly with businesses – and turn initial enquiries into proposals and confirmed sales.

- **Develop compelling packages to sell.** You will identify audiences for initiatives such as shared ticket offers and create appealing packages around our programme for businesses, organisations, and groups of all kinds.

- **Build lasting customer relationships.** You will look after our existing customers and work with us to design a loyalty programme that encourages long-term engagement.

- **Reimagine group sales.** You will lead a group sales development project and work with the team to improve our existing programme for group organisers.

- **Track results and keep improving.** You will test new approaches and assess what delivers results.


**What are we looking for?**

- **You have a strong track record in winning new customers, developing sales, and creating successful concepts.** You have opened doors, brought in new customers, and grown sales.

- **Use CRM and ticketing systems with confidence.** Previous experience of Lippu.fi systems would be an advantage.

- You know how to connect with people face to face, by phone, by email, and online. You listen, identify what the customer needs, and give them a compelling reason to come to the theatre.

- You manage your work in a structured way: planning, prioritising, taking action, and following through on commitments. You are comfortable using digital customer relationship management tools.

- Knowledge of the theatre and / or any other art and creative sector would be an advantage, but your experience may equally come from another field, provided you are genuinely interested in our programme and know how to find audiences for it.


You will report to the Sales and Marketing Director and be supported by our seven-person marketing and communications team – a place where ideas do not have to arrive fully formed and where we are not afraid to change direction. You will bring the customer perspective and sales expertise to our shared thinking, with the freedom to influence, experiment, and drive sales at **&** forward.

jobs.title: Mekaanikko, Autohuolto Seitoy Oy
jobs.description:
Olemme paikallinen, pieni ja ketterä monimerkkikorjaamo, sekä Toyota merkkihuolto. Kuuluminen valtakunnallisiin E-expert ja Autoasi -autokorjaamoketjuihin takaa meille aina ajan tasalla olevat tiedot ja taidot korjata sekä huoltaa kaikki merkit valmistajien ohjeiden mukaan tehdastakuun säilyessä näin ollen ennallaan. Lue lisää **https://seitoy.fi/**

**Etsimme asiakkaallemme Autohuolto Seitoy Oy:lle mekaanikkoa vakituiseen työsuhteeseen**

**Mitä tulisit meillä tekemään?**

Tehtävässä pääset tekemään monipuolisesti mekaanikon perustöitä. Päivittäisiin työtehtäviisi kuuluvat muun muassa autojen määräaikaishuollot, jarru- ja alustatyöt sekä iskunvaimentimien vaihdot. Lisäksi hoidat rengastöitä ja muita huoltokorjaamon arkeen kuuluvia tehtäviä. Työ on käytännönläheistä ja sopii hyvin henkilölle, joka viihtyy käsillä tekemisessä ja haluaa kehittää omaa teknistä osaamistaan aidossa työympäristössä.

Työt alkavat joustavasti sopimuksen mukaan. Työaika on arkisin klo 7.30-15.30 tai 8-16 ja työtunnit ovat 37,5 viikossa. Työskentelypaikkasi sijaitsee Seinäjoella Päivölänkadulla.

**Mitä odotamme?**

Etsimme henkilöä, jolla on oikea asenne ja halu oppia. Tehtävä sopii vastavalmistuneelle automekaanikolle, eikä aikaisempi työkokemus ole välttämätöntä. Tarjoamme myös kokeneemmallekin osaajalle haastavia tehtäviä. Eduksi katsomme ilmastointilaitteiden pätevyyden ja sähköturvallisuusosaamisen, mutta ne eivät ole pakollisia. Suomen kielen taito on edellytys tehtävässä toimimiselle.

**Mitä tarjoamme?**

Tarjoamme sinulle mahdollisuuden liittyä mukaan käytännönläheiseen ja osaavaan työyhteisöön, jossa hyvä fiilis ja tekemisen meininki näkyvät arjessa. Työyhteisössä toimii autohuollon ammattilaisia ja meillä arvostetaan yhteistyötä, huumoria ja reipasta otetta työntekoon. Palkkasi määräytyy osaamisesi ja kokemuksesi mukaan – haarukka 11,50-20,20 €/h. Työsopimus kirjoitetaan Seitoyn kanssa.

**Kiinnostuitko?**

Laitathan hakemuksesi linkin kautta mahdollisimman pian, mutta kuitenkin viimeistään **30.10.2026** mennessä, sillä aloitamme haastattelut jo hakuaikana ja paikka täytetään heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

Rekrytointiprosessi toteutetaan yhteistyössä Biisonin kanssa. Jos kaipaat lisätietoja työtehtävästä, niin olethan yhteydessä puh. 0504752852 tai roope.takala@biisoni.fi

Postdoc Position in Computational Materials Chemistry at the Mads Clausen Institute
jobs.description:
We are seeking an enthusiastic new colleague as a Postdoctoral Research Associate in Computational Materials Chemistry, with a strong background in first-principles (DFT) calculations, computational materials science, and machine-learning-driven materials discovery. The successful candidate is expected to have experience in areas such as high-throughput DFT calculations, thermodynamic and phase stability analysis, crystal structure prediction, materials informatics, and machine learning, preferably applied to inorganic functional materials. Knowledge of solid-state chemistry, perovskite-related materials, and materials databases would be highly advantageous. You are invited to join the Mads Clausen Institute (MCI) at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) in Sønderborg, Denmark. The position is for two years, with an expected starting date of 01.03.2027.

MCI is a part of the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) and covers research and education, including applications of engineering sciences. Our working language is English, reflecting the fact that far more than half of our students and staff have international roots. We are located at SDU’s beautiful campus in Sønderborg, in the inspiring building of Alsion, which is a centre for science, culture and learning in the heart of Sønderborg and perched on the strait of water separating the island of Als from the mainland. The university has very close relations with industries in Sønderborg, Southern Denmark, and Northern Germany.

The successful candidate is expected to carry out research mainly within a project funded by the VILLUM Foundation. The project is hosted by the nanotechnology centre NanoSYD, part of the Mads Clausen Institute (MCI), and integrated into CatMatX, a research laboratory led by Professor Mirabbos Hojamberdiev and focused on developing next-generation functional materials for sustainable energy and environmental applications. The research will focus on the machine-learning-driven computational discovery of novel double-perovskite oxynitrides, integrating first-principles (DFT) calculations, high-throughput computational screening, thermodynamic and phase-stability analysis, materials informatics, and machine-learning approaches. Particular emphasis will be placed on predicting the formability, thermodynamic stability, crystal and electronic structures, cation/anion ordering, and functional properties of previously unexplored double-perovskite oxynitrides. The computational predictions will be closely integrated with experimental synthesis, structural characterization, and evaluation of selected materials for solar water splitting within CatMatX. The successful candidate is also expected to contribute actively to the supervision of MSc and PhD students affiliated with SDU NanoSYD, preparation of project reports, presentations, and scientific publications, and development of research proposals supporting ongoing and future activities at SDU NanoSYD.

Job Description and Responsibilities

  • Implementation of research tasks related to the project and CatMatX Lab;

  • Collaborative and independent research planning focused on the machine-learning-driven computational discovery of double-perovskite oxynitrides;

  • Development and application of first-principles (DFT) calculations and high-throughput computational workflows for predicting crystal structures, formability, thermodynamic stability, electronic properties, and cation/anion ordering;

  • Development and application of materials-informatics and machine-learning approaches for accelerated screening and identification of promising double-perovskite oxynitrides;

  • Construction, curation, and analysis of computational materials datasets, including integration of data from first-principles calculations and available materials databases;

  • Independent computational data analysis, interpretation of research results, and identification of promising materials for experimental synthesis and validation in close collaboration with experimental researchers;

  • Scientific communication and presentation of research results at group seminars, scientific conferences, and project meetings;

  • Supervision and co-supervision of MSc and PhD students and contribution to collaborative research activities within CatMatX and NanoSYD;

  • Publication of project results in international peer-reviewed scientific journals and contribution to the preparation of research proposals and project reports.

  • Supervision of BSc, MSc, and exchange/visiting students conducting research on related topics;

  • Assistance with teaching activities;

  • Assistance with the establishment and development of research infrastructure;

  • Contribution to the preparation of grant proposals for external research funding.

Potential Responsibilities 

  • Supervision of BSc, MSc, and exchange/visiting students conducting research on related topics;

  • Assistance with teaching activities;

  • Assistance with the establishment and development of research infrastructure;

  • Contribution to the preparation of grant proposals for external research funding.

 Mandatory qualifications 

  • PhD degree in Computational Materials Chemistry, Computational Materials Science, Theoretical Chemistry, Condensed Matter Physics, Chemical Physics, or a closely related field;

  • Strong theoretical background and demonstrated hands-on experience in first-principles calculations based on density functional theory (DFT);

  • Proven experience with widely used electronic-structure codes, such as VASP, Quantum ESPRESSO, GPAW, CASTEP, or similar computational packages;

  • Experience in calculating and interpreting electronic, structural, magnetic, and/or thermodynamic properties of materials;

  • Experience with computational modelling of solid-state materials, preferably including transition-metal compounds, mixed-anion materials, magnetic materials, and/or catalytic materials;

  • Experience with machine learning, high-throughput computational screening, materials databases, and/or data-driven materials discovery;

  • Strong programming and scripting skills, preferably in Python, and experience with computational workflows and high-performance computing (HPC) environments;

  • A strong track record of publications in international peer-reviewed scientific journals, including publications as a leading author;

  • Excellent command of English, both written and spoken;

  • Ability to conduct research independently and work effectively as part of a multidisciplinary team;

  • Strong social, communication and scientific presentation skills;

  • Willingness and ability to collaborate closely with experimental researchers and external research partners.

The following qualifications are advantageous

  • Knowledge and/or research experience in solid-state chemistry, materials chemistry, and inorganic materials synthesis;

  • Experience with mixed-anion compounds, particularly transition-metal oxynitrides and nitrides;

  • Experience with materials characterization techniques, such as XRD, XPS, SEM/TEM, Raman, and UV–Vis spectroscopy;

  • Research experience with advanced characterization techniques at synchrotron and/or neutron radiation facilities;

  • Knowledge and/or research experience in electrochemistry, photoelectrochemistry, photocatalysis, and solar water splitting;

  • Experience in connecting computational predictions with experimental synthesis, characterization, and materials performance;

  • Proven experience in national and/or international collaborative research projects and strong interest in interdisciplinary research.

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support. 

Application 

Applicants are advised to read the SDU information on how to apply. 

Assessment of the candidates is based on the application material, and the application must include the following documents in English: 

  • A one-page motivation letter describing the applicant’s previous research experience and its relevance to the offered position;

  • Curriculum Vitae (CV);

  • Certificates and diplomas for Bachelor’s, Master’s, and PhD degrees, including transcripts in Danish and/or English;

  • A complete list of publications, with publications most relevant to the offered position clearly highlighted, especially the first-authored publications;

  • A research statement outlining computational strategies for the discovery and investigation of novel transition-metal-based mixed-anion compounds, particularly (oxy)nitrides, including first-principles calculations and machine-learning-driven materials discovery;

  • A reference letter may be submitted but is not required.

The files should not exceed 10 MB.

The application deadline is November 30, 2026 at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST)  

Read more and apply at https://www.sdu.dk/en/om-sdu/job-sdu

jobs.description:
**Haemme liikenteenohjaajia datakeskushankkeelle Vaasaan!**

**Työt alkavat heti.**

**Keitä olemme?**

Ramudden luo kokonaisvaltaisia työturvallisuusratkaisuja tietöihin, rakennuksiin, tiloihin, rautateille ja erilaisiin infrastruktuurin projekteihin. Teemme työmme turvallisesti ja välittäen!

**Ketä haemme?**

Haemme liikenteenohjaajia Vaasassa sijaitsevalle datakeskushankkeelle. Mitä tarjoamme? Tarjoamme turvallisen ja ammattitaitoisen työyhteisön. Tavoitteenamme on varmistaa se, että sinä ja kaikki muut liikenteessä liikkujat pääsevät turvallisesti töihin tai kouluun sekä takaisin kotiin. Minne sitten olettekin matkalla, turvaamme matkasi!

**Mitä työ sisältää?**

Liikenteenohjaajan työhön datakeskuksella kuuluu varmistaa työmaan läpikulkevan liikenteen turvallinen kulku ja eteneminen. Pidämme huolta myös kollegoistamme.

Työtä tehdään kahdessa vuorossa arkisin ja lauantaisin 06-21 välisenä aikana. Työajoista on mahdollista sopia joustavasti.

**Mitä vaaditaan?**

Sinun tulee olla täysi-ikäinen

Sinulla tulee olla normaalit aistit: näkö, kuulo ja reaktiokyky

Sinulla tulee olla vähintään AM121 tai B-luokan ajokortti

Odotamme liikenteenohjaajiltamme myös hyvää liikennetuntemusta.

**Koulutamme ja perehdytämme sinut tehtävään alla olevien koulutusten avulla:**

Tieturva 1-koulutus

Työturvallisuuskoulutus

Liikenteenohjaajan pätevyys

**Palkkaa maksamme Asfalttialan työehtosopimuksen (TES) mukaisesti.**

**Sen lisäksi tarjoamme sinulle:**

Turvallisen ja ammattitaitoisen työyhteisön

Laadukkaat työvälineet ja -varusteet

Reilun ja tasapuolisen kohtelun

Mahdollisuuden edetä uralla sekä

Erilaisia työsuhde-etuja

jobs.title: Har du hænderne godt skruet på? Vi søger 2 produktionsmedarbejdere i Holstebro!
jobs.description:
Er du praktisk anlagt, kvalitetsbevidst og klar på nye udfordringer? Så har vi måske jobbet til dig!

På vegne af en stor og solid virksomhed i Holstebro, der producerer aluminiumsfacader og vinduer, søger vi 2 medarbejdere til produktion og montage.

Du behøver ikke nødvendigvis at være uddannet håndværker. Det vigtigste er, at du har lyst til at arbejde med hænderne, er nysgerrig på nye opgaver og måske har en lille håndværker gemt i maven.

Du bliver en del af et team med gode kolleger, hvor samarbejde, kvalitet og en god arbejdsindsats er i fokus.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

Du kommer blandt andet til at arbejde med:

  • Samling af aluminiumsfacader og aluminiumsvinduer

  • Montering af beslag og forskellige komponenter

  • Påsætning af gummi- og tætningslister

  • Lettere montageopgaver

  • Andre praktiske opgaver i produktionen

Hvem er du?

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Er mødestabil og tager ansvar for dine opgaver

  • Har hænderne godt skruet på og lyst til at lære nyt

  • Arbejder omhyggeligt og har sans for kvalitet og detaljer

  • Trives med fysisk arbejde og praktiske opgaver

  • Kan samarbejde med dine kolleger og bidrage positivt til teamet

Det vigtigste er din indstilling og lyst til at lære. Har du praktisk erfaring fra tidligere arbejde, produktion, montage eller håndværk, er det selvfølgelig en fordel – men din motivation er mindst lige så vigtig.

Du skal som minimum beherske det danske sprog i skrift og tale svarende til modul 3 i dansk undervisning.

Vi tilbyder

  • Fuldtidsstilling på daghold

  • Ansættelse på ubestemt tid

  • Opstart snarest muligt

  • En arbejdsplads med gode kolleger og mulighed for at lære nye færdigheder

Lyder det som noget for dig?

Så vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig!

Medarbejderne ApS håndterer ansættelsen for virksomheden. Vi er et veldrevet rekrutterings & vikarbureau med ni afdelinger fordelt i landet. Vi er medlem af Vikar Branchen DI, som bla. forpligtiger os til at oveholde lovpligtoge regler så som GDPR. Vi passer godt på dig hos Medarbejderne ApS.

Bemærk at ansøgninger og CV via mails ikke behandles.

Du kan ansøge om jobbet via dette link; https://medarbejderne.peopletrust.dk/candidate/?module=candidateweb&page=Job&action=readMore&jobId=1020176

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

jobs.title: Avustaja sympaattiselle asiakkaalle Sotkamoon
jobs.description:
**Avustaja sympaattiselle asiakkaalle**

Haemme avustajaa osa-aikaiseen työhön avustamaan sympaattista asiakastamme Sotkamossa.

Me olemme Hemby, ikääntyneiden palveluita rohkeasti uudistava yritys, joka tarjoaa iloa ja turvaa ikäihmisten arkeen. Mottomme on: autamme ikääntyviä kuin omaa äitiämme.

Kasvamme jatkuvasti ja etsimme lisää avustajia tiimiimme. Löydät lyhyen ja helposti täytettävän hakulomakkeemme täältä: https://helpper.hemby.fi/apply

**Mitä helpperiltä vaaditaan?**

Helppereiltä ei vaadita sote-alan kokemusta tai tutkintoa. Tärkeää on, että palat halusta auttaa ja sinulla on reipas työote. Työtä voi tehdä oman tilanteen mukaan ja työajat ovat myös hyvin joustavat.

Helpperin työtä voivat tehdä kaikki yli 18-vuotiaat opiskelijoista eläkeläisiin.

Tärkeintä on, että haluat viettää aikaa ikäihmisten kanssa ja tehdä omalla toiminnallasi heidän arjestaan parempaa. Työtä voi tehdä oman tilanteen mukaan ja työajat ovat hyvin joustavat.

**Mikä on parasta helpperin työssä?**

Kysyimme tätä helppereiltämme, ja näin he vastasivat:

"Ihmisten kiireetön kohtaaminen ja ystävystyminen seniorin kanssa."

"Toisen auttaminen ja merkityksellisyyden tunne."

Auttaminen kokonaisvaltaisesti seniorin tarpeiden mukaan."

**Helpperinä saat:**

Oman nimetyn ikäihmisen, jota autat arjen askareissa ja olet hänelle seurana Joustavat työajat, jotka sopivat mainiosti esimerkiksi opiskelun ohelle tai lisätyöksi. Tavallisin työaika on 2-10h/vko. Kilpailukykyisen palkan: 13,20-15,98 €/h + työehtosopimuksen mukaiset lisät sekä lomakorvaukset. Hyvät etenemismahdollisuudet: Voit edetä kokemuksen ja hyvän asiakaspalautteen ansiosta pro- tai guru-helpperiksi ja saada korotusta palkkaasi!

Hakemukset lähetetään sähköisen lomakkeen kautta. Olemme kaikkiin hakijoihin yhteydessä hakemuksen lähettämisen jälkeen.

Lähetä hakemus helpperiksi täältä: https://www.hemby.fi/hae-helpperiksi

Lue lisää Hembystä täältä:https://www.hemby.fi/

Mikäli sinulla on kysyttävää helpperiksi ryhtymisestä, laita meille sähköpostia osoitteeseen rekry@hemby.fi, niin jutellaan lisää!

jobs.title: Er du mester i at kontakte nye kunder i DACH og kan du udføre værdibaseret salg?
jobs.description:
Kan du stille skarpt på rengøringsbranchen og yde kompetent og troværdig rådgivning, hvor du sætter dig i kundens sted? Har du evnen til at tage ansvar og levere en professionel salgsoplevelse, hvor dine kunder opnår succes? Så er du den sælger, vi søger til vores salgsteam.


Om jobbet

Du bliver en del af vores salgsteam, og din primære opgave bliver, at opsøge og skabe relationer og salg til kundeemner i DACH.

Helt konkret kommer du til at:

  • booke præsentationsmøder med nye kunder via telefonen, e-mail og LinkedIn
  • afholde online præsentationsmøder for nye kunder
  • lave tilbud til nye kunder
  • udføre salgs- og tilbudsopfølgning
  • deltage i messer og events i DACH (Der kan forventes op til 10 rejsedage årligt i jobbet.)

Vi anvender bl.a. følgende systemer: HubSpot CRM, Dealfront, Leadfeeder, LinkedIn, Relatel, Whereby og Demio.


Vi forestiller os at du

  • har erfaring med at bruge telefonen til at opsøge nye kunder og booke mødeaftaler
  • taler og skriver dansk og tysk på forretningsniveau
  • er god til sætte dig ind i kundens behov
  • arbejder struktureret og systematisk
  • ikke er bange for at tage ansvar og arbejder proaktivt for at opnå dine salgsmål
  • har erfaring med AI-værktøjer og bruger dem aktivt i dit daglige arbejde

Under ansættelsen lægger vi vægt på din erfaring med de nævnte opgaver, systemer og eventuel erfaring fra rengøringsbranchen, men vigtigst af alt er, at du elsker at tale med nye mennesker og forfølge dine salgsmål for at skabe resultater.


Vi kan tilbyde dig

  • Adgang til avancerede værktøjer inden for salg
  • Dygtige kollegaer og en støttende arbejdskultur, hvor vi løfter i flok
  • Fleksible arbejdstider for en optimal work-life balance
  • Eget kontor i virksomheden
  • Frihed til at planlægge og strukturere dit eget arbejde inden for en fælles ramme
  • Mulighed for faglig udvikling gennem kurser, workshops og intern salgstræning
  • Kaffe og frugtordning samt fælles morgenmad hver fredag
  • Mulighed for at deltage i frokostordning
  • Regelmæssige sociale arrangementer og aktiviteter
  • Udvikling på både personligt og fagligt plan med løbende status- og udviklingssamtaler med din manager
  • Konkurrencedygtig løn og pensionsordning ved PFA


Om virksomheden

Fra vores kontor i Odense driver vi CleanManager, en innovativ softwarevirksomhed med et klart mål: at optimere drift og effektivitet inden for rengøringsbranchen. Vi har i dag mere end 15.000 brugere på vores software og er markedsledende i Danmark. Vi er også godt på vej ind på markederne i Tyskland og Storbritannien. Vi er i øjeblikket 24 medarbejdere, der samarbejder på tværs af teams – dog med undtagelse af når vandrepokalen i bordfodbold eller backgammon er på spil. Se mere på www.cleanmanager.dk.

CleanManager er en del af zvoove, Europas førende leverandør af software- og AI-løsninger til vikarbureauer, rengøringsbranchen og sikkerhedstjenester. zvoove digitaliserer og optimerer arbejdsgange for mere end 8.000 kunder og håndterer årligt administrationen af over 3 millioner medarbejdere, 21 mia. euro i løn og 3 millioner ansøgninger. Med 1000 medarbejdere fordelt på 24 lokationer i Europa og Latinamerika er zvoove med til at styrke konkurrenceevnen i hele servicebranchen.


Arbejdstid og løn

Fuldtidsstilling.

Arbejdstiden er 37 timer pr. uge og løn aftales ud fra kvalifikationer.


Ansøgning

Søg via HR-On. Vedhæft CV, eventuelle anbefalinger og anden relevant information.

jobs.title: Rengøring 30-37 timer

Du møder ind på vores kontor, hvor du sammen med en kollega kører rundt på forskellige opgaver i firmabil. Jobbet er ledigt nu - så du skal kunne begynde meget hurtigt.

Vi har overenskomst, så løn og vilkår er ud fra Serviceoverenskomsten.

jobs.description:
Etsimme asiakasyrityksellemme Sähkö-Team Oy:lle sähkömoottoreiden huoltoon ja korjaukseen keskittyvää asentajaa Helsingin Roihupellossa sijaitsevalle korjaamolle.

Sähkö-Team Oy on vuonna 1977 perustettu sähköalan yritys, jonka ydinosaamista ovat sähkökoneiden ja sähkömoottoreiden huolto ja korjaus. Yrityksen korjaamolla huolletaan ja korjataan monenlaisia sähkömoottoreita ja sähkökoneita eri käyttötarkoituksiin. Työhön kuuluu muun muassa sähköisiä ja mekaanisia korjauksia, moottoreiden vianmääritystä, huoltoja sekä tarvittaessa käämintätöitä. Sähkö-Team toimii monimerkkikorjaamona ja palvelee asiakkaita pääasiassa pääkaupunkiseudulla, mutta sähkömoottoreita saapuu huoltoon myös muualta Suomesta.

Toimenkuva:

Etsimme käytännönläheistä ja teknisesti osaavaa henkilöä osaksi Sähkö-Teamin korjaamotiimiä. Työ on kokoaikainen ja vakituinen ja työtä tehdään arkisin klo 07.30 – 16.00. Tehtävässä työllistyt suoraan asiakasyrityksemme kirjoille.

Työ painottuu sähkömoottoreiden huoltoon, vianmääritykseen ja korjaukseen. Tehtävässä pääset käsittelemään erilaisia sähkömoottoreita ja sähkökoneita aina vian selvittämisestä moottorin purkamiseen, korjaamiseen, kokoonpanoon ja testaukseen asti.

Työskentely tapahtuu pääsääntöisesti korjaamolla, mutta työhön kuuluu tarvittaessa asiakaskohteissa tehtävät vianmääritys- ja mittaustyöt. Joskus isoja sähkömoottoreita huolletaan myös paikan päällä asiakkaan tiloissa, jolloin työskennellään työryhmässä yhdessä muiden Sähkö-Teamin asentajien kanssa.

Työtehtäviisi voi kuulua esimerkiksi:

\- sähkömoottoreiden huolto, korjaus ja testaus

\- moottoreiden purku, tarkastus ja kokoonpano

\- sähköisten vikojen vianmääritys, mittaukset ja kunnon arviointi

\- mekaaniset huolto- ja asennustyöt, kuten laakereiden ja tiivisteiden vaihdot

\- asiakaskohteissa tehtävät vianmääritys- ja kuntokartoituskäynnit

Työnhakijalta odotamme:

Etsimme henkilöä, jolla on sähköalan koulutus ja käytännön ymmärrys sähkömoottoreista sekä sähkö- ja mekaniikkatöistä. Sinulla voi olla esimerkiksi taustaa teollisuuden kunnossapidosta, sähköasennuksista, koneiden huollosta tai muista tehtävistä, joissa sähköinen ja mekaaninen osaaminen yhdistyvät.

Tehtävässä menestyminen edellyttää erityisesti:

\- sähköalan koulutusta

\- ymmärrystä sähkömoottoreiden toiminnasta ja rakenteesta

\- sähköalan perusteiden ja sähkötöiden hallintaa

\- mekaanista asennusosaamista

\- kykyä tehdä vianmääritystä ja tulkita mittaustuloksia

\- käytännönläheistä ja itsenäistä työotetta

\- B-luokan ajokorttia

\- sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa

Tarjoamme sinulle:

Tarjoamme sinulle kokoaikaisen ja vakituisen työn vakavaraisessa yrityksessä. Sähkö-Teamilla on vuosikymmenten kokemus sähköalalta ja sähkökoneiden korjaamisesta, joten sinulla on mahdollisuus hyödyntää omaa ammattitaitoa monipuolisesti ja samalla oppia lisää sähkömoottoreista, sähkökoneista ja niiden korjaamisesta.

jobs.title: Student Assistant in our Control Center - night shift position
jobs.description:
Nordic RCC is looking for candidates with a technical background and interest in the role as operator in our control center – is this something for you?

Do you like working by firm and well-defined procedures, yet alert to interfere in the process when needed? Are you open-minded and enjoy working in a diverse and international team? And are you eager to be part of something new and meaningful?

The position will mainly cover the operator position during the shift from 21.00 PM- 07.15 AM during both weekdays, weekends and holiday periods. The shifts, of individually 10.25 hours length, are distributed throughout the operator team. The schedule is planned and updated 3 times a year, securing at least a planned period of 4 months into the future. You can expect an average of around 70-80 working hours per month.

You will be working alone in the office during the shifts, with an on-call colleague standby to assist in any technical matters if needed.

If you can say yes to the above, then you may be just the person we are looking for.

Join Nordic RCC, a fast-developing company determined to make a significant impact in the energy sector and to provide for a secure and efficient transition to the green, sustainable energy system.

Nordic RCC – supporting security of supply and the green transition

Nordic RCC provides calculations and recommendations to the four Nordic Electricity Transmission System Operators (TSOs), Energinet, Fingrid, Statnett and Svenska Kraftnät. The main aim of the services is to ensure transparency and help the TSOs with operational planning to ensure continued security of supply with an increase of renewables in the system. In short: We play a small but important part of enabling the green transition.

You will join a team of young, diverse, and enthusiastic colleagues of currently more than 20 nationalities, and at times work in virtual teams with expert colleagues from the Nordic TSOs and potentially from all of Europe.

We are not looking for a specific educational background, but an engineering or similar technical or data-scientific background is preferred.

Whether you are in your bachelor’s program, or master’s degree program, that is not critically important. What is more important is your profile as a whole and how you are assessed to fit within the Nordic RCC organization.   

Key responsibilities for the operator role will be:

  • Participating in the 24/7 control center shift roster: mainly covering the night hours 21.00 - 07.15.

  • The shift starts in the control center relieving a colleague operator from the evening shift. When time allows, and the processes for the evening have finalized successfully, you have an opportunity to enter an adjacent resting facility. During the shift, when alerted, your responsibility is to enter the control center within minutes, intervening in the operational challenge faced. Next morning at 07.00, the morning operator will relieve you from your shift responsibility.

  • Become an expert in executing the services provided from the 24/7 Nordic RCC control center.

  • Maintaining your qualifications and knowledge in the operator control systems, including through routinely joining parallel shift during office hours to train in all NRCC services under the guidance of operators.

  • Interface to the Nordic TSOs control centers.  

  • Cooperation with the TSOs securing the process of services.

  • Trouble shooting and fixing challenges in the services together with NRCC IT support.

  • KPI recording and reporting, weekly and monthly.

  • Aid the back-office operators in small tasks, such as visit approval to the core room.

Additional tasks and involvement

Depending on the flexibility and the competence of the candidate, together with the department needs, there will be an opportunity to be involved in other areas of responsibility. This way one will get a better understanding of the NRCC in general and meet fellow NRCC colleagues during normal business hours.

Other working areas, depending on department needs, can be:

  • Involvement in testing system updates and features to be introduced to the control center.

  • Quality assurance and updating operational procedures.

  • Quality assurance and data retrieval for operational reporting.

  • Provide analytical insights on operational planning scenarios.

You are open-minded, international mindset and excellence at working within structured patterns, at the same time the ability to maneuver within a huge spectrum of corner cases quickly, reliably, and independently.

You are structured and can appreciate a fast-paced environment from time to time. On a personal level you are open-minded, team-oriented and take responsibility.

Nordic RCC is an international office, so fluency in spoken and written English is required as well as a motivation for working in an international environment.
