jobs.title: Sähkö- ja automaatioasentaja, Algol Technics Oy
jobs.description:
_Algol Technics on teollisuuden kumppani ja materiaalinkäsittelyn asiantuntija. Algol Technics on osa suomalaista Algol-konsernia, jolla on kokemusta kansainvälisestä kaupasta vuodesta 1894 alkaen. Uskomme, että asiakkaidemme maailma automatisoituu, nopeutuu ja muuttuu aiempaa kompleksisemmaksi. Olemme vahvasti mukana tässä muutoksessa tarjoten asiakkaillemme sisälogistiikan ratkaisuja, mm. nostureita, robottisoluja, kuljettimia ja automaatiovarastoja sekä laajan valikoiman teknisiä tuotteita. Kaikkiin toimittamiimme ratkaisuihin tarjoamme kattavat kunnossapito- ja huoltopalvelut._

_Algol-konsernin yhteistyökumppaniverkosto on maailmanlaajuinen ja yhtiöllä on toimipisteitä kymmenessä eri maassa._

Miltä kuulostaisi vaihtelevat työtehtävät huollon ja kunnossapidon saralla? Lue eteenpäin, mitä Algol Technicsillä on tarjolla ja työllisty heidän kirjoilleen vakituiseen työsuhteeseen!

**Mitä tulisit tässä tehtävässä tekemään?**

Kunnossapidon ja huollon tavoitteena on pitää laitteistot toiminnassa keskeytyksittä. Algol Technicsin huoltoverkosto huolehtii siitä, että huoltotyöt sekä käynnissäpito hoidetaan ammattimaisesti ympäri Suomen.

Algolilla toimit huolto- ja kunnossapitotehtävissä eri asiakaskohteissa Varsinais-Suomen alueella. Päiviisi kuuluvat vaihtelevat tehtävät, jotka sisältävät monipuolisia sähköasennus- ja huoltotöitä pääsääntöisesti teollisuusnostureiden parissa. Huolehdit asiakasyrityksissä, että hommat etenevät ja linjastot liikkuvat. Pääset toimimaan itsenäisesti ja työssä liikkumiseen saat Algolilta käyttöösi auton. Toimit osana osaavaa tiimiä, jolta saat myös kattavan perehdytyksen tehtävään. Työaikasi on arkisin 7:00–15.30.

**Mitä odotamme sinulta?**

Sinulla on taustaa teollisuussähköstä, mutta tartut mielelläsi myös mekaanisiin töihin. Sähköalan osaamisen olet voinut hankkia koulutuksen tai käytännön työkokemuksen kautta. Työssä tehdään paljolti myös mekaanista asennusta, joten esimerkiksi autojen, koneiden tai muun tekniikan parissa harrastaminen antaa tehtävään hyvän pohjan.

Arvostamme omatoimista ja palveluhenkistä työotetta. Turvallisuussyistä tehtävässä edellytetään sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa.

**Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?**

Tarjoamme sinulle vakituisen työn mielenkiintoisissa tehtävissä ja osaamistasi vastaavan palkkauksen. Työsuhde on vakituinen ja kokoaikainen, ja työllistyt suoraan Algol Technicsin palvelukseen.

Pääset osaksi osaavaa ja sitoutunutta työyhteisöä, jossa tekeminen perustuu yhteistyöhön ja keskinäiseen luottamukseen. Työntekijöiden viihtyvyys näkyy arjessa ja vaihtuvuus on poikkeuksellisen pientä.

Algol Technics tarjoaa vakaan työympäristön osana pitkän historian omaavaa perheyritystä, jossa asiat tehdään suunnitelmallisesti ja luotettavasti. Taustalla on yli 130 vuoden historia saman perheen omistuksessa, mikä näkyy pitkäjänteisyytenä ja varmuutena arjessa.

Saat käyttöösi nykyaikaiset työkalut ja järjestelmät sekä kattavat työsuhde-edut, kuten työterveyshuollon ja Epassin.

**Kiinnostuitko?**

Tahdomme kuulla sinusta! Jätäthän hakemuksesi meille pikimmiten, mutta kuitenkin viimeistään **30.10.2026.** Tehtävässä aloitus sopimuksen mukaan. Tehtävään valittu henkilö työllistyy suoraan Algol Technicsin kirjoille.

Tehtävän rekrytoinnista vastaa Biisoni ja Algol Technicsin toiveesta mahdolliset yhteydenotot: roope.takala@biisoni.fi, p.0504752852

jobs.employer: ODA NORWAY AS AVD OSLO DISTRIBUSJON
jobs.description:
We’re looking for Part-Time Drivers to join Oda!

At Oda, we develop affordable grocery services to make the logistics of living surprisingly easy. First we built Norway’s leading online grocery store and now, partnered with Mathem in Sweden, we’re on our way to becoming the world’s most effective grocery system, delivering to thousands of Scandinavian doorsteps every week.

As part of our team, you’ll work with smart, passionate colleagues who bring their whole selves to work every day. It’s a fast-moving, collaborative environment where everyone is welcome and everyone’s opinion matters. Whether you're shaping the future of online retail, tackling complex logistical problems, or making everyday life better for our customers, your work will have a real impact. Read on to find out what part you could play in our story.


What you’ll be doing as a Driver 🚚

  • Report directly to our Driver Operating Managers and Team Leaders at your site as an essential part of our dedicated delivery team.

  • Be a Customer Hero: You’ll be on the road bringing groceries and smiles directly to our customers, ensuring a top-notch "Oda experience" at every doorstep.

  • Keep the wheels turning: You’ll handle loading and unloading with speed and care, ensuring every box arrives in perfect condition.

  • Own your ride: You’ll take pride in your van, keeping it clean, presentable, and ready for the road.

  • Pay it forward: You’ll help onboard and train new colleagues, sharing your best tips and tricks from the road.

  • Make us better: We value your brain as much as your driving! You’ll contribute your ideas to help us improve our routines and ways of working.


What you’ll need to succeed 🌟

  • A valid driving license (Class B). You’ve had your license for at least 2 years and feel confident and safe behind the wheel.

  • Good communication skills: Comfortable in speaking and writing English. If you also know Norwegian or another Nordic language, that’s a big plus!


What would be nice to have 💡

  • Enjoy being active and thrive in a physically demanding job

  • Comfortable working both independently and as part of a team

  • A strong work ethic and a "can-do" mindset

  • Service-minded and always looking for the best solutions

  • A genuine desire to make our customers happy

  • Responsible and always prioritize safety in traffic


What we offer 🚀

  • A chance to make a real impact as a Part-Time Driver in a fast-moving company with a product people love-while shaking up the grocery industry.

  • Teammates who aim high and have each other’s backs. We care about people, and that means supporting each other every step of the way.

  • A flat structure where we team up across disciplines to solve exciting challenges. Big ideas come from everywhere!

  • A transparent way of working. We use Slack to stay in the loop-less email, fewer meetings, more getting things done.

  • A chance to shape the future of grocery shopping while building a company that’s here to stay.


Practical information

  • Application deadline: We review applications on an ongoing basis and may close the process once the right candidates are found. We encourage you to apply as early as possible.

  • Start date: As soon as possible.

  • Position: 20% Part-time

  • Working hours: Saturday and Sunday, every other weekend.

    • Morning shift: 05:45-13:45

    • Evening shift: 13:30-21:30

  • Location: Verkseier Furulunds Vei 1, 0668 Oslo


To ensure a fair and efficient process for everyone, we use Hubert, our virtual assistant, to help us with the first selection. 🤖 Keep an eye on your inbox – shortly after applying, you’ll receive an email with an invite to a chat-based interview. Just make sure your email address is correct so the invite finds its way to you!

A few final words

At Oda, you’ll join a passionate, ambitious team working to change the future of grocery shopping. We’re all different—just like you—and we wouldn’t have it any other way. If you need any adjustments or support during the application process, just let us know, and we’ll do our best to help. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and want everyone to have an equal shot at landing the job.

Come build the future of grocery with us! Want to know more about how we work? Check out these posts on Medium.

We can’t wait to hear from you! 🧡

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Oda is the leading online grocery retailer in Norway, but as a company, we’re first and foremost an ambitious tech and logistics company - not a classic retailer. We’re one of the fastest-growing startups in the Nordics, working with huge, complex challenges to make the lives of our customers simpler and easier. Want to join us? Our goal is to create the world's most efficient retail system. Through smart work, passionate customer focus and our own technology we make a difference in the lives of thousands of customers and change society for the better through a completely re-imagined value chain for grocery shopping. Our customers save more than 60 hours a year, time we believe can be better spent than going to the store. Our effective value chain and logistics save society tonnes of food waste each year and our distribution network replace almost 13,000 individual trips by car to the grocery store each year.

jobs.title: Kafémedarbeider - deltid
jobs.description:
Vi søker fire kafémedarbeidere til mindre deltidsstillinger ved Skalmstadsetra på sørsiden av Hafjell. Arbeidet vil hovedsakelig foregå på lørdager januar til april 2027, samt enkelte dager i vinterferien og påsken.

Hva vi ser etter

Vi ser først og fremst etter deg som er pålitelig, selvstendig, serviceinnstilt og ryddig, og som klarer å beholde oversikten når flere ting skjer samtidig. Du må være komfortabel med å ta initiativ, følge med på det som skjer rundt deg og vurdere hva som bør prioriteres.

Erfaring fra kafé, restaurant eller butikk er selvfølgelig positivt, men ikke nødvendigvis avgjørende. Det viktigste for oss er at du er lærevillig, tar ansvar og bidrar der det trengs. Du får god opplæring og tydelige rutiner før du skal stå på egne ben.

Vi søker primært medarbeidere over 20 år, blant annet fordi arbeidet innebærer servering av alkohol. Det er likevel mulig for yngre å søke, og vi vurderer søkere ut fra egnethet og hvilke arbeidsoppgaver de kan utføre.

Arbeidet innebærer mye kontakt med gjester, og du må kunne kommunisere godt med gjestene på norsk, et annet skandinavisk språk, eller engelsk.

Arbeidsstedet har begrenset kollektivtilbud, så du må på forhånd ha avklart hvordan du kommer deg til og fra jobb.

Arbeidsoppgaver

Arbeidet vil hovedsakelig være på dagtid, og dere vil alltid være to medarbeidere på jobb. Oppgavene består av kundeservice, servering, drikke/bar, rydding og oppvask samt enkel klargjøring og servering av mat og kaker. Mye bestilling og betaling skjer ved disken, men vi ønsker at medarbeiderne ser hva som er naturlig i den enkelte situasjonen. Vi jobber fleksibelt mellom oppgavene og forventer at begge bidrar der det til enhver tid er behov. Noen ganger betyr det å ta imot bestilling ved disken, andre ganger å gå bort til et bord, servere, rydde eller følge opp gjestene der. God service hos oss handler derfor mye om å være oppmerksom, ta initiativ og samarbeide godt med den man er på jobb sammen med. Kaféen er liten og oversiktelig og du må trives med å ta ansvar for flere deler av kafédriften i løpet av en vakt.

Matservering vil være enkel og godt tilrettelagt på forhånd. Det kan være oppvarming og enkel ferdigstilling av mat og anretning av kaker. Det forventes ikke at medarbeiderne skal lage mat fra bunnen av samtidig som de betjener kaféen.

Vi tilbyr

Arbeidstid og omfang

Det faste behovet er primært lørdager i januar og mars, med utgangspunkt i omtrent annehver lørdag per medarbeider. I tillegg trenger vi bemanning enkelte dager i vinterferien (uke 8) og påskeperioden (uke 12)

Kaféens åpningstid er normalt kl. 13-18, med arbeidstid noe før åpning og etter stenging. Vi forsøker å tilpasse vaktene etter tilgjengelighet, og det er derfor mulig å søke både dersom du ønsker omtrent det beskrevene omfanget, eller om du ønsker å jobbe noe mer eller mindre. Det kan også bli mulighet for ekstravakter ved arrangementer og andre behov gjennom året. Vi håper gjerne å finne medarbeidere vi kan spørre igjen ved senere behov, men kan per i dag ikke love et fast omfang utover periodene som er beskrevet over.

Hva vi tilbyr vi?

Stillingen passer godt for deg som ønsker en mindre deltidsjobb ved siden av annen jobb, studier eller andre forpliktelser.

Vi tilbyr et hyggelig og uformelt kafémiljø, med varierte arbeidsoppgaver og tett samarbeid med en kollega.

Du får god opplæring, tydelige arbeidsrutiner og mulighet til å jobbe selvstendig innenfor trygge rammer.

Lønn etter gjeldende satser for serveringsbransjen.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Skalmstadsetra ligger på sørsiden av Hafjell, et lite tun med gamle bygninger og mange faste hyttegjester i nærområdet. Vi ønsker å skape en hyggelig og uformell kafé der både hyttefolk, fastboende og andre besøkende kan stikke innom.

jobs.title: Service Instructor
jobs.description:
**Join us as a Service Instructor in hotel cleaning services in Turku!**

Are you an experienced cleaning services professional interested in a guiding role where you can support the team in their daily work and help ensure high-quality service? With us, work is carried out responsibly as part of a reliable team.

You will work as a Service Instructor under the supervision of your manager and have a key role in ensuring the smooth operation and quality of cleaning services at the customer site. You work responsibly and ensure that all tasks are carried out safely and in accordance with our shared quality standards and operating procedures. You act as a key link between employees, management and the customer, supporting your manager, but the role does not include actual managerial responsibility.

Customer service plays a central role in this position, and succeeding in the role requires a customer-oriented mindset and good interpersonal skills. In your role, you have a direct impact on the customer experience and the smooth running of the customer relationship. Active cooperation, clear communication and a solution-oriented approach are therefore essential.

**Your duties include, among other things:**

- ensuring the smooth running and quality of daily cleaning work, planning the division of tasks and using resources in a cost-conscious manner

- continuously developing operations together with your manager and actively contributing ideas for improvement

- guiding and onboarding employees and ensuring safe working practices

- customer cooperation

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager
Servicechef för löne- och ekonomitjänster, Jakobstad
jobs.description:
Servicechef för löne- och ekonomitjänster
Leder du människor på ett inspirerande sätt och får vardagen att fungera?

Har du god kännedom om löne- och ekonomiförvaltningens processer och brinner du för ledarskap, verksamhetsutveckling och att lyckas tillsammans? Vi söker en servicechef till våra löne- och ekonomitjänster i Jakobstad, en person som håller i alla trådar men som aldrig glömmer människorna i andra änden av dem.
Som servicechef får du bygga en smidig vardag tillsammans med ett kunnigt team. Rollen passar dig som vill kombinera expertis inom löne- och ekonomiförvaltning med ledarskap och praktiskt utvecklingsarbete.
Vad kommer du att arbeta med?
Du ansvarar för teamets personal, serviceproduktion och kvalitet. Du organiserar verksamheten, håller helheten under kontroll och säkerställer att teamet har de bästa förutsättningarna att lyckas.
I rollen kommer du att:
- fungera som chef för serviceteamet
- ansvara för organisering och kvalitet i teamets verksamhet
- säkerställa att serviceproduktionen fungerar smidigt
- stöda, uppmuntra och coacha dina medarbetare
- aktivt utveckla arbetssätt och processer
- delta i utvecklingsprojekt
- stöda teamet i förändringssituationer
- samarbeta nära med kunder, andra servicechefer och intressenter
- delta i den utvidgade ledningsgruppens verksamhet

I den här uppgiften får du både ansvar samt möjlighet att påverka. Samtidigt står du aldrig ensam, utan har stöd av din egen chef, andra servicechefer och kompetenta kollegor.
Är du vår nya kollega?
Du har erfarenhet av löne- och ekonomiförvaltning och förstår helhetsprocesserna inom båda områdena. Du kan organisera både ditt eget och teamets arbete, tar initiativ och driver saker framåt på ett målmedvetet sätt.
Vi hoppas att du har:
- erfarenhet av och god förståelse för löne- och ekonomiförvaltningens processer
- lämplig högskoleutbildning eller motsvarande kompetens som du förvärvat genom arbetserfarenhet
- intresse för chefsarbete och ledarskap
- god samarbets- och kommunikationsförmåga
- ett aktivt och ansvarsfullt arbetssätt
- förmåga att organisera och hantera helhet
- vilja att stöda, uppmuntra och hjälpa andra att lyckas
- engagemang för att utveckla verksamheten tillsammans med teamet
- förmåga att kommunicera på både svenska och finska


Vi uppskattar ett ledarskap som präglas av tydlighet, förtroende och ett genuint intresse för människor. Du behöver inte kunna allt från början. Det viktigaste är viljan att lära sig, utvecklas och bygga en välfungerande vardag tillsammans med andra.
Varför ska du välja oss?
Vi erbjuder dig en ansvarsfull och mångsidig roll där du får möjlighet att påverka utvecklingen av våra löne- och ekonomitjänster och teamets vardag.
Hos oss får du:
- ett meningsfullt arbete till förmån för organisationer inom den offentliga sektorn
- möjlighet att påverka och utveckla verksamheten
- stöd för din professionella utveckling
- flexibel och förkortad arbetstid, 7 timmar och 15 minuter per dag
- möjlighet till hybridarbete efter introduktionsperioden
- stöd från din chef och kunniga kollegor
- regelbundna one-to-one-samtal
- personalförmåner som stödjer en aktiv livsstil
- gemensamma aktiviteter och trevliga stunder med kollegor
- en trivsam och samarbetsinriktad arbetsmiljö.

Var med och skapa en smidigare vardag tillsammans med oss
Hos oss arbetar du med viktiga tjänster tillsammans med engagerade och kompetenta yrkesmänniskor. Vi tror att ett gott ledarskap syns i en välfungerande vardag, öppet samarbete och människors möjligheter att lyckas i sitt arbete.
Låter det här som ditt nästa steg?
Skicka in din ansökan och berätta vilken kompetens, vilka idéer och vilket ledarskap du vill bidra med till våra löne- och ekonomitjänster. Vi behandlar ansökningarna redan under ansökningstiden, så vänta inte för länge. Ansök senast den 8 november 2026.
För mer information om tjänsten kontakta Camilla Pääkkölä, servicedirektör för löne- och ekonomitjänster, tfn 040 354 4177.
Kom med och led, utveckla och skapa en smidigare arbetsvardag tillsammans med oss!

jobs.title: Palvelupäällikkö palkka- ja talouspalveluihin, Pietarsaari
jobs.description:
Palvelupäällikkö palkka- ja talouspalveluihin
Johdatko ihmisiä kannustavasti ja saatko arjen rullaamaan?

Tunnetko palkka- ja taloushallinnon prosessit ja innostutko ihmisten johtamisesta, toiminnan kehittämisestä sekä yhdessä onnistumisesta? Etsimme Pietarsaaren palkka- ja talouspalveluihin palvelupäällikköä, joka pitää langat käsissään, mutta ei unohda niiden toisessa päässä olevia ihmisiä.
Palvelupäällikkönä pääset rakentamaan sujuvaa työarkea osaavan tiimin kanssa. Tehtävä sopii sinulle, joka haluat yhdistää palkka- ja taloushallinnon asiantuntemuksen, esihenkilötyön ja käytännönläheisen kehittämisen.
Mitä työpöydällesi kuuluu?
Vastaat tiimisi henkilöstöstä, palvelutuotannosta ja toiminnan laadusta. Organisoit arkea, pidät kokonaisuuden hallinnassa ja varmistat, että tiimilläsi on hyvät edellytykset onnistua työssään.
Tehtävässäsi:
- toimit palvelutiimin esihenkilönä
- vastaat tiimin toiminnan organisoinnista ja laadusta
- huolehdit palvelutuotannon toimivuudesta ja sujuvuudesta
- tuet, kannustat ja valmennat tiimiläisiäsi
- kehität aktiivisesti toimintatapoja ja prosesseja
- osallistut kehitysprojekteihin
- tuet tiimiä muutoksissa
- teet tiivistä yhteistyötä asiakkaiden, muiden palvelupäälliköiden ja sidosryhmien kanssa
- osallistut laajennetun johtoryhmän toimintaan

Saat tehtävässä sekä vastuuta että mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa. Kaikkea ei kuitenkaan tarvitse tehdä yksin, sillä tukenasi ovat oma esihenkilösi, muut palvelupäälliköt ja osaavat kollegat.
Olisitko juuri sinä uusi työkaverimme?
Sinulla on kokemusta palkka- ja taloushallinnosta ja ymmärrät molempien prosessit kokonaisuutena. Osaat organisoida omaa ja tiimin työtä, tarttua asioihin sekä viedä niitä määrätietoisesti eteenpäin.
Toivomme sinulta:
- kokemusta ja vahvaa ymmärrystä palkka- ja taloushallinnon prosesseista
- soveltuvaa korkeakoulututkintoa tai vastaavaa työkokemuksen kautta hankittua osaamista
- kiinnostusta esihenkilötyöhön ja ihmisten johtamiseen
- hyviä vuorovaikutus- ja yhteistyötaitoja
- aktiivista ja vastuullista työotetta
- kykyä organisoida ja hallita kokonaisuuksia
- halua tukea, kannustaa ja auttaa muita onnistumaan
- intoa kehittää toimintaa yhdessä tiimin kanssa
- kykyä kommunikoida sekä suomeksi että ruotsiksi

Arvostamme johtamisotetta, jossa yhdistyvät selkeys, luottamus ja aito kiinnostus ihmisiin. Sinun ei tarvitse olla kaikessa valmis. Tärkeintä on halu oppia, kehittyä ja rakentaa toimivaa arkea yhdessä muiden kanssa.
Miksi meille kannattaa tulla?
Tarjoamme sinulle vastuullisen ja monipuolisen tehtävän, jossa pääset vaikuttamaan palkka- ja talous palveluiden toimintaan ja tiimisi työarkeen.
Meillä saat:
- merkityksellisen työn julkisen sektorin organisaatioiden hyväksi
- mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa ja kehittää toimintaa
- tuen ammatilliseen kehittymiseen
- joustavan ja lyhyen työajan, 7 tuntia 15 minuuttia päivässä
- mahdollisuuden hybridityöhön perehdytyksen jälkeen
- oman esihenkilön ja osaavien kollegoiden tuen
- säännölliset one-to-one keskustelut
- aktiivista elämäntapaa tukevia henkilöstöetuja
- yhteisiä tapahtumia ja mukavia hetkiä työkavereiden kanssa
- mukavan ja yhteistyöhön kannustavan työympäristön

Tule rakentamaan kanssamme sujuvampaa arkea
Meillä työskentelet tärkeiden palveluiden parissa yhdessä osaavien ammattilaisten kanssa. Uskomme siihen, että hyvä johtaminen näkyy arjen sujuvuutena, avoimena yhteistyönä ja ihmisten mahdollisuutena onnistua työssään.
Kuulostaako tämä sinun seuraavalta askeleeltasi?
Lähetä hakemuksesi ja kerro meille, millaista osaamista, näkemystä ja johtamisotetta sinä toisit palkka- ja talouspalveluidemme arkeen. Käsittelemme hakemuksia jo hakuaikana, joten kannattaa toimia pian, viimeistään 8.11.2026. Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa palkka- ja talouspalveluiden palvelujohtaja Camilla Pääkkölä 040 354 4177.
Tule mukaan johtamaan, kehittämään ja tekemään työarjesta sujuvampaa yhdessä kanssamme!

jobs.title: Director of IT and Workplace
jobs.description:
The Role

We've grown to roughly 265 people working onsite from our Menlo Park headquarters, supported by a large network of remote U.S.-licensed clinicians â and part of the Series C is earmarked for acquisitions. The systems and the spaces holding all of that together were built for a much smaller company. We're hiring a Director of IT & Workplace to own them properly.

You'll own two halves of the same problem: the employee technology platform â identity, endpoints, networking, the SaaS portfolio, and our IT security posture â and the physical environment the company runs on, from space planning and physical security to the AV that customer demos and all-hands depend on. You'll inherit a small, capable team and be accountable for leveling it up. You'll be the named owner for IT controls in our HIPAA and SOC 2 programs, you'll own the IT and workplace budget, and when we acquire a company, you'll be the one integrating it.

Our Environment

  • Identity and access: Okta for SSO, MFA, and lifecycle provisioning.

  • Productivity: Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace, both in active use across the company.

  • Endpoints: a Mac-primary fleet with Windows machines alongside it, managed through MDM. VDIs included.

  • Internal systems: IRU, plus a growing portfolio of internal and third-party SaaS applications.

  • Workplace: a Palo Alto headquarters with conference room AV and access control, plus a distributed clinician and staff population.

What You'll Do

Strategy, budget, and team

  • Own a multi-year IT and workplace roadmap tied to the hiring plan, and bring it to leadership with clear tradeoffs and funding asks.

  • Own the IT and workplace operating and capital budget: forecast it, defend it in planning cycles, and continuously rationalize license, vendor, and facilities spend.

  • Lead, coach, and grow the existing team â set clear expectations, run honest performance conversations, hire as scope deepens, and build career paths that keep strong people.

  • Define and publish service levels for ticket response, uptime, onboarding readiness, and workplace turnaround, and report against them to the executive team.

Technology and infrastructure

  • Own the identity platform: SSO, MFA, automated joiner-mover-leaver provisioning in Okta, and access governance across every connected application.

  • Own the endpoint fleet and the SaaS portfolio â Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, IRU, and a long tail of business applications â with enforced MDM baselines for encryption, patching, and configuration.

  • Own network and connectivity for the headquarters and the remote workforce, with redundancy appropriate to a company our customers depend on.

  • Replace manual provisioning, access reviews, and device setup with scripted, auditable workflows.

  • Lead major programs end to end: platform migrations, upgrades, office buildouts, and the IT and workplace integration of acquired companies.

Security, compliance, and risk

  • Serve as the accountable owner for IT controls in our HIPAA, SOC 2, and customer security review programs, including evidence collection and audit response.

  • Enforce least privilege across the environment and run recurring access certifications with documented outcomes.

jobs.title: Lähihoitaja vakituiseen työsuhteeseen Keisarinkotoon!
jobs.description:
Hei sinä lähihoitaja – me etsimme ehkäpä juuri sinua!

**Keisarinkodossa Piikkiössä olisi paikka yhdelle hyvälle tyypille. Voisitko se olla sinä?**

Jos olet lähihoitaja, joka tykkää ihmisistä, vaihtelevista päivistä ja siitä, että töihin on kiva tulla, **jatka lukemista!** Meillä Keisarinkodossa tehdään tärkeää työtä, mutta otsa kurtussa ei tarvitse olla. Arjessa on tilaa **hymyille, huumorille, hyvälle kahville ja onnistumisille** – unohtamatta tietenkään laadukasta ja turvallista hoitotyötä.

Mitä meillä pääset tekemään? Olemaan läsnä, auttamaan, kohtaamaan, kuuntelemaan ja toteuttamaan hyvää arkea yhdessä asukkaidemme kanssa. Työpäivät eivät ole samanlaisia, ja juuri se tekee tästä työstä mielenkiintoista. Joskus tarvitaan ripeyttä, joskus rauhallista kuuntelijaa ja välillä ripaus huumoria. Kaikkea ei tarvitse osata heti – **me opetellaan ja autetaan toinen toisiamme.**

Mitä me toivomme sinulta?

- Olet koulutukseltasi lähihoitaja.

- Olet luotettava ja vastuuntuntoinen.

- Kohtaat ihmiset aidosti ja arvostavasti.

- Osaat tehdä töitä sekä itsenäisesti että yhdessä muiden kanssa.

- Sinulla on positiivinen asenne ja mielellään myös **pilkettä silmäkulmassa.**


Ikääntyneiden parissa työskentelyn kokemus on plussaa, mutta **hyvä tyyppi ja oikea asenne painavat vaakakupissa paljon.**

Miksi juuri meille? Koska meillä **työkaveria ei jätetä yksin**. Meillä saa kysyä, oppia, nauraa ja välillä todeta yhdessä, että _"selvittiinpäs tästäkin!"_

Haluamme rakentaa työyhteisöä, jossa jokainen voi tulla töihin omana itsenään ja jossa hyvä työ näkyy sekä asukkaiden arjessa että työkavereiden fiiliksessä.

Joko nappasit ajatuksesta kiinni? Jos mietit, että **"tuonne voisin kyllä tulla töihin"**, niin laita hakemus tulemaan! Me odotamme innolla, että pääsemme tutustumaan sinuun.

**Tervetuloa Keisarinkotoon – meillä voisi olla sinulle paikka!**

**Lähetä hakemuksesi aivan heti:** sofia.heinonen@kototiimi.fi

_P.S. Jos olet sellainen hoitaja, joka ajattelee, että työssä saa olla myös iloa, huumoria ja sydäntä – saatamme hyvinkin etsiä juuri sinua._

Lue meistä lisää www.kototiimi.fi

jobs.title: Sairaanhoitaja uuteen Keisarinnaan!
jobs.description:
**Sairaanhoitaja, haluatko olla mukana rakentamassa parasta työporukkaa ikinä?**

**Nyt on mahdollisuus päästä mukaan heti alusta asti.**

Keisarinnan uusi palvelukoti on avannut ovensa lokakuun alussa, ja etsimme joukkoomme vielä yhtä **sairaanhoitajaa**, joka haluaa tehdä merkityksellistä työtä, mutta myös vaikuttaa siihen, millainen työpaikka ja arki meillä rakentuu.

Keisarinnassa tuotetaan **yhteisöllistä asumispalvelua ja ympärivuorokautista palveluasumista ikäihmisille**. Me emme halua vain avata uutta yksikköä – haluamme rakentaa paikan, jossa on hyvä asua, hyvä tehdä töitä ja hyvä tulla kohdatuksi.

**Miksi juuri Keisarinna?**

Koska tässä työssä et astu valmiiseen muottiin.

Uuden yksikön käynnistyessä pääset oikeasti vaikuttamaan siihen, **miten meillä tehdään asioita**. Saat tuoda pöytään omat ideasi, osaamisesi ja persoonasi.

Me haluamme rakentaa työyhteisön, jossa ei tarvitse miettiä:

_"Näin tämä on aina tehty."_

Vaan kysytään:

**"Voisiko tämän tehdä vielä paremmin?"**

Sairaanhoitajana olet tärkeässä roolissa sekä asukkaiden kokonaisvaltaisen hoidon että turvallisen arjen rakentamisessa. Päivissä on vaihtelua, vastuuta, kohtaamisia ja ennen kaikkea mahdollisuuksia tehdä työ omalla ammattitaidollasi näkyväksi.

**Tässä työssä pääset**

- olemaan mukana käynnistämässä täysin uutta palvelukotia

- rakentamaan kanssamme hyvää työyhteisöä alusta asti

- hyödyntämään ja kehittämään omaa sairaanhoitajan osaamistasi

- kohtaamaan ikäihmiset yksilöinä – ei vain asiakkaina

- vaikuttamaan arjen toimintatapoihin ja niiden kehittämiseen

- tekemään työtä, jolla on oikeasti merkitystä.


**Meille hyvä hoitotyö on muutakin kuin suorittamista**

Keisarinnassa asukkaiden elämä ei pysähdy siihen, että he muuttavat palvelukotiin.

Haluamme mahdollistaa **oman näköistä elämää, turvallisuutta, yhteisöllisyyttä ja hyviä hetkiä**. Siksi tarvitsemme hoitajia, joille ihminen tulee ennen rutiinia.

Sinun ei tarvitse olla valmis paketti.

**Riittää, että olet ammattitaitoinen, utelias, vastuullinen ja valmis tekemään yhdessä.**

Arvostamme myös huumoria, hyvää energiaa ja sitä, että uskallat sanoa ääneen omat ajatuksesi.

**Tule tekemään tästä meidän näköisemme Keisarinna.**

Jos kaipaat työltäsi enemmän kuin valmista työvuorolistaa ja tuttua kaavaa, **Keisarinna saattaa olla juuri sinua varten.**

Täällä pääset näkemään oman kädenjälkesi.

**Uusi paikka. Uusi tiimi. Uudet mahdollisuudet.**

Ja ehkä juuri sinä olet yksi niistä ihmisistä, joiden ansiosta Keisarinnasta tulee paikka, jonne on maanantainakin kiva tulla töihin.

**Kiinnostuitko?**

Jos olet **sairaanhoitaja** ja haluat olla mukana rakentamassa uutta palvelukotia alusta asti, **lähetä meille hakemuksesi!**

Kerro meille lyhyesti, kuka olet, mitä osaat ja ennen kaikkea: **Mitä sinä haluaisit tuoda Keisarinnaan?**

**Tule mukaan rakentamaan Keisarinnaa. Meillä on paikka sinulle.**

jobs.title: Gérant(e)-Gestionnaire du Camping Bon Accueil à Alzingen (m/f)
jobs.employer: Syndicat d'Initiative et de Tourisme de la commune de Hesperange A.S.B.L.
jobs.description:
Description des tâches:

Le Syndicat d'Initiative et de Tourisme de la Commune de Hesperange, ASBL recrute:

Gérant(e)-Gestionnaire du Camping Bon Accueil à Alzingen

Dans le cadre de la gestion et du développement du Camping Bon Accueil à Alzingen, le Syndicat d'Initiative et de Tourisme de la Commune de Hesperange, ASBL recherche, pour entrée immédiate, un(e) Gérant(e)-Gestionnaire à temps plein.
En tant que responsable du Camping, vous assurez la gestion opérationnelle, administrative et organisationnelle de l'établissement. Vous bénéficiez d'une autonomie dans l'exercice de vos fonctions et travaillez en étroite collaboration avec le Conseil du Syndicat, auquel vous rapportez directement.
Vous aurez également la responsabilité de coordonner et d'encadrer une équipe multidisciplinaire active dans les domaines de l'accueil, du tourisme, de la restauration et de l'entretien.

Vos missions

Gestion et organisation du Camping

• Assurer la gestion opérationnelle et l'organisation quotidienne du Camping;
• Planifier, coordonner et superviser le travail des différents collaborateurs;
• Établir les plannings et assurer une répartition efficace des tâches et des responsabilités;
• Veiller à la qualité de l'accueil et des services proposés aux clients;
• Assurer la gestion des réservations, de l'accueil téléphonique et physique ainsi que de la boîte e-mail;
• Assurer la facturation, le suivi administratif, la gestion des fournisseurs, l'établissement des statistiques et des rapports d'activité;
• Veiller au respect des procédures internes et proposer, lorsque nécessaire, des améliorations.

Management et gestion d'équipe

• Encadrer, motiver et coordonner une équipe multidisciplinaire;
• Assurer une bonne communication au sein de l'équipe et favoriser un environnement de travail collaboratif;
• Organiser et superviser les activités des collaborateurs en fonction des besoins opérationnels;
• Participer au recrutement, à l'intégration et à l'accompagnement des collaborateurs, en collaboration avec le Conseil du Syndicat;
• Veiller au respect des règles de sécurité, d'hygiène et d'organisation du travail.

Infrastructures et qualité

• Assurer le contrôle régulier de l'état et du bon fonctionnement des infrastructures et équipements du Camping;
• Coordonner les travaux d'entretien et de maintenance et assurer le suivi avec les prestataires externes;
• Identifier les besoins d'amélioration et proposer des solutions au Conseil du Syndicat;
• Participer à la planification et assurer le suivi des projets de renouvellement, de modernisation et de développement du Camping.

Tourisme, communication et développement

• Contribuer activement à la promotion du Camping Bon Accueil et des activités touristiques de la Commune de Hesperange;
• Participer à la valorisation de l'image et de l'attractivité du Camping;
• Entretenir des relations professionnelles avec les clients, partenaires, fournisseurs et acteurs locaux du secteur touristique.

Votre profil

Vous êtes une personne autonome, dynamique et orientée vers le service, capable de prendre des responsabilités et de gérer des situations variées dans un environnement touristique et opérationnel.

Vous disposez idéalement de:

• Une expérience professionnelle confirmée dans un poste de gestion, de coordination ou de responsabilité, dans le secteur touristique, hôtelier, de la restauration ou dans tout autre environnement impliquant un contact régulier avec la clientèle;
• Une première expérience réussie dans la gestion et l'encadrement d'une équipe;
• Une bonne capacité d'organisation et de planification;
• Un excellent sens du service et de la relation client;
• Une bonne capacité à prendre des décisions, à gérer les priorités et à résoudre les problèmes de manière autonome;
• Un esprit d'initiative et une volonté constante d'améliorer les processus et la qualité des services;
• Une bonne maîtrise du français, de l'allemand et de l'anglais. La connaissance du luxembourgeois constitue un avantage;
• Une bonne maîtrise des outils MS Office (Word, Excel, Outlook);
• La connaissance du logiciel Tommy Booking constitue un avantage;
• Une personnalité enthousiaste, sociable, conviviale et orientée vers les solutions;
• De la polyvalence, de la flexibilité et de la rigueur dans l'exécution des différentes tâches en lien avec votre fonction;
• Une bonne résistance au stress et la capacité à rester efficace dans des périodes de forte activité.

Ce que nous vous offrons

• Un poste à responsabilités avec une réelle autonomie dans la gestion opérationnelle du Camping;
• Une fonction variée et évolutive au sein d'un environnement touristique dynamique;
• La possibilité de diriger et de développer une équipe multidisciplinaire;
• Une collaboration directe avec le Conseil du Syndicat d'Initiative et de Tourisme de la Commune de Hesperange;
• La possibilité de contribuer activement au développement et à la modernisation du Camping Bon Accueil;
• Une rémunération attractive, en adéquation avec votre expérience, vos compétences et vos responsabilités;

Conditions de travail

• Contrat à durée indéterminée;
• Temps plein;
• Travail selon un planning établi en fonction des besoins du Camping, avec disponibilité du lundi au dimanche, y compris pendant les vacances scolaires et les périodes de forte activité;
• Prise de fonction: immédiate ou à convenir.

Comment postuler?

Les personnes intéressées sont invitées à envoyer leur dossier de candidature comprenant:

• un curriculum vitae détaillé avec photo récente;
• une lettre de motivation;
• une copie de la carte d'identité;
• un extrait du casier judiciaire.

Les candidatures sont à envoyer jusqu'au 02/11/2026:
Par courriel: gestion@camping-alzingen.lu
ou
Par voie postale:
Syndicat d'Initiative et de Tourisme de la Commune de Hesperange, ASBL
2, rue du Camping
L-5815 Alzingen

Les candidatures seront traitées avec confidentialité. Les candidat(e)s retenu(e)s seront contacté(e)s par les responsables du Syndicat d'Initiative et de Tourisme de la Commune de Hesperange, ASBL.
Pour toute question concernant le poste, n'hésitez pas à nous contacter par courriel.

Études:  Bachelor (Bac +3)

Métier / domaine de formation:  Gestion d'entreprise; Ressources humaines;

Autres compétences:  utilisation des outils informatiques conventionnels; fonctionnement d'un camping; gestion d'infrastructures

jobs.title: Senior in Accounting and Reporting (m/f)
jobs.description:
Senior in Accounting and Reporting

Who are we?

BDO is present in over 169 countries, and we offer an extensive range of services in the areas of Audit, Tax, Advisory, Accounting, Business Services and Outsourcing. At BDO Luxembourg, our mission is to provide our clients with our expertise of our global network tailored to the unique needs of the Luxembourgish market, delivering personalized service and building valued relationships. With over 650 people representing more than 42 nationalities, we embrace diversity and encourage skill development and ownership among our team members. Our core values, honesty, integrity, quality, respect, and responsibility define our culture. Hence, our People can expect to grow in a stimulating work environment that nurtures professional development and fosters inclusivity.

What will you do?

Being part of the team, you will:

• Meet the needs of our clients (regulated entities and management companies) with regards to accounting, tax and administrative processes, in particular by keeping day-to-day accounts, preparing tax returns and annual accounts/reports;
• Supervise the accounting performed by junior team members;
• Review and finalise the preparation of annual tax returns, linked to their respective accounts;
• Be in regular and proactive contact with your clients and be committed to building long-lasting and trusting relationships with them. Your ability to anticipate and respond to their needs makes you their preferred contact;
• Be involved in improving internal and digital processes;
• Participate in the acquisition of new clients using your knowledge of your clients, the latest trends, the market and your network;
• Perform financial analysis, prepare periodic reports and provide insights into financial performance while ensuring the accuracy and compliance of accounting information;
• Train, motivate and develop your team, because your own success is measured by that of your team.

This position is for you if:

• You possess at least 3 years of professional experience managing a portfolio of local clients within a fiduciary or Big-4 firm in Luxembourg;
• Your leadership and technical expertise are recognized by your team;
• You are highly organized, detail-oriented and able to coordinate several tasks at the same time to meet deadlines;
• You have an independent, conscientious and goal-oriented mindset;
• You are fluent in French and possess a good English level, knowledge of Luxembourgish or German can be an asset.
• Minimum required education: Master (Bac+5)

What´s in it for you:  

• Competitive remuneration package including
- a 13th month (representing a mobility budget offering a car leasing opportunity),
- a discretionary performance bonus
• Pension plan
• Lunch vouchers
• Extra days of annual leave
• Flexible working hours and homeworking options
• Parking spots available for a fee within our building
• Possibility to charge electric vehicles in our parking
• On-site employee restaurant with preferential prices
• Free access to our fitness room
• Sports sessions for small additional charge
• Internal sports groups (e.g. running, cycling and football)
• Career development opportunities through a wide range of trainings (e.g. technical and soft skills, language courses)

Our main office is ideally located in the modern and rapidly expanding Cloche d'Or area. This dynamic area offers easy access to public transport, stores and park-and-ride facilities.

Are you willing to grow your career in a multicultural, pleasant and dynamic environment? Then, take your chance!

In accordance with the provisions of the Luxembourg law of 23 July 2016 amending the law of 29 March 2013, candidates may be required to provide an extract from their criminal record. This document, issued by the authorities, must not be older than three months. Such a document will be requested with the aim of carrying out a character check on candidates, bearing in mind the area of activity of our establishment and, more particularly, the tasks described in the job description.

jobs.title: International Tax Senior Advisor (m/f)
jobs.description:
International Tax Senior Advisor
Locations Luxembourg
time type Full time
job requisition id JR100208

Operating as an internationally integrated partnership in over 100 countries and territories, Forvis Mazars Group specialises in audit, tax and advisory services. The partnership draws on the expertise and cultural understanding of over 40,000 professionals across the globe to assist clients of all sizes at every stage in their development.

Joining our team as a Senior Tax Advisor means taking on a pivotal role within a dynamic and fast-paced advisory environment, where technical excellence and high-quality client service are at the core of everything we do.
You will operate in a stimulating and demanding consulting environment where excellence, ownership and continuous development are expected.

You will lead complex assignments aligned with our clients' strategic priorities, bringing technical expertise and a pragmatic approach to problem-solving. As a key point of contact for both clients and junior team members, you will contribute to high-quality deliverables while ensuring deadlines and expectations are consistently met.

You will play an active role in client interactions, developing strong relationships, understanding their challenges and providing tailored, value-added advice. Beyond client work, you will play an important role in the development of our team. You will coach and mentor junior team members, review their work and contribute to fostering a collaborative and high-performing culture. Your experience and leadership will help shape both individual careers and the continued growth of our practice.

In return, we offer a stimulating and intellectually challenging environment that encourages initiative and provides genuine opportunities for career progression. Through ongoing training, exposure to complex international projects and increasing leadership responsibilities, you will be empowered to continuously develop your expertise and advance your professional ambitions.

Responsibilities:

As part of our International Tax team, you will take on a central role in delivering high-quality advisory services within a dynamic and client-driven environment.

Your role will include:

• Advising clients on complex International and Luxembourg tax matters, ensuring technical accuracy and relevance in a constantly evolving regulatory landscape;
• Leading and reviewing in-depth tax analysis, and translating technical findings into clear, strategic and actionable recommendations;
• Managing client engagements, including planning, execution and timely delivery of high-quality outputs;
• Acting as a potential point of contact for clients, starting building trusted relationships with the aim of ensuring  full client satisfaction;
• Supervising, mentoring and reviewing the work of junior team members, fostering their development and ensuring quality standards;
• Contributing indirectly to business development initiatives, including proposals and pitches with the support of a highly experienced advisory team ;
• Collaborating closely with  your management team and actively contributing to the growth and positioning of your service line.
You will be expected to demonstrate high dedication to work, a high level of rigor in all aspects of your work and substantial capacity to share your knowledge with your team members.

Your Profile:

• Master's degree in Economics, Finance, Accounting or Law (with a specialization in Tax Law);
• 2-4 years of relevant experience in International Tax, preferably within a consulting or professional services firm;
• Strong technical expertise in International and Luxembourg tax frameworks;
• Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to structure and simplify complex matters;
• Proven ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver under pressure;
• Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with first experiences in client interactions;
• Demonstrated ability to supervise and coach junior team members;
• Proactive, results-driven and committed to continuous learning and professional growth;
• Fluent in French and English (written and spoken).

What We Offer

• A high-impact role with increased autonomy, responsibility and potential client exposure depending on your skills and behavior;
• A key learning process over the long term in business developments initiatives;
• The opportunity to work on complex, technical and strategic assignments;
• A clear career path with leadership development opportunities;
• Continuous learning tailored to your level of experience and ambitions;
• A human-sized international group combining proximity, entrepreneurial spirit and global reach;
• A dynamic, collaborative and high-performing environment where excellence and teamwork go hand in hand.

Forvis Mazars is an equal opportunities employer and is committed to building a diverse and inclusive culture in which each individual feels welcomed.

We consider candidates based on their skills, abilities or experiences as we believe everyone brings their own talents with them.
The diversity of our talents is what makes our work environment multicultural, innovative and enriching.

jobs.title: Risk Analytics Lead (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Risk Analytics Lead (m/f/d)
Job ID: REF3057H
Company: Riverty GmbH
Location: Luxembourg
Daria Manoilenko
Recruiting

I look forward to receiving your application

Everyone's story matters. Come shape your story with us at Riverty.

But where does that take you?

To one of our 30 hybrid workspaces – designed for exchanging ideas, learning from others, and shaping the way we work. An international community of over 4,000 people, representing almost 80 nationalities across 11 countries. United by one mission: Combining empathy, advanced technology and data-driven insights to keep people and businesses in flow. With payments made for them. So that they don't have to worry about it.

And there's more. We are part of the family-owned Bertelsmann group. Established. Corporate. In a fast-paced industry. We enable flexible payments in various industries, simplifying the financial management of known brands and helping people repay debt to build financial confidence. In short: shaping FinTech.

We are looking for a

Risk Analytics Lead (m/f/d)

Join our team at our location in Luxembourg - flexible working conditions available

We are looking for a Lead for a Risk Analytics team with a strong analytical and hands-on attitude that is keen to have an impact on our risk analytics and related processes by data-oriented insights in terms of external end customer's solvency / fraud indicators in a balanced risk decision environment. The focus of the team lies on helping our steering teams defining our risk strategy, its (further) development and the constant monitoring and steering according to it. In line with the company's overarching vision to become the most human-centric FinTech, the Risk Analytics team develops appropriate customer risk strategies for different markets and ecosystems. The organization is characterized by technology-based rapid learning and decision-making cycles and guided by a strong common purpose to jointly create value for all stakeholders. Strong footprint in DACH/NL & Nordics with further expansion ambition within Europe (example: France, Italy, Spain & UK).

The main responsibilities of the Risk Analytics Lead are:

• Leading a high-performing team of risk analytics experts in an international setup
• Ensuring that the team uses industry-standard analytics tools and data-driven decision-making to solve complex fraud / solvency risk related problems and support product expansion
• Driving continuous improvement of underlying data analyses, existing business processes and monitoring/reporting, while establishing best practices for ad-hoc and deep-dive analyses
• Providing risk insights for pricing requests and ensuring effective collaboration with internal stakeholders on analytical requirements
• Playing a key role in cross-functional Risk Data Science initiatives and in enabling machine learning based models and advanced analytics for risk decisioning
• Representing the Risk Analytics team in key projects with project responsibility for risk steering related analytics and implementation
You will lead the Risk Analytics team and work in close collaboration with other functions such as Risk Product, Risk Steering, Data Science, Pricing, Financial Controlling, Sales and Operations.
The function is reporting into the Risk Analytics & Steering Lead, which is reporting into the global Client Underwriting Lead. The location is flexible, preferred locations are Luxembourg, Germany (Berlin, Verl, Baden-Baden) and the Netherlands (Amsterdam, Heerenveen).

What you should bring:

• You have a proven track-record in data analytics and credit risk management, ideally within a Bank / BNPL industry / fast-growing payment industry.
• Minimum of 3 years of experience in leading (cross-border) teams in a relevant area such as credit risk analytics, ideally in an international, agile, cross-functional environment
• You have experience in successfully enabling machine learning-based models and advanced analytics for risk assessment and decisioning
• Expertise in using various programming languages (SQL and Python) to perform complex analytical tasks
• You embrace new technology and understand the potential of data and advanced analytics
• You are a strategic thinker with vision and a strong operator - you get things done
• Language: English (mandatory); German or Dutch is a plus

Equal Opportunity Employer Statement

We want to be a fair and inclusive employer. We value the diverse perspectives that a diverse workforce brings to the table. Therefore, we are actively looking for people who enrich our company through their identity, background and personal experiences, with or without a disability.

Disclosure requirements pertaining to the collection of your personal data:

jobs.title: Financial Crime Compliance Officer (m/f)
jobs.employer: Mitsubishi UFJ Investor Services & Banking (Luxembourg) S.A.
jobs.description:
Mitsubishi UFJ Investor Services and Banking (Luxembourg) S.A. (MIBL) is a Bank incorporated in Luxembourg and is fully owned by Mitsubishi UFJ Trust and Banking Corporation, member of   the    Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group, one of the largest financial groups worldwide.

MIBL provides a wide range of financial services to institutional investors including depositary, custody, fund administration, and other banking-related services.

MIBL now has an opening in its Compliance Department for a:

Financial Crime Compliance Officer                                                                                                                                                                                                         (CDI)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    (Ref: MIBLFCCO_092026)

About the Role:

The focus on documented testing, remediation tracking, and assessment of first-line controls reflects current Luxembourg monitoring roles, where the Bank specifically seek experience in second-line testing and assessment of control effectiveness.

Responsibilities:

• Execute scheduled Financial Crime Compliance monitoring reviews in accordance with the approved annual Compliance Monitoring Programme.
• Perform sample-based testing of financial crime controls, including areas such as:
 Customer Due Diligence (CDD/KYC).
 Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD).
 PEP and sanctions screening.
 ongoing monitoring.
 transaction monitoring/KYT.
 high-risk customers and relationships.
 periodic reviews.
 suspicious activity escalation and reporting processes, where applicable.
• Assess whether controls have been performed in accordance with applicable policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements.
• Document testing performed, evidence reviewed and conclusions reached in accordance with established monitoring methodology.
• Identify control weaknesses, exceptions and potential compliance deficiencies and escalate them to senior team members.
• Assist in performing root-cause analysis of identified issues.
• Support the preparation of monitoring reports, including factual findings and supporting evidence.
• Maintain monitoring files and supporting documentation to an appropriate audit and regulatory standard.
• Track agreed remediation actions and follow up with relevant stakeholders on outstanding items.
• Support the production of statistics, KPIs and KRIs.
• Assist with thematic reviews and ad-hoc monitoring exercises arising from emerging risks or regulatory developments.
• Maintain awareness of relevant Luxembourg and EU financial crime regulatory developments.
• Contribute to the continuous improvement of monitoring procedures, testing scripts, and working papers.

Qualifications:

• Bachelor's or master's degree in law, Finance, Economics, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
• Ideally 1–3 years of relevant experience within Compliance, AML/CFT, Financial Crime, Internal Control, Risk or Audit in the financial services sector. A strong graduate profile with relevant internships may also be considered depending on the organisation.
• Fluency in English.

Required Skills:

• Basic to good understanding of financial crime risks.
• Familiarity with Luxembourg AML/CFT requirements and the CSSF regulatory environment.
• Understanding of KYC/CDD/EDD and sanctions concepts.
• Strong analytical and investigative skills.
• Ability to review evidence critically rather than relying solely on process confirmation.
• Strong attention to detail and documentation standards.
• Good written communication skills.
• Ability to manage deadlines and multiple monitoring assignments.
• Professional judgement, integrity.

Salary range:

• €72,000

If you are interested in taking up this opportunity, please send your application letter with detailed curriculum vitae to:

Mitsubishi UFJ Investor Services & Banking (Luxembourg) S.A.
Attention: Human Resources Department
287, Route d'Arlon
L – 1150 Luxembourg

jobs.title: MONTER/KA III (821306) U ODJELU ELEKTRO ODRŽAVANJA
jobs.description:
Uvjeti (potrebna znanja i kvalifikacije) koje kandidati moraju zadovoljiti za navedeno radno mjesto su:

• SSS/KV – elektro smjera • 2 godine radnog iskustva • poznavanje čitanja električnih shema • vozačka dozvola B kategorije

Opis poslova radnog mjesta:

• obavlja složene poslove na održavanju elektro opreme i uređaja energetike na crpnim, precrpnim stanicama i vodospremama • obavlja popravak elemenata električnih instalacija niskog napona, sklopne tehnike, rasvjete, grijanja i snage • sudjeluje pri remontu agregata, demontaže i montaže elektro motora, mekih upuštača, frekventnih pretvarača i ispravljača • obavlja izradu električnih instalacija jake i slabe struje • izrađuje i montira sustave za kompenzaciju jalove energije na svim pogonima vodoopskrbe • održava elektroinstalacije u poslovnim prostorima • popravlja i održava vanjsku i unutarnju rasvjetu, gromobransku instalaciju, uzemljenja, izjednačavanje potencijala i kabelskog razvoda • rad u smjenama

Izabrani kandidati obavljat će poslove radnog mjesta MONTER III (821306) u Odjelu elektro održavanja, temeljem ugovora o radu na neodređeno vrijeme s probnim radom u trajanju od 6 (šest) mjeseci. Mjesto rada je u Zagrebu.

Uz predaju ponude koja sadrži kontakt podatke (broj telefona ili mobitela, e-mail adresa) kandidati trebaju obvezno priložiti dokaze o ispunjavanju uvjeta, kako slijedi:

• životopis s opisom dosadašnjeg rada • dokaz o odgovarajućem stupnju obrazovanja u skladu s uvjetima iz javnog natječaja (presliku svjedodžbe, odnosno rješenje o priznavanju inozemne stručne kvalifikacije koju je izdalo nadležno tijelo) • dokaz o radnom iskustvu (elektronički zapis/potvrda o radnom stažu Hrvatskog zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje ne stariji od 7 dana od dana prijave na natječaj) • uvjerenje da se ne vodi kazneni postupak (ne starije od 3 mjeseca od dana objave natječaja) • presliku važeće vozačke dozvole

Ponude na javni natječaj podnose se elektroničkim putem. Rok za dostavu tražene dokumentacije je 14 dana od dana objave, na adresu elektroničke pošte:

vio.karijera@zgh.hr

S naznakom „Za javni natječaj za radno mjesto MONTER III (821306) u Odjelu elektro održavanja“.

Urednom ponudom smatra se ponuda koja sadrži sve podatke i priloge navedene u javnom natječaju. Nepotpune i nepravodobno pristigle ponude neće se razmatrati.

Kandidati koji zadovoljavaju tražene uvjete iz natječaja, bit će upućeni na daljnji selekcijski postupak koji uključuje, prema potrebi, pisano testiranje (testovi općeg znanja, stručnih znanja, opće pismenosti, informatičke pismenosti i sl., psihologijsko testiranje i dr.) i/ili intervju.

Kandidati koji ostvaruju pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema posebnim propisima dužni su u prijavi na javni natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i priložiti svu propisanu dokumentaciju prema posebnom zakonu te imaju prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate pod jednakim uvjetima. Kandidati koji se pozovu na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskoga rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (Narodne novine, br. 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23), a u trenutku podnošenja prijave ispunjavaju uvjete za ostvarivanje toga prava dužni su uz prijavu na javni natječaj priložiti sve dokaze o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta iz javnog natječaja i dokaze o ispunjavanju uvjeta za ostvarivanje prava prednosti pri zapošljavanju.

Popis dokaza potrebnih za ostvarivanje prava prednosti pri zapošljavanju nalazi se na internetskoj stranici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja:

https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20ZOHBDR%202021.pdf

Kandidati koji se pozovu na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (Narodne novine, broj 84/21 i 13/26) a u trenutku podnošenja prijave ispunjavaju uvjete za ostvarivanje toga prava dužni su uz prijavu na javni natječaj priložiti i sve dokaze o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta iz javnog natječaja i dokaze o ispunjavanju uvjeta za ostvarivanje prava prednosti pri zapošljavanju. Popis dokaza potrebnih za ostvarivanje prava prednosti pri zapošljavanju nalazi se na internetskoj stranici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja:

https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf

Kandidati koji se pozovu na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 48. Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata (Narodne novine, br. 33/92, 57/92, 77/92, 27/93, 58/93, 2/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03, 148/13 i 98/19), uz prijavu na javni natječaj dužni su, uz dokaze o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta iz javnog natječaja, priložiti rješenje ili potvrdu o priznatom statusu, izjavu da do sada nisu koristili pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju po toj osnovi te dokaz iz kojeg se vidi na koji je način prestao radni odnos kod posljednjeg poslodavca (rješenje, ugovor, sporazum i sl.).

Kandidati koji se pozovu na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom (Narodne novine, br. 157/13, 152/14, 39/18 i 32/20), uz prijavu na javni natječaj dužni su, uz dokaze o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta iz javnog natječaja, priložiti i rješenje o utvrđenom invaliditetu, odnosno drugu javnu ispravu o invaliditetu na temelju koje se osoba može upisati u očevidnik zaposlenih osoba s invaliditetom te dokaz iz kojeg se vidi na koji je način prestao radni odnos kod posljednjeg poslodavca (rješenje, ugovor, sporazum i sl.).

https://mrosp.gov.hr/pristup-informacijama-16/najcesca-pitanja-i-odgovori/najcesca-pitanja-i-odgovori-12153/rad-i-zaposljavanje/zakon-o-profesionalnoj-rehabilitaciji-i-zaposljavanju-osoba-s-invaliditetom/5946

Vodoopskrba i odvodnja d.o.o. zadržava pravo poništenja natječaja, u cijelosti i/ili u dijelu te ne prihvatiti ni jednu dostavljenu ponudu.

- Collaborate closely with clients and internal teams to deliver high-quality SAP services.
- Contribute to knowledge transfer and best practices within the SAP team.

- Mitwirkung beim Wissensaustausch und der Weitergabe von Best Practices innerhalb des SAP-Teams.

Qualifications

- Completed degree in Business Administration, Business Informatics, or equivalent qualification with relevant professional experience
- Proven experience in SAP consulting, ideally in SAP PSM and PSCD modules
- Solid knowledge of Public Sector Management (PSM) processes and SAP PSCD
- Experience in SAP ERP and SAP S/4HANA projects, including conception, design, customizing, prototyping, and roll-out
- Knowledge of SAP FI and SAP S/4HANA Finance is a plus
- Fluent German (C1) and good English skills
- Flexible and willing to travel (20% up to 40%)

- Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse (C1) sowie gute Englischkenntnisse.

.....gesucht wird ein "bewirtender" Berufskraftfahrer oder "kundenorientierter" Gastronom mit Lkw-Führerschein.....

Wir suchen einen zuverlässigen und erfahrenen Lkw-Fahrer mit Führerschein C/CE für unseren Showtruck, der sich um die sichere und effiziente Beförderung unserer Gastronomie-Einrichtung kümmert und nahezu ganzjährig unterwegs ist, insbesondere in Italien und Frankreich.

Als Lkw-Fahrer werden Sie für die Bedienung und Wartung des Fahrzeugs verantwortlich sein und sicherstellen, dass alle Aufgaben im Zusammenhang mit dem Auf- und Abbau der Gastronomie-Einrichtung reibungslos durchgeführt werden. Zu Ihren Hauptaufgaben gehören die Fahrt zu den Veranstaltungsorten, der Auf- und Abbau der Einrichtung, der Ausschank und die Betreuung der Gäste. Wir suchen einen Kandidaten mit ausgeprägten Fahrkenntnissen, excellenten Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und einer tiefen Erfahrung im Umgang mit Lkw und Gastronomie-Einrichtungen.

Die Stelle erfordert eine hohe Flexibilität und die Bereitschaft, nahezu ganzjährig unterwegs zu sein. Wenn Sie eine Herausforderung suchen und sich für eine abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeit begeistern, dann sind Sie bei uns richtig.

Zum Aufgabengebiet gehören voraussichtlich aber nicht ausschließlich:

- Mitreisetätigkeit an 6-10 Monaten am Stück im Jahr, ausdehnbar auf 12 Monate im Jahr, wenn erste Teilsaison stimmt
- Erfahrung im Betrieb/Mitreisen bei Schaustellerbetrieben, Eventbereich
- leichter Auf- und Abbau von Gerätschaften während der Tour
- Eventunterstützung von Organisation vor Ort
- Terminplanung Tour
- Ausschankbetrieb
- Führerschein Klasse CE

Persönliche Voraussetzungen:

- Unabhängigkeit
- Altersvorgabe 30-58
- technisches Verständnis Light&Sound und LKW-Technik
- englisch fließend, jede weitere Fremdsprache ist willkommen
- Persönlichkeit: präsent, kommunikativ, selbstbewusst

Interesse? Bitte teilen Sie uns mit, wenn Sie weitere Fragen haben oder wenn Sie sich für diese Stelle interessieren.

Ergänzende Informationen:
Anforderungen an den Bewerber:
Grundkenntnisse: Getränke zubereiten und anrichten, Fahrzeugführung, Gästebetreuung, Technisches Verständnis

jobs.title: Elektrischer Vorarbeiter / Supervisor Elektrik (m/w/d) (Bauleiter/in)
jobs.description:
Was dich auszeichnet:

- Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Elektriker / Elektroniker (z.B. Industrieelektriker, Betriebstechnik, Energie- & Gebäudetechnik)
- Handwerkliches Geschick und Verständnis für Schalt- und Stromlaufpläne, sowie technische Zeichnungen
- Sicheres Auftreten und Führungskompetenz
- Gutes Englisch und Deutsch in Wort und Schrift – mind. B2-Niveau. Weitere Sprachkenntnisse von Vorteil

Was du bei uns machst :

- Baustellenprojektleitung unter Einhaltung von Qualität, Kosten, Termine

- Umsetzung der kundenspezifischen Anforderungen unter Berücksichtigung interner und externer Vorgaben
- Organisation, Führung und Weiterentwicklung der Mitarbeiter

was du dafür bekommst (Benefits):

- Corporate Benefits: Sonderangebote und Rabatte bei vielen Marken
- Jobrad Fahrrad-Leasing

jobs.title: UKLÍZEČ/-KA, Uklízeči a pomocníci v administrativních objektech
jobs.description:
KO: Šajerová Hana, tel.: 553 760 820 - volat PO-PÁ od 8:00 do 15:30 hod., e-mail: kariera@hagemann.cz

Máte silný smysl pro detail, chuť udržovat pořádek, pečlivost a spolehlivost?
Pak bychom Vám rádi nabídli práci uklízečky. Tato práce zahrnuje běžný úklid, tj. zametání, vytírání podlah, utírání prachu, čištění nábytku a zařízení, vysávání koberců a vynášení odpadků. Dále provádění čištění a dezinfekci toalet, umyvadel, pisoárů a záchodů, a to denně nebo podle stanovených hygienických norem. Součástí práce je i čištění oken, zrcadel, přepážek a světelných a tepelných zdrojů, mechanické mytí a leštění podlah, případně obsluha úklidových strojů. Kromě toho je součásti této práce výpomoc při výdeji obědů v závodní jídelně, úklid kuchyně, jídelny, příprava varnic a mytí nádobí.
Motivace pro tuto práci často pramení z radosti z viditelných výsledků dobře odvedené práce a z pocitu, že přispíváte k příjemnému prostředí pro ostatní.

Zaměstnanecké výhody:
- Příspěvek na stravování v závodní jídelně.
- Odměna k životním událostem jako je svatba, narození dítěte nebo jubileum.
- Výhodné tarify u operátora O2.
- Zaměstnanecké slevy na autoservis, pořízení vozu i stavebního materiálu.
- Až šest týdnu volna
- Pouze ranní směny
- Parkování v areálu firmy

jobs.title: Division Controller & Commercial Manager High Speed (m/f/d) (80-100%)
jobs.description:
Accelleron is accelerating sustainability in the marine and energy industries as a global technology leader in turbocharging, fuel injection, and digital solutions for heavy-duty applications. Building on a heritage of over 100 years as a trusted industry partner, the company serves customers in more than 100 locations in over 50 countries. Accelleron’s 3,000 employees are continuously innovating to deliver best-in-class products, services, and solutions that are mission-critical for the energy transition. You will join a team of experts in an exciting international environment, committed to excellence and innovation. Together, we support our customers in driving the transition toward sustainable industries with cutting-edge technology, deep expertise, and smart solutions. At Accelleron, we foster diversity and inclusion, welcoming and celebrating individual differences as a source of strength.

In this role, you will serve as a strategic Finance Business Partner for the High Speed Division, supporting the Division President and Leadership Team in driving profitable growth, operational excellence, and strategic decision-making across a global business. Working closely with stakeholders across Sales, Operations, and Technical Development in Europe, the US, and China, you will ensure financial transparency, performance management, and value creation while translating business insights into impactful actions. Reporting directly to the Chief Financial Officer (CFO), you will lead planning, forecasting, reporting, and business performance processes, while actively contributing to the division's strategic development and future growth.

Your responsibilities:


Support the definition and execution of the High Speed strategy, ensuring alignment between strategic priorities and financial targets.
Own the strategic five-year planning, budgeting and forecasting processes for the High Speed Division globally.
Own monthly, quarterly and annual financial closing and reporting, ensuring compliance with internal and external requirements.
Lead the monthly financial performance review with the Division President, providing transparency on key P&L and operational performance drivers.
Ensure transparency on customer, product and lifecycle profitability and provide actionable insights to improve financial performance.
Drive cost and working capital performance across the Division and initiate corrective actions where required.
Act as financial business partner for strategic initiatives, investments and major development projects, including active participation in business cases, design reviews and steering committees.
Partner with Sales on commercial and financial risk management, including risk reviews, insurance claims and escalation mechanisms.
Ensure effective financial governance and internal controls, including implementation and adherence to the Table of Authority.
Drive continuous innovation and improvement, simplification and standardization of financial processes and reporting.
Actively contribute to the strategic development of the High Speed division as member of the Division’s Leadership Team
Contribute to cross-divisional and Group Finance initiatives, supporting the development of the global Finance function.

Your background:


Strong financial background with expertise in controlling, planning and internal controls
Results-oriented finance leader with strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Strong business partnering and communication skills, with the ability to challenge and influence and implement solutions across the organization
Strong cross-cultural collaboration skills in a global organization
Ability to translate financial and operational insights into actions
10+ years of relevant experience, complemented by strong digital & financial tool capabilities
Digital mindset with proof record on digital innovations

Your benefits:


Attractive compensation & benefits
Employee Assistance Program Global
Parental Leave Program



We look forward to receiving your application. If you want to discover more about Accelleron, take another look at our website accelleron.com.

jobs.title: Senior / Staff Security Engineer
jobs.description:
At Linear, we're building the product development system for teams and agents. AI is fundamentally changing how software gets built, and we’re shaping the tools this new era requires.

Founded in 2019, Linear has become the platform of choice for more than 30,000 companies (including OpenAI, Coinbase, and Ramp) to plan, build, and ship their products. Today, our team is distributed across North America, Europe, and Australia, and we’re continuing to grow internationally. What unites us is relentless focus, fast execution, and a deep care for software craftsmanship.

At Linear, we are committed to quality. Security is an essential part of that quality — not a layer that we add later, but something we build in from the start. We have a foundational security program we're proud of but, as Linear evolves our product and scales into enterprise, there's meaningful work ahead: staying ahead of vulnerabilities as our attack surface grows, responding fast and cleanly when incidents happen, and hardening our product and infrastructure. As Security Engineer at Linear, you'll be operating in a high-autonomy role with real scope, doing hands-on security work across the product and infrastructure we build.

Location & work mode

Linear is a remote-first company. This role is open to candidates based in North America. You can work from anywhere within this region. We value deep focus and async collaboration, with intentional moments to connect in person through team off-sites, optional co-working, and occasional travel.

What you’ll do

Depending on your experience / skillset and our broader priorities, you could:

 - Operate, automate, and extend vulnerability management end-to-end: triage, prioritize, and drive remediation across product, infrastructure, and dependencies, and keep the program’s SLAs meaningful rather than theoretical

 - Run our bug bounty program: triage incoming reports, validate severity, work with engineering on fixes, and keep researcher relationships professional and responsive

 - Lead product security testing: threat model new features (including AI/agent-facing surfaces), review designs and code for security-relevant risk, and do hands-on testing (manual and tool-assisted) rather than relying solely on scanners

 - Be a primary responder for security incidents: lead investigation and containment, drive postmortems, and turn lessons into concrete hardening work

 - Own meaningful chunks of our cloud/infra security posture on GCP/k8s/Postgres: harden configurations, close gaps surfaced by audits or scanning, and partner with infra engineering on secure defaults

 - Build and maintain security tooling and automation, including using AI/LLM tooling to speed up triage, code review, and repetitive investigation work, so the program scales without linear headcount growth

 - Partner with the GRC/Trust function: feed real findings into the risk register and control evidence, and help make sure compliance requirements reflect actual engineering practice

What we’re looking for

 - A generalist, senior-level security engineer (5+ years across security engineering, with real depth in at least two of: vulnerability management, product/appsec testing, incident response, and cloud security). We need breadth, rather than a narrow specialist in any one of these.

 - Hands-on and technical: you can read and reason about code (we use a lot of TypeScript), you’re comfortable in cloud environments (GCP a plus), and you can go deep on a finding rather than just filing a ticket for someone else to fix. You’re comfortable using AI coding/security tools as force multipliers (Linear Agent, Claude, Codex, etc).

 - Calm under pressure: you can lead an incident from first alert through postmortem without needing to be told what to do next

 - A builder: you’d rather write a script or ship a tool than repeat a manual process a third time

 - A pragmatic risk-reducer: you optimize for actually reducing risk, not for checking a box or maximizing findings count

 - Autonomy-oriented: comfortable setting your own priorities, working with significant independence, and knowing when to escalate

 - A clear communicator: able to explain a technical finding to a non-technical stakeholder and write it up so it’s actually actionable

Our tech

This is a hands-on security engineering role. You'll be running tools, reading/writing code, building detections, working in our cloud environment, and partnering closely with the engineers who build our product. Our stack is fronted by Cloudflare and runs on Google Cloud with k8s, Postgres, and Node.

For day-to-day work, we use:

 - Linear, GitHub, Slack, and Google Workspace for collaboration

 - Claude and ChatGPT for general & engineering-specific AI tasks

 - Vanta for compliance automation and evidence collection

Our security-specific tooling includes:

 - GitHub Advanced Security

 - RunReveal

 - SentinelOne

What we offer

We're a small, focused team that cares deeply about the quality of our work and the people we do it with. Here's what you can expect:

 - Competitive salary and equity

 - Employee-friendly equity terms including early exercise in the US and extended exercise windows

 - Daily meal and coffee stipend on every workday

 - Paid co-working space or desk

 - Health coverage (based on country requirements)

 - 5 weeks paid vacation, plus local statutory holidays

 - 4 months paid parental leave

 - Paid month off after 4 years & every 2 years thereafter

 - Regular team events and off-sites

 - Remote-first with no required commute

Learn how we think and work

 - Read Me https://linear.app/readme a story about our mission

 - Our hiring process: How we hire at Linear https://linear.app/now/how-we-hire-at-linear

 - How we work: Designing remote work at Linear https://linear.app/now/designing-remote-work-at-linear

 - Why and how we do work trials https://linear.app/blog/why-and-how-we-do-work-trials-at-linear Linear blog post

 - How we use AI in design https://designerfund.substack.com/p/ai-design-linear feature of Linear's design team

 - Scaling our real-time sync engine https://linear.app/blog/scaling-the-linear-sync-engine talk by our cofounder, Tuomas Artman, at Linear's 2023 offsite

 - Our recent tender offer: Sharing Linear’s growth with the people building it https://linear.app/now/sharing-growth-with-the-people-building-linear
