jobs.title: Senior Security Consultant – Incident Response
jobs.description:
Do you want to be on the frontline when serious cyber incidents hit? You will lead complex investigations, guide customers through crises, and help shape our incident response services. You will join a highly skilled, collaborative team working with some of the most interesting and challenging cyber cases in the market. 

 

Make a real impact in high‑stakes incidents 

You will be part of a small, expert Incident Response team handling everything from ransomware to targeted attacks across large, complex environments. You will work closely with customers, helping them stay calm, informed and in control during critical situations. You will collaborate with specialists across MDR, Intelligence and Consulting, learn from unique cases, and contribute to the development of tools, methodologies and publications. At CSIS, we invest in your growth with dedicated training time, certifications, and peer learning - in an open, diverse and friendly culture built on “We commit, We care, We succeed together.” 

When you join CSIS, you will get an interesting job in a company and an industry which is growing. You will get interesting challenges, that truly make a difference for our customers, and you will be able to take ownership for your work from start to finish. And you will not least get 130+ fantastic colleagues from all over the world. Besides that, you will get: 

  • Flexible work from home arrangements 

  • A competitive salary and personal benefit package 

  • 5 weeks holiday, plus 5 extra days off each year 

  • Health Insurance, a pension, plus life and disability insurance 

  • Healthy, varied lunches (incl. vegetarian and allergy options) 

  • Home-baked goods, healthy snacks, coffee, tea and sodas in the office

  • Social activities and company events throughout the year

  • Paid mobile phone subscription and home internet 

 

Your new job 

In this client-facing role, you will lead major incident response engagements, support multiple customers, guide junior responders, and help clients strengthen their detection and response capabilities. You will work across diverse environments, industries, and technologies, making adaptability and strong communication essential.  

Your responsibilities will be: 

  • Incident Response & Investigations (Client-Facing) 

  • Lead complex and high-severity incident response engagements for customers across varied infrastructures (on-prem, cloud, hybrid). 

  • Perform advanced forensic analysis across a variety of data sources (disk, memory, network, malware, cloud) and provide clients with clear, actionable findings. 

  • Coordinate response activities with client technical teams, management, and legal/compliance contacts. 

  • Develop accurate incident timelines, attribution assessments (where possible), and root-cause analyses. 

  • Customer Communication & Advisory 

  • Act as a trusted advisor to clients during and after incidents, providing guidance on containment, recovery, and long-term improvements. 

  • Deliver polished, professional technical reports and executive summaries for clients. 

  • Present findings to technical teams as well as to senior leadership and non-technical stakeholders. 

  • Preparedness, Consulting & Continuous Improvement 

  • Assist clients with incident readiness assessments, IR playbook creation, tabletop exercises, and contribute to CSIS’s MDR detection engineering. 

  • Contribute to development of internal incident response methodologies, tooling, and best practices. 

  • Mentor and guide junior team members during engagements and internal training. 

 

About you 

You are an experienced incident responder who remains calm and structured under pressure. You enjoy working closely with customers, translating complex technical issues into clear business language, and you value collaboration and knowledge sharing. You are curious, proactive and driven by making a real difference in the fight against cybercrime. 

You bring most of the following: 

Qualifications & Technical Expertise 

  • Hands-on incident response experience, ideally in a consultancy, MSSP, DFIR, or CSIRT environment. 

  • Proven track record leading multi-client or multi-environment incident investigations. 

  • Deep knowledge of Windows, Linux, and Active Directory security.  

  • Strong knowledge of network protocols and security 

  • Strong experience with SIEM and EDR tools, including detection logic, log correlation, and threat analysis. Hands-on experience with Sentinel/Defender and CrowdStrike a plus. 

  • Advanced digital forensics experience (memory, disk, log, network). 

  • Familiarity with evidence handling, chain-of-custody standards, and forensic reporting. 

  • Strong understanding of attack techniques and threat actor behaviours (MITRE ATT&CK). 

  • Experience in cloud investigations (Azure/AWS/GCP logs, identity, telemetry). 

 

Consultancy-Specific Requirements 

  • Ability to manage multiple parallel client engagements and prioritize effectively. 

  • Excellent client-facing communication: confident, calm, and credible during crises. 

  • Strong written documentation skills for both highly technical and non-technical readers. 

  • Ability to scope engagements, set expectations, and represent the company professionally. 

 

Regulatory & Governance Knowledge 

  • Familiarity with European cybersecurity requirements, especially NIS2, GDPR breach handling, and relevant ISO standards. 

  • Ability to advise clients on improving governance, detection maturity, and incident readiness. 

 

Preferred Skills 

  • Danish speaker – English only can be accomodated. 

  • Threat hunting experience or development of hunting hypotheses. 

  • Scripting/automation (Python, PowerShell, Bash). 

  • Experience in red team/purple team activities or adversary emulation. 

  • Experience providing IR training or running tabletop exercises. 

 

Relevant Certifications  

  • GIAC: GCIH, GCIA, GCFA, GCFE, GPEN, GNFA. 

  • OSCP, CISSP, CISM, or cloud security certs (Azure/AWS/GCP). 

  • Equivalent real-world experience also highly considered and appriciated. 

 

Personal Competencies 

  • Professional, customer-oriented communication style. 

  • Ability to remain composed and decisive under pressure. 

  • Strong analytical mindset with attention to detail. 

  • Leadership qualities and ability to mentor junior responders. 

  • Curiosity and passion for threat research, attacker behaviour, and continuous learning. 

 

This is a 24/7/365 function — flexibility, out-of-hours work, on-call coverage and occasional travel is required. 

 

Other conditions 

  • Security Clearance: As you may work with some of our public sector customers, a Security Clearance may be required. 

  • Relocation: The position is based out of our offices in Denmark, with some flexibility of remote working. Relocation can also be offered to Denmark if relevant

jobs.title: Agroforestry Manager til Grove Farm Management
jobs.description:
Hos Grove Farm Management bygger for fremtidens landbrug. Vi etablerer og driver produktionssystemer med træer og buske. Vi oplever stor vækst og leder efter en operationel, faglig og handlekraftig person der kan tage ansvar for plantning og drift i Midtjylland og Sønderjylland. 

Rollen 

Du bliver ansvarlig for at planlægge og etablere beplantninger med træer og buske på vores egne arealer og hos kunder. Derudover får du ansvaret for drift af vores eget skovlandbrug på 50 ha samt løbende drift-opgaver for vores kunder og samarbejdspartnere. 

Dine ansvarsområder 

  • Etablering: Lede planlægning og etablering af skovlandbrug på tværs af vores lokationer.

  • Plantesundhed & Vedligehold: Sikre systematisk beskæring, ukrudtshåndtering og høstoptimering, så vores udbytte matcher vores kommercielle kontrakter. 

  • Udvikling og innovation: Arbejde tæt sammen med vores udviklings-team om udvikling og innovation indenfor skovlandbrug. Vi søger hele tiden at skubbe grænserne for kommercielle skovlandbrug og laver løbende markforsøg på vores kommercielle arealer og deltager i forskningsprojekter.

Om dig

  • Du har en stærk faglig baggrund (skov- og landskabsingeniør, agronom, produktionsgartner, jordbrugsteknolog eller lignende).

  • Du trives i et tværfagligt miljø hvor hoved og hænder skal arbejde sammen. Du kan planlægge en beplantning om morgenen og sidde på traktoren eller beskære træer om eftermiddagen.

Three profile opportunities

Career Path 1: Flight Instructor DK summer / Spain winther

As a Flight Instructor, your primary responsibility will be delivering flight training onboard our aircraft. Depending on operational needs, you may also conduct simulator sessions and classroom-based theoretical instruction.

You will guide students throughout their training journey and help ensure the highest standards of pilot education.

Mandatory Requirements

This position is designed for pilots who meet the requirements for CRI/SPA training but have not yet obtained the qualification.

Join GreyBird Pilot Academy and help shape the future of aviation.

We can’t wait to hear from you.

jobs.title: Postdoc in environmental medicine
jobs.description:
The translational pharmacology research group at Clinical Pharmacology, Pharmacy and Environmental Medicine (CPPEM), Department of Public Health, Faculty of Health Sciences, University of Southern Denmark, invites applications for a fully funded 18 months postdoctoral position. The position is to be filled from January 1st, 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.


About the Research Environment

The research areas of CPPEM span from pharmacoepidemiology to clinical studies, and cell-based basic pharmacology and environmental medicine. Collectively, CPPEM has a strong background in exposure to environmental chemicals, pharmacoepidemiology, pharmacogenetics, pharmacokinetics, drug-drug interactions, and therapeutic drug monitoring. Specifically, the translational pharmacology group aims to understand variability in drug toxicity, drug metabolism and drug transport. Examples of this include cell-based models such as induced-pluripotent stem cells, primary human hepatocytes, and clinical studies. The pharmacoepidemiological research group utilizes the world-class Danish registries as well as international data sources to assess pharmacological questions in large populations. The environmental medicine group studies the impact of early life exposures to environmental chemicals. In particular PFAS is a focus area, with studies of the adverse health effects of exposure, biomonitoring and advising national and international authorities. The analytical chemistry laboratory analyzes concentrations of drugs or environmental chemicals in various matrices. 

In the Environmental Medicine group we are looking for a post doc funded by Novo Nordic Foundation and ERC advanced grant. The projects focus on the Odense Child Cohort and study the impact of early life exposures to environmental chemicals. Especially PFAS and their adverse effects on maternal and child health (e.g. the brain, immune, metabolic and reproductive system). In addition, we aim to identify toxicity of short PFAS including trifluoroacetic acid, widely used but considered less toxic due to their short half-life. 

We are seeking a candidate with a PhD in medicine, pharmacology, public health, or a related discipline. Work within environmental medicine is an advance, and epidemiological and statistical skills are essential. Motivation, curiosity, and a strong drive to excel in environmental research are very important. Excellent communication skills in written and spoken English is a requirement. The position includes independent scientific writing, clinical project leading, and supervision of students. You should be interested in contributing both to the scientific armamentarium in our department and to our collegial culture. It is also expected that the post doc contributes to additional fundraising for the projects as well as research collaborations and the continuation of the Odense Child Cohort, and takes on teaching responsibilities within the department. You will, in your daily work, refer to Professor Tina Kold Jensen, but also engage in a very active collaboration with the full research group.


Your qualifications

  • PhD in medicine, pharmacology, public health, or a related discipline.

  • Experience within environmental medicine is considered an advantage

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English

  • Ability to work independently with scientific writing and publication

  • Interest in and experience with supervision of students

  • Commitment to contributing to both scientific excellence and a positive collegial culture within the department

  • Interest in establishing and maintaining national and international research collaboration
     

Further information

Interviews can be performed online if needed. If you will need to relocate to Denmark for the position, both the University and the research group will provide ample support.

Additional information about the position can be obtained from Tina Kold Jensen (tkjensen@health.sdu.dk; 0045 29464350).

jobs.title: PhD Position in Data-driven Critical Raw Material Supply Chain Resilience
jobs.description:
Do you want to investigate the resilience of critical raw material supply chains supporting low-carbon and digital technologies? Join us as a PhD student at SDU Life Cycle Engineering, University of Southern Denmark.

The Department of Green Technology at the University of Southern Denmark invites applications for a three-year PhD position in data-driven critical raw material supply chain resilience.

The position will be based at SDU Life Cycle Engineering, Department of Green Technology, Faculty of Engineering, at the SDU Odense campus. The expected starting date is 15 February 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter.

 

Project Overview

The deployment of low-carbon technologies, electrification and digital infrastructure is increasing global demand for critical raw materials. At the same time, the production and processing of many of these materials are geographically concentrated and exposed to geopolitical, economic, environmental and logistical disruptions.

Understanding how technology development affects material demand, in-use stocks, end-of-life flows and global supply dependencies is therefore important for assessing and strengthening the resilience of critical raw material supply chains.

The PhD position is jointly funded through research projects on critical raw material supply chains and material requirements for Denmark’s climate-neutral transition. The project will be embedded in an interdisciplinary research environment combining environmental systems analysis, supply-chain research and data science.

 

PhD Topic Description

The PhD project will develop modular and data-driven approaches for analysing critical raw material demand, supply-chain dependencies and resilience.

A central methodological contribution will be the development of transparent, reusable and reproducible computational modules for dynamic material flow analysis. The modules will support the integration of technology deployment scenarios, material intensities, product lifetimes, stocks and flows, end-of-life management, recycling, production, trade, facility and ownership data.

The developed approaches will be applied to selected technology systems, including Denmark’s wind-energy infrastructure and the rapidly expanding infrastructure supporting data centres and AI computing. These cases will be analysed within a common methodological framework to examine how infrastructure expansion and technological change influence demand for critical and scarce materials, in-use stocks, future waste flows, recycling potential and global supply-chain dependencies.

The project may also investigate overlapping material requirements and competition for materials across low-carbon and digital technologies. Particular attention may be given to supply concentration, host–by-product dependencies, trade and ownership structures, supply bottlenecks, cascading risks and potential resilience strategies.

Depending on the candidate’s academic background and the specific research questions, the project may include network analysis, geospatial analysis, scenario modelling, uncertainty analysis, machine learning and other AI-supported approaches.

The candidate will build on selected existing models, datasets and research activities in the group and further develop scientifically robust and reusable methods that improve transparency, comparability and reproducibility in material-system research.

The exact research focus and detailed PhD plan will be developed jointly with the successful candidate, taking into account the project objectives, academic background and research interests.

In addition to a PhD dissertation and high-quality scientific publications, the project is expected to produce reusable modelling methods, documented datasets and reproducible computational workflows.

 

PhD Position and Research Environment

As a PhD student, you will conduct independent research under the supervision of an interdisciplinary team, contribute to high-quality scientific publications and participate actively in a collaborative research environment.

You will join SDU Life Cycle Engineering, where research covers industrial ecology, material flow analysis, life cycle assessment, circular economy, resource systems and sustainability transitions.

The project connects expertise in engineering, data science, mathematics, business, supply-chain research and geological resources. The wider research environment includes competences in material flow analysis, critical raw material systems, data mining, network analysis, supply-chain science, finance, investment, ownership structures, geological resources and technology systems.

The position provides opportunities for collaboration across SDU faculties and with external research partners. It may also include participation in international conferences, research visits and collaboration with relevant industrial and public-sector stakeholders.

The PhD programme follows the Danish PhD framework and includes coursework, participation in active research environments, dissemination activities, and teaching or other knowledge-dissemination duties.

 

What We Expect

We are looking for a highly motivated, independent and collaborative candidate with a strong interest in critical raw materials, quantitative modelling, data-driven research and sustainability.

Applicants must hold a relevant master’s degree or equivalent by the time of enrolment. Relevant academic backgrounds may include engineering, industrial ecology, sustainability science, resource management, data science, computer science, applied mathematics, operations research, supply-chain management, geoinformatics, mining or geological sciences, or another relevant natural science or quantitative discipline.

The successful candidate should demonstrate:

  • A solid academic foundation in quantitative analysis, system modelling, data science or related methods. 

  • Experience with programming and data analysis, preferably using Python or a similar programming language. 

  • Experience with data handling, including data cleaning, transformation, integration and exploratory analysis. 

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. 

  • The ability to work independently and collaboratively in an interdisciplinary research environment. 

  • Good written and spoken English. 

  • A strong interest in sustainability, critical raw materials and supply-chain resilience. 

Experience in one or more of the following areas will be considered an advantage:

  • Material flow analysis, industrial ecology or material systems modelling. 

  • Network, supply-chain or geospatial analysis. 

  • Scientific computing and reproducible research workflows. 

  • Statistics, machine learning, artificial intelligence, optimisation, uncertainty or scenario analysis. 

  • International trade, production facility or corporate ownership data. 

  • Critical raw materials, wind energy, digital infrastructure or data centres. 

Applicants are not expected to possess expertise in all these areas. Prior experience with material flow analysis is an advantage but is not a requirement. Relevant training will be provided according to the candidate’s background and the needs of the project.

 

Application

Before applying the candidates are advised to read the Faculty information for prospective PhD students and the SDU information on how to apply.

The application must be submitted in English through the SDU online recruitment system.

Assessment of applicants will be based on the submitted application material. The application must include:

  • Curriculum Vitae. 

  • A motivated application describing the applicant’s research interests, relevant qualifications and motivation for applying. 

  • Documentation of academic qualifications, including bachelor’s and master’s degree certificates and complete transcripts of grades. 

  • Official English translations of documents not issued in English or Danish. 

  • Two letters of recommendation. 

  • A list of publications and up to two examples of relevant publications, if available. 

  • The completed TEK PhD application form for 5+3 applicants. Find the form at the Faculty website.

  • The completed TEK form for calculation of grade-point average. Find the form at the Faculty website.

  • Official documentation describing the grading system of the awarding university, if the degree was not obtained in Denmark. 

  • Examples of relevant thesis work, software, code repositories or other research outputs, where available. 

  • Only for applicants from programmes that evaluate thesis/examination project by approved/not approved: An official written assessment of the thesis or dissertation project from the grade giving institution. The statement must clearly state that the candidate has been among the top 30 pct. in the graduation class for the study programme.

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

For administrative questions regarding the recruitment process, please contact our email support.

 

The application deadline is November 15, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Enrollment and employment terms

Appointment as a PhD fellow is a 3-year salaried position, and the monthly gross salary incl. pension is 37.075 DKK. If you have relevant postgraduate experience, you may be placed on a higher salary step. The place of employment is in Odense, Denmark and preferred starting date is February 15, 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter.

Applicants must hold a master’s degree (equivalent to a Danish master's degree) at the time of enrollment and employment. Employment is contingent on enrollment approved by the PhD School. Enrollment will be in accordance with Faculty regulations and the Danish Ministerial Order on the PhD Programme at the Universities (PhD order). Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for PhD fellows as described therein as well as the Protocol on PhD fellows signed by the Danish Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (AC). 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

-

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

 

SDU Life Cycle Engineering

The successful candidate will be affiliated with SDU Life Cycle Engineering at the Department of Green Technology. The research environment conducts interdisciplinary research on the global and systemic interactions between materials, technologies, energy, the environment and society.

The Department of Green Technology is located in Odense, the main campus of the University of Southern Denmark. Odense offers an international research environment and an open Scandinavian working culture.

 

Further Information

Further information about the scientific content of the position is available from:

Wu Chen
Associate Professor
Department of Green Technology
SDU Life Cycle Engineering
University of Southern Denmark
Email: wuc@igt.sdu.dk

For administrative questions regarding the recruitment process, please contact our email support.

jobs.title: Executive Assistant & Business Management Support - CEO Office (m/f)
jobs.description:
Description:


Executive Assistant


Pour l'un de nos clients, acteur bancaire de premier plan au Luxembourg, nous recherchons un(e) Executive Assistant & Business Management Support pour rejoindre l'environnement direct du CEO et de son Executive Office.


A PROPOS DU POSTE

Vous avez déjà acquis une première expérience solide dans un environnement exigeant, idéalement au sein d'un Big4, d'un cabinet de conseil, d'un cabinet d'avocats ou du secteur financier, et vous souhaitez aujourd'hui vous rapprocher du cœur des décisions d'une organisation ?

Cette opportunité va au-delà d'un poste classique d'Executive Assistant.

Aux côtés du CEO et de son environnement exécutif, vous combinez support de haut niveau, coordination, préparation de supports et suivi de sujets stratégiques et opérationnels.

Votre rôle : permettre au CEO d'être organisé, préparé et concentré sur ses priorités, tout en assurant un suivi rigoureux des informations, demandes et actions qui gravitent autour de l'Executive Office.

Il s'agit d'une fonction particulièrement intéressante pour un profil ayant environ 5 années d'expérience, souhaitant continuer à apprendre, gagner en exposition et évoluer progressivement vers des responsabilités plus larges de Business Management / Executive Office.


VOTRE RÔLE ET RESPONSABILITES:
Executive Support & organisation

Vous assurez un support quotidien fluide et structuré auprès du CEO et de son environnement exécutif :

    gestion proactive d'un agenda complexe et mouvant ;
    organisation et coordination des réunions internes et externes ;
    préparation des rendez-vous, agendas et documents nécessaires ;
    anticipation des échéances et identification des priorités ;
    coordination des déplacements professionnels et de leur logistique ;
    gestion des notes de frais, factures et autres sujets administratifs associés.

Vous ne vous contentez pas d'organiser : vous anticipez, identifiez les conflits de priorité et proposez des solutions.
Business Management & coordination

Une partie importante de votre rôle consiste à faciliter le fonctionnement de l'Executive Office.

À ce titre, vous :

    assurez le suivi des actions et décisions prises lors des réunions ;
    sollicitez les différentes parties prenantes afin d'obtenir les informations attendues ;
    consolidez des informations provenant de plusieurs interlocuteurs ;
    structurez ces éléments afin de les rendre immédiatement exploitables par le CEO ;
    maintenez des trackers et outils de suivi permettant de donner de la visibilité sur l'avancement des différents sujets ;
    contribuez à la coordination de projets et initiatives transverses ;
    identifiez les échéances ou sujets nécessitant une attention particulière et les faites remonter de manière proactive.

Votre capacité à comprendre rapidement un sujet, structurer l'information et assurer le suivi jusqu'à sa finalisation fera réellement la différence.
Executive Communication & préparation de supports

Vous contribuez directement à la qualité des informations et documents utilisés au niveau exécutif :

    préparation et mise en forme de présentations PowerPoint ;
    préparation de briefings, notes de synthèse et meeting packs ;
    consolidation de données et préparation de reportings simples sous Excel ;
    rédaction, relecture et adaptation de communications en français et en anglais ;
    préparation et organisation de documents destinés à des réunions de management ou de gouvernance.

Vous savez transformer une quantité importante d'informations en un support clair, synthétique et orienté décision.
Coordination & stakeholder management

Positionné(e) au cœur de l'organisation, vous êtes en interaction avec de nombreux interlocuteurs internes et externes.

Vous assurez une communication fluide et professionnelle, relancez lorsque nécessaire et savez adapter votre approche à des interlocuteurs de niveaux de séniorité différents.

La confidentialité, la diplomatie et la qualité de votre communication sont essentielles dans cette fonction.


Vous avez idéalement :

    un Bachelor ou Master en gestion, économie, management ou formation équivalente ;
    environ 5 années d'expérience professionnelle dans une fonction d'Executive Assistant, Business Support, PMO, Executive Office ou une fonction comparable ;
    une expérience acquise dans un Big4 ou un environnement de conseil/professional services exigeant, fortement appréciée ;
    l'habitude de travailler directement avec des Partners, Managing Directors, membres de direction ou autres senior executives ;
    une excellente maîtrise de PowerPoint, avec la capacité de produire des présentations professionnelles et structurées ;
    une bonne maîtrise d'Excel et des outils de suivi/reporting ;
    d'excellentes capacités rédactionnelles et de synthèse ;
    une parfaite maîtrise professionnelle du français et de l'anglais ; le luxembourgeois constitue un atout.

Au-delà de votre expérience, nous recherchons surtout une personnalité.

Vous êtes structuré(e), fiable et extrêmement organisé(e), mais également curieux(se) et capable de comprendre ce qui se joue derrière une demande.

Vous savez travailler dans un environnement où les priorités peuvent changer rapidement, sans perdre en qualité ni en précision.

Vous êtes à l'aise avec des interlocuteurs seniors tout en conservant une posture professionnelle et naturelle.

Enfin, vous recherchez un poste dans lequel vous pourrez apprendre, prendre progressivement davantage de responsabilités et développer une compréhension transverse du fonctionnement d'une banque et de son Executive Management.

jobs.title: Directeur de la Practice CIO Advisory (h/f)
jobs.description:
Directeur de la Practice CIO Advisory (H/F) – Région Liège-Luxembourg

Reference: LU879641
Luxembourg
Permanent
Legal and Professional Services

Notre client est un cabinet de conseil international fondé au début des années 2000 et aujourd'hui présent dans plusieurs pays européens.
Sa mission est d'accompagner les entreprises dans l'atteinte de leurs objectifs en délivrant des résultats mesurables et concrets.
Son expertise couvre l'excellence opérationnelle, l'optimisation de la supply chain, la data, la conduite du changement, la transformation digitale et la transition durable.

Le cabinet intervient auprès d'organisations de premier plan dans des secteurs variés tels que l'industrie, les sciences de la vie, le secteur public, les services financiers, le retail et la construction.
Dans un contexte où les transformations numériques s'accélèrent et où les DSI, CIO et CTO jouent un rôle croissant dans la définition de la stratégie des entreprises, notre client souhaite aujourd'hui franchir une nouvelle étape avec la création et le développement d'une practice CIO Advisory.

Cette practice a vocation à devenir un axe majeur du développement du cabinet, en accompagnant les dirigeants IT et les directions générales dans leurs réflexions et transformations stratégiques, organisationnelles et technologiques.
Pour accompagner sa croissance et participer à des projets de transformation et d'excellence opérationnelle, notre client recherche actuellement un(e) Directeur de la Practice CIO Advisory (H/F).

Votre rôle

En tant que Directeur de la Practice CIO Advisory, vous aurez la responsabilité de piloter et délivrer des missions de transformation IT à fort impact, tout en contribuant au développement de la practice, de son portefeuille clients et de ses équipes.
Vous interviendrez directement auprès des CIO, CTO, DSI et Directions Générales, de la définition des orientations jusqu'à leur mise en œuvre, avec une forte exigence de résultats, de qualité de delivery et d'impact durable.

Pilotage et delivery des missions clients

Vous jouerez un rôle central dans la conduite et la réussite des missions de la practice :

• Piloter des missions complexes de stratégie et transformation IT, de leur cadrage jusqu'à leur mise en œuvre.
• Accompagner les clients dans la définition de leur vision cible IT et sa déclinaison en feuilles de route concrètes et opérationnelles.
• Superviser les diagnostics, analyses, recommandations et plans de transformation réalisés par les équipes.
• Challenger les organisations, processus, architectures et modes de fonctionnement IT afin d'identifier les leviers de performance et de transformation.
• Assurer la qualité des livrables, le respect des engagements et l'atteinte des résultats attendus.
• Intervenir directement auprès des instances de direction et accompagner les clients dans leurs décisions stratégiques.
• Sécuriser l'exécution des transformations et accompagner les équipes clients jusqu'à l'obtention de résultats durables.
Développement et structuration de la practice

En vous appuyant sur les besoins rencontrés sur le terrain, vous contribuerez à faire évoluer et structurer l'offre CIO Advisory :

• Développer des méthodologies et approches permettant de transformer l'expertise acquise en mission en offres structurées et réplicables.
• Identifier les nouvelles problématiques rencontrées par les CIO et faire évoluer l'offre en conséquence.
• Développer des synergies avec les autres expertises du cabinet : cybersécurité, data, ERP, cloud, transformation et excellence opérationnelle.
• Contribuer au positionnement et au développement de la practice au sein de mon client.
Développement commercial et relation client
Le développement commercial s'inscrira dans la continuité de votre activité de conseil et de votre proximité avec les clients :
• Développer des relations de confiance durables avec les CIO, CTO, DSI et Directions Générales.
• Identifier de nouvelles opportunités à partir des enjeux et besoins rencontrés chez les clients.
• Construire et développer un portefeuille de missions CIO Advisory.
• Piloter les avant-ventes, propositions commerciales, appels d'offres et soutenances.
• Développer le cross-selling avec les autres practices et contribuer à la croissance du cabinet.

Leadership et développement des équipes

En tant que Directeur, vous serez également responsable de la qualité et du développement des équipes intervenant sur vos missions :

• Encadrer les équipes et leur apporter le niveau de guidance nécessaire à la réussite des missions.
• Challenger les analyses, recommandations et livrables afin de garantir un haut niveau d'exigence.
• Accompagner les consultants dans leur montée en compétences et leur capacité à prendre progressivement davantage de responsabilités en delivery.
• Transmettre votre expertise à travers le coaching, le mentoring et le partage d'expérience.
• Contribuer au recrutement et au développement des expertises nécessaires à la croissance de la practice.
• Développer une culture fondée sur l'excellence du delivery, le pragmatisme, la collaboration et l'obtention de résultats concrets.

Profil recherché

Nous recherchons avant tout un leader entrepreneurial, capable de combiner expertise technique, excellence du delivery et développement commercial.

Vous disposez idéalement de :

• Une formation de niveau Master (Bac+5), idéalement issue d'une école d'ingénieurs, d'une université ou d'une grande école avec une spécialisation IT, digitale ou technologique.
• Au moins 10 ans d'expérience dans le conseil, la transformation IT ou des environnements technologiques complexes.
• De solides compétences techniques et une forte compréhension des enjeux IT, vous permettant de challenger des architectures, des organisations, des choix technologiques et des trajectoires de transformation.
• Une expertise sur plusieurs dimensions du CIO Advisory : stratégie IT, operating model, cloud, infrastructures, architecture, cybersécurité, data, modernisation ou rationalisation des systèmes d'information.
• Une expérience significative dans le pilotage et le delivery de missions complexes, depuis le cadrage stratégique jusqu'à la mise en œuvre.
• Une expérience solide auprès de CIO, CTO, DSI et Directions Générales, avec la capacité à intervenir comme interlocuteur de confiance sur des problématiques stratégiques et techniques.
• Une réelle capacité à développer du business : identification d'opportunités, développement de comptes, construction de propositions commerciales, soutenances et développement de nouvelles missions.
• Une forte capacité à développer et entretenir des relations de confiance avec des décideurs de haut niveau.
• Un fort esprit entrepreneurial, avec l'envie de construire, structurer et faire grandir une activité.
• Une excellente communication, une forte posture de conseil et une capacité à embarquer clients et équipes.

jobs.title: Remote Office Assistant

Coalition Technologies is seeking a reliable, detail-oriented, and highly organized Remote Office Assistant to support administrative, bookkeeping, billing, reporting, data entry, and internal operations tasks. This role is ideal for someone with strong communication skills, discretion, attention to detail, and a willingness to learn and grow within a fast-paced remote work environment.

As an Office Assistant, you will help support daily administrative operations, assist with entry-level bookkeeping, organize client documents, support internal reporting, and help maintain accurate company records. This position offers strong growth potential for the right candidate, including opportunities for advancement within the Accounting team or other departments.

We are looking for talented and diligent candidates who perform well on our skills assessments. Strong skills test performance may be considered even if a candidate does not meet every preferred experience or educational background requirement.

 

Why Join Coalition Technologies?

Coalition Technologies is committed to delivering high-quality work for our clients while providing our team with a fun, thriving, innovative, and growth-focused work environment. We offer:

  • 100% remote work with a company that has supported remote team members for more than a decade
  • Competitive profit-sharing bonus plan, with up to 50% of company profits paid to full-time employees each month
  • Competitive Paid Time Off plan that supports work-life balance
  • Subsidized gym memberships
  • Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance packages for eligible US-based team members
  • International Health Insurance Reimbursement Program for eligible international team members
  • Device upgrade and learning reimbursement programs
  • Career development plans with clearly defined goals and rewards
  • Additional job-specific incentives and bonuses

 

Office Assistant Responsibilities

As an Office Assistant, your duties will include:

  • Answering phones and emails
  • Completing entry-level bookkeeping tasks, including recording expenses, organizing receipts, and maintaining transaction records
  • Resolving billing issues with clients and internal team members
  • Providing account access, usage reports, data analysis, and other ad hoc support for team members
  • Supporting quality assurance checks for internal and client-facing reports
  • Organizing new client contracts, creating invoices, and processing client payments
  • Contributing to internal database maintenance, upkeep, and data entry
  • Researching, ordering, and distributing company-wide gifts two to three times per year
  • Organizing company events, competitions, and special projects throughout the year
  • Facilitating company holiday calendars, time-off calendars, and schedule variation calendars

 

Required Skills and Qualifications

The ideal candidate will have:

  • Willingness to learn, grow, and collaborate with the team and company as a whole
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • High level of discretion, ethics, and trustworthiness
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills
  • Ability to support administrative, bookkeeping, billing, reporting, and data entry tasks
  • Innovative thinking and willingness to challenge existing methods when improvement is possible
  • Availability to work 40 hours per week, Monday through Friday, 9:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. Pacific Time
  • Reliable remote workspace with a fast computer, quality internet, camera, microphone, and speakers

 

Preferred Skills

  • The following experience is preferred but not required:
  • Intermediate spreadsheet skills
  • Experience with bookkeeping or financial record keeping
  • Experience with Google Sheets, Microsoft Excel, QuickBooks Online, and Google Workspace
  • Experience supporting billing, invoicing, reporting, data entry, or administrative operations

 

Remote Work Environment

Coalition Technologies is a fully remote company. Our team works remotely with the support of time tracking software, structured communication, and a company culture designed to help remote team members succeed. We have supported remote team members for more than a decade and welcome qualified applicants from around the world.

 

Growth Opportunity

This position offers a strong opportunity for growth. Successful Office Assistants at Coalition Technologies have advanced quickly and earned promotions within the Accounting team and across other departments.

 

Compensation

For candidates located in California, New York, Washington, and Colorado, the starting base pay for this position ranges from $15 to $25 per hour. Compensation may vary based on factors such as experience, qualifications, skills test performance, geographic location, and seniority of the position offered. For candidates outside of California, New York, Washington, and Colorado, compensation may fall outside the listed range.

jobs.description:

Innovate with Tether

Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the worldâs most trusted stablecoin, USDT, relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

But thatâs just the beginning:

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

Tether Education: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

Tether Evolution: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If youâre passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. Weâve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

QV.AC is a general purpose AI assistant that runs locally on your devices. It gives people real control over their data and how they use AI. No cloud dependency, no data harvesting, and no one else's servers between you and your assistant. Our focus is local, on-device, privacy-preserving AI, connected across Tether's peer-to-peer ecosystem. We're building the AI assistant people actually own. Product sets the direction.

We're looking for a Product Engineering Lead to turn that direction into features people love, built to a standard that holds up on real devices with real constraints. You lead the teams that build QV.AC's features and app experience on top of our local AI stack, each with its own lead. You report directly to the CTO and take direction from product. Product owns the what and the why. You own the how and the engineering bar.

The split is roughly 70% engineering leadership and 30% product. You're a combination of three things. You're an engineering leader who has helped teams ship consumer products at speed. You have real product sense and can partner with PMs as an equal, shaping what gets built, not just executing it. And you have an intuition for AI systems and their limits, so you can turn emerging capabilities into features that work reliably on-device, without needing to build the models yourself.

Responsibilities

  • Engineering - Run the app and feature teams day to day: unblocking, reviewing, and keeping them shipping.- Set and hold a high engineering bar for performance, reliability, and clean APIs.- Own the technical design of features and the API surface between our AI core and the app.- Make sure your teams work closely with our AI research and deep tech teams on code reviews, design, and anything that touches models or inference.

  • Product Partnership - Work alongside QV.AC's product managers to turn vision and roadmap into scoped, buildable work.- Push back when scope and reality don't match, and propose better paths when they exist.- Bring an engineering perspective to product decisions, especially on what local models can do well today and what they can't yet.- Help the team move fast, using AI tools and quick prototypes to validate ideas before committing to them.

  • Leadership - Create clarity around team goals and make sure everyone knows what success looks like.- Mentor team leads to build strong team operating systems, improve how their teams work with others, and grow as leaders.- Lead by example: roll up your sleeves when the team needs it, and step back when they're ready to own it.



Mandatory:

  • Experience managing engineers or engineering leads who ship consumer product, ideally AI-powered apps.

  • Strong product sense: you can tell a good feature from a busy one.

  • Intuition for applied AI and on-device constraints: model size, latency, memory, battery, and the gap between a good demo and a reliable feature. You don't need ML research expertise, because our core abstracts it away.

  • You use AI tools heavily in your own work and enjoy experimenting with new models and capabilities.

  • Deep JavaScript and React.

  • Initiative, curiosity, resilience, and the ability to give and receive direct critique.

Preferred:

  • Bonus: Experience with local or on-device inference, LLM evals, cross-platform mobile and desktop apps, or open source.

jobs.title: Projektstilling i projekt med at være kirke for unge i Aarhus
jobs.description:
Kan du se dig selv i en vision om at folkekirken tilbyder et sted for unge i Aarhus, hvor man kan hænge ud og indgå i fællesskaber? Er du relationelt orienteret? Og har du det fint med både at sidde til planlægningsmøder og løfte konkrete, praktiske opgaver – så tror vi, at du vil finde dette opslag interessant.

For godt et års tid siden åbnede Christianskirken i Aarhus STEDET. Her kan unge i Aarhus hænge ud, sidde med deres studier, deltage i aktiviteter, møde andre unge til fællesspisning og få et møde med kirken i øjenhøjde. Er du den, som skal være med til at videreudvikle og konsolidere dét arbejde?

 

STEDET er fysisk lokation på Katrinebjerg, men det er også en måde at vise at kirken er mere end gudstjenester; at kirken er fællesskaber, samtaler om stort og småt, mulighed for at møde andre unge og et pitstop i den hverdag, som unge lever i.

 

Der er tale om en etårig projektstilling på 30 timer ugentligt, med eventuel mulighed for forlængelse, hvis den fremtidige finansiering falder på plads.

Opgaver

Som projektmedarbejder ved Christianskirken, skal du overordnet set være med til at udleve kirkens vision:

Christianskirken - et livstræ med mange grene, der

·        Rækker synligt ud i sognet

·        Peger opad og inspirerer til at søge Gud

·        Styrker og engagerer den enkelte og menigheden

 

    - for at gøre evangeliet kendt, troet og levet.

 

Konkret betyder det, at…

·        du – i samarbejde med bl.a. menighedsrådet, projektets styregruppe og den anden projektmedarbejder – sikrer den daglige drift på STEDET, og i mange sammenhænge er du STEDETs ansigt udadtil.

·        du er vært på STEDET, så de unge der kommer ind ad døren, mærker at de er velkomne her.

·        du ærligt kan sige, at du har lyst til at arbejde sammen med unge, er imødekommende og kan tage initiativ til fx en snak eller igangsætte brætspil.

·        du indgår i et samarbejde med ansatte og frivillige om at planlægge og afvikle forskellige typer af aktiviteter. Fx fællesspisning hvor du veksler mellem at stå i front og ”være den” og stå i baggrunden og få andre til at lykkes i deres frivillige opgave.

·        du sidder med i styregruppen (som består af repræsentanter for menighedsråd, ungdomsråd og ansatte ved Christianskirken) for STEDET, og er med til at sætte retning for projektet, og i mange tilfælde er du ansvarlig for at det som besluttes dér, bliver til virkelighed.

·        du vil være ansvarlig for rekruttering, fastholdelse og udrustning af frivillige. For STEDET er ikke noget, som laves for de unge, men noget vi laver sammen med unge.

·        du får til opgave at pleje og videreudvikle vores netværk med samarbejdspartnere og interessenter i Aarhus. Det er fx uddannelsesinstitutioner, NGO’er som arbejder med unge, naboer på Katrinebjerg, nøglepersoner i Aarhus kommune og kirker i Aarhus.

·        du løser forskellige administrative og koordinerende opgaver såsom at have overblik over vores forbrug og sørge for at betalinger sker rettidigt; booking af lokaler; forberedelse af møder, at vores tillidsbod har varer på hylderne m.v.

 

I det daglige er din nærmeste kollega vores projektmedarbejder, som har fokus på kommunikation og aktiviteter og den præst, som er tilknyttet STEDET og er projektleder. I har hver jeres ansvarsområder, men arbejder sammen om meget af det som sker på STEDET.

 

Vi forventer at du…

·        har en konstruktiv tilgang til tingene og kan samarbejde med både professionelle og amatører.

·        har erfaring fra selv at have frivilligt engageret, og gerne at du har erfaring med engagere, motivere og samarbejde andre frivillige på en måde, så de føler sig påskønnede og som en aktiv del af STEDETS liv og aktiviteter.

·       er nysgerrig på nye mennesker og har det godt med at samle mennesker.

·        kan se idéen i at vi som kirke laver dette tilbud til unge i vores by.

·        er i stand til at omsætte strategiske beslutninger til konkrete handlinger.

·        har syn for både helheden og detaljen, og trives med at arbejde både på et overordnet og et praktisk plan. Nogle dage vil du derfor sidde og udvikle en idé, og andre dage svinger du støvsugeren, så der er klar til næste event.

·        kan lide at arbejde i team med andre, samtidig med at du er god til at arbejde selvstændigt, systematisk og struktureret med dine opgaver.

·        har en faglig eller erfaringsmæssig baggrund, som er relevant for dette job.

·        er fleksibel ift arbejdstid. Der er primært tale om arbejde i dagtimerne, men der er også aftenarbejde i skiftende omfang.

·        kan identificere dig med Christianskirkens samspilsværdier - åbenhed, respekt, omsorg og engagement - samt evner at omsætte disse i relation til andre mennesker.

 

 

Om kirken:

Christianskirken er en aktiv kirke på Christiansbjerg. Kirkens arbejde præges af mere end 400 frivillige, der bidrager til kirkens liv og aktiviteter på forskellig vis.

Vi tilbyder bl.a.:

•        Samarbejde med engagerede kolleger i et godt arbejdsmiljø, der vægter teamsamarbejdet højt.

•        Godt besøgte gudstjenester, der i udtryk og stilarter rummer variation, tradition og fornyelse.  

•        Et rigt menighedsliv.

 

Har du lyst til at høre mere om stillingen, er du meget velkommen til at kontakte daglig leder, Vibeke Dahmen på 41 72 71 06 eller projektleder Lasse Holmgaard Iversen på 26 25 57 88.

Som ansat ved Christianskirken refererer du overordnet set til menighedsrådet som arbejdsgiver, repræsenteret ved menighedsrådets kontaktperson. I det daglige referer du til Christianskirkens daglige leder, Vibeke Dahmen, der vil forestå den daglige ledelsesopgave, samt til projektleder for STEDET, sognepræst Lasse Holmgaard Iversen. Beskrivelse af sognet kan findes på kirkens hjemmeside www.christianskirken.dk

Ansøgningssted: Ansøgning, anbefalinger, referencer samt kopi af evt. eksamensbevis, sendes via sikker mail til kirkekontoret, att. daglig leder Vibeke Dahmen. (Link findes på kirkens hjemmeside).

jobs.title: Global Demo Engineer
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

As one of Notion’s founding Demo Engineers, you’ll build the global demo engine behind how we bring Notion’s most important customer stories to life. You’ll shape the standards, systems, and experiences that help our Sales teams demonstrate what is possible with Notion, from the first customer conversation through implementation and deployment.



This is a high-impact opportunity to create the function from the ground up. You’ll establish global standards, turn our strongest customer solutions into repeatable demos, and give regional teams the tools and autonomy to innovate. Your work will directly influence how customers understand Notion’s platform, AI capabilities, and potential to transform how their organizations work.



This role reports to the Global Head of Acquisition and partners closely with Sales, Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE), Enablement, and PMM.

 

This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Build the global demo engine that brings Notion’s most important customer stories to life
   
   - Partner with Enablement and PMM to define the core narratives, scripts, environments, and assets for each demo
   
   - Create a durable release and versioning process so demos stay current as the product evolves
   
   - Automate repeatable setup and maintenance wherever possible so the system can scale globally

 - Turn Notion’s strongest customer and internal solutions into reusable GTM assets
   
   - Identify high-impact use cases and transform them into repeatable, field-ready demos
   
   - Partner with FDE to package customer solutions, implementation guidance, and technical patterns into demos the field can confidently deliver
   
   - Work with GTM Systems to translate demos into workspaces that can be deployed in customer environments

 - Set the global standard for demo quality and help the field deliver it
   
   - Define what great looks like for each demo moment, from the first customer conversation to a tailored technical experience
   
   - Train and coach customer-facing teams on storytelling, environment setup, delivery, and troubleshooting
   
   - Partner with Enablement to create practical resources and programs that raise demo quality across regions

 - Create a clear path from experimentation to global scale
   
   - Give customer-facing teams a structured way to safely build, test, and pilot new demo concepts
   
   - Evaluate the strongest ideas and turn them into scalable standards, templates, and reusable assets

 - Serve as the strategic demo partner for high-impact opportunities
   
   - Advise teams on custom or personalized demos that fall outside the standard portfolio
   
   - Help teams balance customer relevance, technical credibility, and speed without compromising quality




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - 5+ years in a technical or customer-facing role such as Solutions Engineering, Sales Engineering, Demo Engineering, Solutions Architecture, or Software Engineering

 - Experience designing and delivering technical demos, prototypes, or solution experiences for a SaaS product

 - Strong systems thinking, with experience building scalable standards, templates, documentation, versioning practices, and operating processes

 - Ability to translate complex product capabilities into clear, compelling customer stories tied to business value

 - Technical fluency across APIs, integrations, automation, data, permissions, and enterprise security concepts

 - Working proficiency with scripting or automation tools such as Python or JavaScript

 - Experience partnering across Sales, Product, Engineering, Enablement, and Marketing to drive alignment and deliver shared outcomes

 - Strong communication and coaching skills, with the ability to raise the capabilities of customer-facing teams

 - Comfort creating structure, setting priorities, and making progress in a fast-moving environment with evolving requirements




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Experience building or scaling a demo engineering, solutions engineering, or technical enablement function

 - Experience with enterprise sales cycles and complex, multi-stakeholder customer environments

 - Hands-on experience with demo automation platforms such as Consensus, Navattic, Reprise, Storylane, or Demostack

 - Experience supporting major product launches or global go-to-market programs

 - Familiarity with AI coding tools such as Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor

 - Experience with productivity, collaboration, AI, or horizontal SaaS products

 - Notion power user
   


TOOLS YOU'LL USE:

 - Demo environments: Notion, plus demo automation platforms as needed

jobs.title: Student Assistant - Data & Analytics (BluePool and Data Governance)
jobs.description:
Do you want to help shape the future of Europe’s energy system and contribute to a fully carbon‑neutral, sustainable power grid? Are you a data engineer who is curious, open‑minded, and initiative-taking — someone who enjoys working in an explorative and collaborative environment? Do you want to collaborate with engineers, application developers, and data scientists to unlock insights from the vast amounts of data behind our services? 

We are looking for a Student Assistant to support our Data & Analytics department. This is an excellent opportunity for a student who wants practical experience working with data platforms, governance processes, documentation, and operational support activities in an international and highly technical environment. 

Nordic RCC – supporting security of supply and the green energy transition 

Nordic Regional Coordination Centre (RCC) provides critical services and insights to support the national Transmission System Operators (TSOs) in Finland, Norway, Sweden and Denmark — to ensure the efficient operation and use of the Nordic power system and high security of power supply at any time. 

Based in Copenhagen, Nordic RCC is one of six RCCs in Europe, equally owned by the Nordic region's four electricity TSOs: Fingrid, Statnett, Svenska Kraftnät, and Energinet. 

As European power systems integrate and evolve to meet climate goals, Nordic RCC provides regional coordination, integrated services, regional insights and recommendations to the Nordic TSOs and their control centres, to support cross-border operational security 24/7.  

Join Nordic RCC, a fast-developing company determined to make a significant impact in the energy sector and to provide for a secure and efficient transition to the green, sustainable energy system. 

Right now, we are looking for a Student Assistant to join our Data & Analytics Department. 

What You Will Be Working On 

The Data and Analytics team consists of 10 employees and consultants and plays a central role in enabling data-driven decision-making across Nordic RCC. The team develops and maintains data pipelines, analytics products, BI solutions, platform services, and information services that support operational, strategic, and regulatory needs. 

As Student Assistant, you will support various initiatives across the department, with a primary focus on NRCC's analytics platform ‘BluePool’, and data governance activities. 

Examples of tasks may include: 

BluePool Support 

  • Assisting with user onboarding and access administration 

  • Maintaining onboarding guides and user documentation 

  • Supporting training sessions and workshops 

  • Gathering and tracking user feedback 

  • Assisting with testing of new BluePool functionality 

Data Governance 

  • Supporting data governance processes and documentation 

  • Maintaining data catalogues and metadata documentation 

  • Assisting with data classification and governance activities 

  • Supporting compliance and process-related initiatives 

General Department Support 

  • Coordinating meetings and workshops 

  • Maintaining team documentation and knowledge bases 

  • Preparing presentations and communication materials 

  • Supporting project coordination and follow-up activities 

  • Assisting with ad hoc analytical and administrative tasks 

Who We Are Looking For 

You are currently enrolled in a relevant university programme, for example within data science, computer science, engineering, information management, business analytics, economics, mathematics, or a similar field. 

You do not need extensive professional experience. What matters most is that you are curious, structured, and comfortable taking ownership of practical tasks — from organizing documentation and following up on details to supporting colleagues with day-to-day needs. 

We are looking for someone who: 

  • Is detail-oriented and follows tasks through carefully 

  • Enjoys turning information into clear documentation, guides, or overviews that others can use 

  • Communicates clearly in writing and verbally 

  • Can work independently while also asking for input when needed 

  • Has an interest in data, analytics, and digital platforms 

  • Is comfortable using Microsoft Office tools 

It is an advantage, but not a requirement, if you have experience with one or more relevant tools or concepts, such as Python, SQL, Power BI, enterprise architecture, data governance, or technical documentation. 

What We Offer: 

  • A flexible student position that can be adapted to your studies 

  • Exposure to large-scale data and analytics initiatives within the energy sector 

  • Experience working in an international environment with Nordic stakeholders 

  • Insight into data governance, analytics platforms, and digital transformation 

  • Opportunities to build practical skills that are highly relevant for a future career in data and analytics 

  • A friendly and collaborative team with experienced data scientists, data engineers, and analytics specialists 

Application & Security Clearance 

Please apply online in English no later than 5 November 2026. Interviews will be conducted on a rolling basis. 

To ensure a fair and unbiased recruitment process, we kindly request that you do not include photographs in your CVs or application materials.   

A cover letter is not required, but we kindly ask you to include a few sentences in your CV explaining why you are interested in the position. Applications are only accepted through our online recruitment system.  

Note that as part of the recruitment process, the candidate must undergo a satisfactory background check. The position is also conditioned upon a national security clearance. Both will be facilitated by Nordic RCC. You can read more on security clearance here. Please also note that the process includes that any spouse, registered partner, cohabitant, steady partner, co-resident, child over 18 living at home and parent with the same address as the candidate must also consent to be examined.  Nordic RCC is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

In our Renewables division, we have major EPC projects in the pipeline for both short- and long-term operations. As an OT Security Architect, you will take the architectural lead and support all OT Security areas across the EPC substation projects.

Your tasks will include but are not limited to:

  • Contributing to the implementation of industry-accepted good practice and required Cyber/OT Security architecture at solution level, typically based on standards such as IEC 62443, ISO 27001, and NIS
  • Helping define products and standards relevant to OT Security and infrastructure
  • Hands-on experience with cybersecurity audits and compliance frameworks, including ISO 27001, Critical Infrastructure regulations, and IEC 62443
  • Reviewing requirements/ITT packages and providing input to tenders consisting of calculations, solutions, descriptions, clarifications, and reservations
  • Taking on an advisory or active role in infrastructure, identity access management, or logging/event-based activities
  • Being responsible for planning, coordinating, and executing FAT, SAT, and SIT activities to ensure successful system delivery and integration
  • Implementing customer-specific Cyber/OT Security requirements in substation design for multiple systems and subsystems, such as SCADA, low-voltage, HVAC, Auxiliary Control and Monitoring System, etc.


Crucial to this position is your ability to take ownership of project deliverables and coordinate OT Security deadlines with internal and external stakeholders. You should thrive in a leading role where your skills, collaboration, and structured approach help ensure that requirements are met.
 
Your profile & qualifications

You are a team player who enjoys leading projects and working with stakeholders to align on timing, scope, and objectives. You know when technical expertise should be brought in to support delivery. To us, this means that you have a structured and solution-oriented approach, the ability to influence stakeholders, and the dedication to see tasks through to completion.

You will be part of a team of six colleagues that values quality, attention to detail, and a flexible working environment. We are sociable, helpful, and open to input, and we work in a dedicated, structured, and execution-focused way while respecting the agility that is a natural part of our core tasks. We want the same from you.

To succeed in this position, we imagine that you have:

  • A minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in OT Security from a similar position
  • A Tech Lead mentality – we are not seeking an extreme subject matter expert, but a well-rounded colleague who can work through heavily structured large projects involving many stakeholders 
  • The ability to know when additional technical specialists or resources are needed to complete a project
  • Excellent communication skills and fluency in English
  • Experience working in complex engineering projects, as well as project and stakeholder management, is an advantage


If you have any questions, you are more than welcome to contact OT Security Architect & Team Lead, Reza Sarafrazjoo.
 
Welcome to Semco Maritime

At Semco Maritime, we create change. For people. For projects. And for the global energy sector. With us, you will join a community of over 2,300 of the most dedicated thinkers and doers in the energy industry who are driving real change and making their own personal mark on the global energy landscape.

While everyone knows why the energy transition is vital, we are concerned with the journey: how to get there. We provide the answers needed to make change real, because we believe that global energy ambitions can only be realized through hard work and clever, pragmatic solutions. This is what we do, and this is what we invite you to participate in.

Safety is at the core of everything we do, and we are committed to protecting our people, partners, and the planet as we work towards a sustainable energy future.
So yes, working for us will change the energy sector – and may well change you too. 

Care to join the movement?
Change. With us.

Semco Maritime is an international engineering and contracting company with 2,300 employees and 40 years of dedication rooted in both the conventional energy sector and the offshore wind industry. This puts us in a unique position to bridge today's and tomorrow’s solutions, constantly seeking clever and pragmatic ways to realise global energy ambitions. We do this through comprehensive project management across all phases of energy projects together with world-leading partners across the globe.

jobs.title: Data engineer for analytics platform with BI expertise and an interest in the green energy transition
jobs.description:
Do you want to help shape the future of Europe’s energy system and contribute to a fully carbon‑neutral, sustainable power grid? Are you a data engineer who is curious, open‑minded, and initiative-taking — someone who enjoys working in an explorative and collaborative environment? Do you want to collaborate with engineers, application developers, and data scientists to unlock insights from the vast amounts of data behind our services? 

We are looking for a Data Engineer with BI expertise to join our Data and Analytics team at Nordic RCC. If you are excited about building robust data pipelines, developing high‑quality BI products, and enabling data‑driven decision‑making in a mission‑driven organization, we encourage you to apply — even if you don’t meet every requirement. 

Nordic RCC – supporting security of supply and the green energy transition 

Nordic Regional Coordination Centre (RCC) provides critical services and insights to support the national Transmission System Operators (TSOs) in Finland, Norway, Sweden and Denmark — to ensure the efficient operation and use of the Nordic power system and high security of power supply at any time. 

Based in Copenhagen, Nordic RCC is one of six RCCs in Europe, equally owned by the Nordic region's four electricity TSOs: Fingrid, Statnett, Svenska Kraftnät, and Energinet. 

As European power systems integrate and evolve to meet climate goals, Nordic RCC provides regional coordination, integrated services, regional insights and recommendations to the Nordic TSOs and their control centres, to support cross-border operational security 24/7.  

Join Nordic RCC, a fast-developing company determined to make a significant impact in the energy sector and to provide for a secure and efficient transition to the green, sustainable energy system. 

Right now, we are looking for a Data Engineer who likes to make a difference! 

Job description

The Data and Analytics team consists of 10 employees and consultants and plays a central role in enabling data-driven decision-making across Nordic RCC. The team develops and maintains data pipelines, analytics products, BI solutions, platform services, and information services that support operational, strategic, and regulatory needs. 

As a Data Engineer with BI expertise, you will help design, build, operate, and improve our analytics platform and the data products built on it. You will work closely with data scientists, engineers, developers, infrastructure teams, external providers, and stakeholders to deliver reliable data pipelines, intuitive BI solutions, and user-friendly data services. 

Your work will directly influence how Nordic RCC uses data to improve processes, services, and operational decision-making. Your key responsibilities will include: 

  • Design, build, and optimize scalable data pipelines, data models, integrations, and curated datasets. 

  • Develop BI dashboards, reports, and data products that turn complex data into clear insights. 

  • Operate and improve analytics platform services, including data platforms, BI solutions, JupyterHub, user-facing analytics environments, and supporting applications. 

  • Ensure data quality, reliability, monitoring, and operational visibility across pipelines, BI products, and platform services. 

  • Monitor and optimize platform performance, resource use, computer storage, and analytical workloads. 

  • Collaborate with data scientists, engineers, developers, infrastructure teams, external providers, and stakeholders to deliver production-ready analytics solutions. 

  • Support the development of platform architecture, metadata, governance practices, and service-oriented delivery models such as Data-as-a-Service and Platform-as-a-Service. 

  • Document data flows, platform components, operational procedures, and technical solutions to support maintainability and knowledge sharing. 

We are looking for someone with several of the following qualifications: 

  • Minimum 5 years of experience as a Data Engineer, Analytics Engineer, BI Developer, Platform Engineer, Application Developer, or similar. 

  • Strong experience with ETL/ELT pipelines, modern data architectures, SQL, and data warehousing concepts. 

  • Hands-on experience with BI tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Qlik, or similar. 

  • Experience operating and optimizing analytics platforms in production environments. 

  • Experience with cloud-native technologies and analytics platforms such as Microsoft Azure, Databricks, Azure Synapse, Snowflake, or similar. 

  • Familiarity with orchestration, monitoring, DevOps, CI/CD, Python, containerization, Kubernetes, storage solutions, or data platform infrastructure 

  • Experience operationalizing analytics models, enabling data consumption, or supporting service-oriented delivery models is an advantage. 

  • Knowledge of power systems and the energy sector is a plus, but not a requirement. 

We encourage you to apply even if you do not meet all the listed requirements. Your experience and perspective could be exactly what we are looking for. 

Working Environment 

You will join a diverse and enthusiastic team in our office at Copenhagen Towers, Ørestad. Nordic RCC is home to over twenty nationalities, with a healthy gender balance and a wide range of ages and backgrounds. We value curiosity, fellowship, respect, and transparency—and we hope you see yourself in these values. 

We offer flexible work arrangements to support a healthy work-life balance, including the option to work from home part of the time. Due to the collaborative nature of our work, physical presence in the office is expected on most days. 

You’ll report to Data & Analytics team-lead and collaborate regularly with colleagues from the Nordic RCC and occasionally also from the Nordic TSOs. Travel is limited and will not exceed 15 days per year. 

Nordic RCC is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. 

Application & Security Clearance 

Please apply online in English no later than 5 November 2026. Interviews will be conducted on a rolling basis. 

To ensure a fair and unbiased recruitment process, we kindly request that you do not include photographs in your CVs or application materials.   

A cover letter is not required, but we kindly ask you to include a few sentences in your CV explaining why you are interested in the position. Applications are only accepted through our online recruitment system.  

Note that as part of the recruitment process, the candidate must undergo a satisfactory background check. The position is also conditioned upon a national security clearance. Both will be facilitated by Nordic RCC. You can read more on security clearance here. Please also note that the process includes that any spouse, registered partner, cohabitant, steady partner, co-resident, child over 18 living at home and parent with the same address as the candidate must also consent to be examined.   Nordic RCC is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.
